jobs.excerpt: Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Senior Product Manager is the key driver of strategic product and brand management within the Oncology portfolio. The role is responsible for the successful commercialization of established products as well as the early strategic preparation of pipeline assets for future launches. Acting at the intersection of strategy, science, Business Excellence, Market Access, Medical Affairs, and the Field Force, the Senior Product Manager ensures that global and European strategies are translated into locally relevant and actionable marketing and communication concepts.

A particular focus of the role is close and continuous collaboration with Omnichannel Management, Business Excellence, and the Field Force. The objective is to ensure a consistent, data-driven, and customer-centric customer experience across all channels and touchpoints. In addition, the Senior Product Manager serves as a key interface to European Marketing, ensuring consistent strategy execution, best-practice sharing, and an aligned market strategy across countries.The role reports to the Director, Marketing, Spain and makes a significant contribution to successful commercial execution and the sustainable development of the Oncology portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

Launch & Pipeline Ownership

  • Lead the strategic preparation of pipeline assets in close collaboration with Business Excellence, Medical, Market Access, and European stakeholders.

  • Develop integrated launch plans considering the healthcare environment, stakeholder landscape, and market dynamics.

  • Ensure cross-functional launch readiness, including all relevant functions, in particular Omnichannel, Business, Excellence, Field Force enablement, Medical, Market Access, and material and content strategy.

  • Actively shape the Go-to-Market strategy in close alignment with regional stakeholders.

Product & Brand Management (In-Market)

  • Own the strategic commercialization of Oncology products in the market.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously optimize brand and marketing strategies throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Derive targeted marketing initiatives based on market, customer, and competitor analyses.

  • Drive the performance of products, including KPI tracking and the identification and implementation of optimization measures.

Cross-functional Integration & Omnichannel Leadership

  • Serve as a key interface between Marketing, Business Excellence, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Omnichannel Management, and the Field Force (SOAMs & ABLs).

  • Work closely with Omnichannel Management to develop integrated customer journeys and data-driven engagement strategies.

  • Ensure consistent execution of marketing strategies across all channels and touchpoints.

  • Translate marketing strategies into concrete, actionable content and initiatives for the Field Force.

  • Establish and manage a continuous feedback loop between the Field Force and the central Marketing organization.

European Coordination & Alignment

  • Work closely with European Marketing to ensure a consistent portfolio and brand strategy.

  • Actively contribute to and leverage European best practices for local implementation.

  • Ensure effective alignment between strategy, European direction, and local execution.

Business & Market Impact

  • Own the commercial performance of the products in close collaboration with the Field Force.

  • Analyze market, customer, and competitor developments and translate insights into strategic implications for marketing and launch strategies.

  • Support the Field Force (SOAMs/ABLs) through targeted marketing and omnichannel initiatives to achieve business and revenue objectives.

Required Skills, Experience, and Education:

A successful Senior Product Manager combines strong strategic marketing expertise, scientific acumen, and excellent cross-functional leadership skills with a deep understanding of the Oncology healthcare environment.

  • University degree in Natural Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

  • 8+ years of professional experience in the healthcare industry, including significant commercial marketing experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology sector.

  • Proven track record in pharmaceutical Marketing, Product Management or Brand Management, preferably within oncology or hospital-based therapeutic areas.

  • Demonstrated experience in pre-launch planning, launch readiness and oncology product launches.

  • Strong understanding of the Spanish pharmaceutical market, healthcare system and hospital environment.

  • Proven ability to translate international marketing strategies into effective local commercial plans and initiatives.

  • Strong strategic thinking, business acumen, analytical capabilities and results orientation.

  • Strong ability to generate and translate customer, market and competitive insights into actionable business strategies.

  • Experience in omnichannel marketing, customer engagement strategies and development of promotional materials.

  • Demonstrated success building effective partnerships across cross-functional and international teams.

  • Strong organizational, project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and tight timelines.

  • Experience managing marketing budgets, external agencies and commercial projects.

  • Self-directed, proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving organization.

  • Fluency in written and spoken Spanish and English.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.

  • Proficiency in AI tools to enhance marketing effectiveness, efficiency and innovation.

  • Strong understanding of precision oncology, molecular testing pathways and biomarker-driven treatment approaches.

  • Ability and willingness to travel for internal and external meetings, congresses and business activities, approximately 20-40% of the time.

Preferred Skills:

  • Extensive experience in pharmaceutical product or brand management within Oncology.

  • A strong understanding of market dynamics, Spanish healthcare system, customer journeys, and omnichannel marketing.

  • The ability to navigate and manage complex stakeholder structures across functions and countries.

  • Strong expertise in developing and executing integrated launch strategies.

  • Proven expertise to coordinate and engage with a cross-functional team on country and regional level.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively and collaboratively with the Field Force.

  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to decision-making.

  • A high degree of ownership, strategic thinking, and strong execution capabilities.

  • Outstanding written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, combined with a structured approach and professional presence that reflects the Core Values of Revolution Medicines.

  • Flexible team player who thrives in a fast-growing environment, embraces change, manages ambiguity and evolving priorities effectively within given budget frames.

  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Excel and Word, as well as other relevant business software.

Associate Manager, Regulatory Compliance
Location: Leesburg, VA, Allendale, NJ, or Remote (5–10% Travel Required)

Looking for a career where your work truly matters? At VB Spine, you’ll be part of a mission-focused team that supports surgeons during life-changing spinal procedures. We’re the largest privately held spine company and among the largest family-owned medical technology companies in the world, dedicated to innovation, surgeon partnerships, and improving patient outcomes in spine care. As Associate Manager, Regulatory Compliance in our Regulatory Affairs function within the Spine division, you’ll lead and execute global regulatory compliance activities with primary ownership of Product Field Assessments (PFAs) — remaining hands-on in regulatory assessments and reporting decisions while providing day-to-day guidance and supervision to the Regulatory Compliance team.

What You’ll Do:

Product Field Assessments (PFAs) & Postmarket Regulatory Compliance

  • Lead, manage, and actively participate in the execution of PFAs, ensuring timely evaluation, documentation, and resolution of potential field actions and other postmarket regulatory compliance matters
  • Exercise independent regulatory judgment in evaluating potential field actions and determining applicable reporting, notification, and communication requirements
  • Collaborate closely with Quality Assurance to incorporate quality and patient safety information into regulatory assessments and decisions
  • Oversee and support preparation, coordination, and submission of required FDA reports and regulatory notifications associated with PFAs and field actions

  • Present PFAs to VB Spine management, sales, and marketing functions as necessary
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and traceability of PFA records, supporting documentation, and regulatory decisions
  • Maintain ownership of PFA-related procedures, work instructions, and processes
  • Oversee PFA-related updates within the company PLM and other quality and regulatory systems
  • Evaluate nonconformances and compliance issues for potential regulatory implications, escalating significant matters as appropriate
  • Identify trends, compliance risks, and opportunities for improvement within the PFA process

Regulatory Process Ownership, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as process owner and subject matter expert for assigned regulatory compliance procedures, systems, and activities
  • Develop, maintain, and periodically review SOPs, work instructions, templates, and other controlled documents
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance compliance, consistency, efficiency, and operational effectiveness
  • Support internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance assessments, including documentation, responses, and corrective actions
  • Support integration activities associated with acquired products, businesses, and regulatory processes
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Global Regulatory Affairs, and other stakeholders to ensure consistent execution of regulatory compliance activities

Regulatory Information & Documentation Management

Regulatory Information Management System (RIMS)

  • Support regulatory intelligence activities to identify and communicate changes that may impact product compliance or market access

  • Identify and implement improvements to regulatory data integrity, system utilization, and operational efficiency

Team Leadership & Operational Management

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, supervision, and technical guidance to Regulatory Compliance team members while remaining hands-on in core activities

  • Mentor, coach, and develop team members to strengthen regulatory expertise, critical thinking, and professional growth
  • Establish clear performance expectations, provide ongoing feedback, and support employee development
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, continuous-improvement-oriented team environment
  • Provide Regulatory Affairs leadership with updates on team activities, compliance risks, key initiatives, and resource needs
  • Participate in cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives supporting Global Regulatory Affairs objectives
  • Perform other duties as assigned

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biological/Physical Science, or other relevant focus required
  • 6+ years of professional experience in Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, regulatory compliance, or a related function within the medical device or other FDA-regulated industry
  • Strong working knowledge of FDA regulations and applicable medical device requirements, including 21 CFR Parts 803 and 806
  • Demonstrated experience with postmarket regulatory compliance activities, including field actions, regulatory reporting, complaint handling, and nonconformance management

  • Experience preparing, reviewing, or overseeing FDA Medical Device Reports (MDRs), correction and removal reports, and other regulatory submissions or notifications
  • Familiarity with Health Hazard Evaluations (HHEs) and their role in supporting field action and reporting decisions

We believe in growing talent from within. At VB Spine, step into a hands-on leadership role where you’ll own Product Field Assessments, strengthen postmarket compliance, develop a high-performing team, and help ensure the regulatory integrity of innovative spinal technologies worldwide.

jobs.description:
About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the role

As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer working at Northbeam, you will work with a small engineering team to create a scaleable, observable, reliable platform for data ingestion, processing, and serving. Responsibilities will range widely and evolve, as they tend to at startups. The following all fall within the Infrastructure team’s remit:

  • CI/CD and dev infrastructure
  • Security
  • DR policies
  • SSL cert management and DNS
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Kubernetes Care and Maintenance
  • Capacity planning and budgeting
  • Observability
  • Scaling plans and automation
  • Guidance for best use of cloud infrastructure
  • … and more

Success in this role will require significant existing experience, interest in continuously learning and iterating on existing solutions, a penchant for automation over “clickops” and one-offs, and ability to effectively collaborate with engineers, auditors, product managers, and more.

Your Impact

You’ll wear many hats, juggle diverse tasks, and probably find yourself learning new skills on the fly – while also teaching a few. If you thrive on variety and love diving in, you’ll fit right in. Here’s a taste of what might come up:

  • Capacity management: tune the footprint you have, project what you'll need. Cloud provider out of hardware in Iowa? No problem, you and the team can ship multi-region support in under 3 weeks.
  • Migrations: move a high-volume pipeline off a managed service onto Kubernetes with zero data loss, cut its cost by a meaningful amount, and find a bug the old system had been hiding for years.
  • Incident response: handle the traffic spike nobody saw coming, then build the thing that takes care of it automatically next time.
  • Reliability and DR: run failover drills at peak traffic, restore production in another region, handle providers taking a 4 hour downtime “maintenance window” without anyone noticing.
  • Security: automate workflows to route automated security discoveries to the right people, fix critical CVEs, create structures and automations that help the rest of the eng team stay on top of the recent flood of vulnerabilities.
  • AI infrastructure: run the LLM gateway the company builds on, and work alongside AI agents that triage incidents and draft PRs with you.
  • Developer platform: introduce on-demand preview environments, manage CI runners, and make it easy for app teams to do the right thing without filing a ticket.
  • Communication: Create technical documentation that’s useful for engineers, understandable for stakeholders, and not soul-crushing to read.

You will work with great people who have done this many times before. You will teach them some new tricks, and maybe learn some old ones.

You’ll be a key player in keeping our platform reliable, efficient, and scalable. We’ll laugh, we’ll cry, we’ll tell stories of yore. If this sounds like your kind of chaos, we’d love to hear from you.

What You Bring

  • Experience and judgement: When it comes to cloud infrastructure, you are the person people go to with their thorniest questions. Everyone has Claude; you have Claude, lived experience, and taste.
  • Bias for Automation:You automate things. You create bots. You might have a home lab. You are allergic to clickops.
  • Technical direction: You've set the infrastructure roadmap for a team or company, not just executed one. You can take something vague like "we should be multi-region," turn it into a phased plan with real tradeoffs, get buy-in, and see it through.
  • Security as a practice: You've led a company through security certifications and kept it there. You decide where to invest and where to accept risk, explain those calls to leadership in plain terms, and build processes that make the secure path the easy one without slowing everything to a crawl.
  • Reliability ownership: You've designed for failure before it happened: DR, failover, capacity planning, cost. When incidents happen you lead the response, and afterward you work with the team to fix the root causes.
  • Observability strategy: You make it, you tweak it, you don’t tolerate neither alert noise nor silent failure. Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, whatever; you've used enough of them to have opinions, and you can use any of them to get the job done.
  • Effective collaboration: You work across engineering, data, product, and leadership. People follow your standards because they make their lives easier, not because they were told to.

Bonus Skills and Experience:

  • Experience in marketing, e-commerce, or ad-tech, where traffic spikes on someone else's schedule.
Base Salary Range
$190,000—$240,000 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process
The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Your work will help AI systems reliably access, interpret and present product, pricing, availability and delivery information, improving product discoverability and overall ecommerce performance.

You will be an integral part of the AEO/GEO programme and engineering team, collaborating closely with the AEO/GEO Lead, engineering and platform teams, paid search, trading and product content teams.

This mid-to-senior-level role centres on enhancing structured data quality, maintaining accurate and consistent product information across large-scale catalogues, and supporting the next generation of AI-powered product discovery and shopping experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain template-level JSON-LD across product, category, content and brand pages, covering Product, ProductGroup, Offer, AggregateRating, Review, OfferShippingDetails, MerchantReturnPolicy and Organization.
  • Generate structured markup directly from source systems, ensuring data remains accurate as prices, stock levels and customer reviews change.
  • Build automated validation and monitoring processes to detect missing, broken or conflicting structured data.
  • Manage and maintain product feed pipelines into Google Merchant Center and Microsoft Merchant Center, working closely with the paid search team.
  • Develop product feeds and integrations for emerging AI shopping platforms and agentic commerce protocols.
  • Ensure near real-time consistency of pricing, availability and delivery information across the website, structured markup and product feeds.
  • Identify and address gaps in product attributes, including specifications, energy ratings, dimensions and compatibility details.
  • Ensure pricing, delivery options and customer review information are accurately and consistently structured across relevant platforms.
  • Work with PIM, catalogue and trading teams to identify and resolve product data quality issues at source.
  • Ensure key content and structured markup are accessible in server-rendered HTML and discoverable by AI crawlers.
  • Support log file analysis and crawler access optimisation in collaboration with the AEO/GEO Lead.
  • Translate AEO/GEO insights into clearly defined, actionable and testable engineering tasks.
  • Deliver technical changes through established Git workflows, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
  • Ensure product data and structured markup are ready ahead of major retail events, including Black Friday and significant product launches.
  • Participate in engineering stand-ups, sprint planning and team rituals during UK business hours.
  • First 30 days: Understand the existing technology stack, PIM systems and feed pipelines, audit structured data and feed quality across priority categories, and establish a prioritised implementation backlog.
  • Days 31–60: Implement corrected, source-driven structured markup across high-traffic templates and address critical pricing, availability and product attribute inconsistencies.
  • Days 61–90: Introduce automated validation and monitoring, expand coverage across the product catalogue and document processes for ongoing maintenance.
  • Work towards fully automated, validated and monitored structured markup and product feeds across priority categories within the first 90 days.
  • Measure progress against the initial audit, including structured data coverage and validity, pricing and availability consistency, product attribute completeness and Merchant Center feed health.
  • Monitor data quality issues and increase the proportion of errors identified and resolved before they affect customers or AI systems.
  • Support improvements in AI search visibility, measured through the AEO/GEO Lead's citation and factual accuracy metrics.

  • 4+ years of experience in backend, data or integration engineering, with at least 2 years in ecommerce or retail technology.
  • Strong Python programming skills, sound SQL knowledge and practical experience with ETL processes and data pipeline tools.

  • Solid understanding of JSON-LD and schema.org, or the technical capability to quickly develop expertise and implement structured data correctly.
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining product feeds for Google Merchant Center or comparable platforms.
  • Working knowledge of server-side rendering, caching, Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) and how search engine and AI crawlers access and interpret web content.
  • Experience implementing automated testing, validation and monitoring processes to maintain data quality.
  • Practical experience with Git, code reviews and CI/CD pipelines within an established engineering environment.
  • Ability to maintain accurate, consistent and reliable data across large-scale ecommerce product catalogues.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and commercial stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to agentic commerce, AI shopping integrations or Large Language Model (LLM) APIs.
  • Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse.
  • Background working with consumer electrical products or other specification-heavy product categories.

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Cape Verdean Creole-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Cape Verdean Creole Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $15 - $17 per hour.

  • For Colorado applicants, the expected pay range is $15.16 - $19.29 per hour.
  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Cape Verdean Creole Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Cape Verdean Creole and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**


Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions at all times.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inCape Verdean Creole and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

jobs.description:
Role Summary

Triquetra Health is a fast-growing health and wellness brand selling through Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, retail marketplaces and wholesale distributors. We are moving our books to Sage Intacct, and this role joins in time to own the first closes on the new system.

The SeniorAccountant owns the month-end close, the balance sheet and inventory
accounting, and reviews the Bookkeeper's daily work. You will deliver financial statements within 7 business days, keep every account reconciled, and help shape how Intacct runs from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Close and reporting

  • Own the month-end close and deliver the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow within 7 business days.
  • Post period entries: accruals (including advertising), prepaids, payroll and payroll tax, depreciation, amortization and loan interest.
  • Keep a supporting schedule for every balance sheet account, including debt split between current and long-term.
  • Review and sign off the Bookkeeper's work each month, confirming it is complete and reconciled before it is reported as done.
  • Reconciliations and controls
  • Reconcile every bank, card, payment-processor and marketplace clearing account to its statement monthly.
  • Reconcile Amazon, Shopify and TikTok settlements to deposits and keep clearing accounts at open items only.
  • Maintain internal controls: supplier payments always clear payables against a bill, no balances parked in suspense, and every correction documented.
  • Inventory and cost accounting
  • Own inventory and COGS, including landed cost, co-manufacturer conversion costs and inventory valuation.
  • Reconcile the inventory system (Luminous) to the general ledger and investigate variances.
  • Partner with operations on purchase orders, production runs and inventory transfers. Sage Intacct (first months)
  • Run the first closes in Sage Intacct and stabilize the new processes alongside the implementation partner.
  • Validate migrated balances and help refine dimensions (channel, department), workflows and reports.
  • Set up recurring entries, close checklists and payables approvals in the new system.
  • Planning and analysis
  • Build and own a rolling cash flow forecast, updated weekly.
  • Support the budget, budget-to-actual reporting and channel margin analysis.
  • Prepare support for the tax preparer, 1099s and any audit or lender requests.
  • The finance team follows a documented SOP manual with step-by-step procedures; you will help keep it current as processes move into Intacct.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including general ledger ownership and the month-end close.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting.
  • Inventory and cost accounting in a physical-product or e-commerce business (COGS,landed cost, inventory valuation).
  • Hands-on experience with Sage Intacct or a comparable cloud ERP (NetSuite or
  • similar).
  • Advanced Excel: pivot tables, lookups and cash flow modeling.
  • Works independently and meets close deadlines in a fully remote team.
  • Must be amenable to working U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours to ensure effective collaboration with the marketing team.
  • Must be comfortable using Time Doctor, a productivity tool that supports workload visibility, capacity planning, and productivity insights.

Preferred

  • Sage Intacct experience during or right after a go-live.
  • Amazon, Shopify and TikTok settlement accounting (A2X, Synder or similar).
  • Consumer health, CPG or co-manufactured products.
  • Wholesale receivables and distributor deductions (EDI retailers, distributors such as KeHE and iHerb).
  • Multi-state sales tax exposure and internal control improvement.
  • CPA or progress toward it.

Systems and details

Systems

Sage Intacct (Xero for history), A2X or successor settlement tool, Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, TikTok Seller Center, Luminous (inventory), CRSTL (EDI), ADP, Excel and Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp

Works with

Bookkeeper, operations and inventory, Intacct implementation partner

First 90 days: close the first months in Sage Intacct on the 7-day timeline, take over the

reconciliations and balance sheet schedules, and stand up the rolling cash flow forecast.

Salary: $95,000 - $110,000 annually

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Service Manager, Threat Services, you will be tasked with helping make our strategic partnership successful for customers by representing SentinelOne's interests in partner-delivered managed detection and response (MDR), ensuring the service is performing as promised, quality issues are identified early, and operational changes produce better customer outcomes. The partner operates the service; you own SentinelOne-side assurance, cross-team resolution, and evidence-driven continuous improvement. Our expanded global relationship with our strategic partners brings together SentinelOne's AI-powered security platform and our partners' expertise in managed detection and response, managed SIEM, and incident response, and as partner-delivered services grow, SentinelOne remains committed to clear customer ownership, technical quality, and measurable results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Run structured MDR operational reviews with the partner covering alert handling, investigation quality, escalation decisions, and customer impact.
  • Monitor detection and response performance, including mean time to detect, mean time to respond, false positives, and escalation accuracy.
  • Investigate missed handoffs, inaccurate prioritization, repeated tuning defects, and service failures; coordinate corrective-action plans.
  • Partner with SentinelOne detection engineering and Product to adjudicate content issues while preserving SentinelOne ownership of platform detection decisions.
  • Validate that MDR runbooks, escalation thresholds, customer contacts, and evidence requirements are current and followed.
  • Coordinate high-severity service issues with Critical Situation Management, Support, Threat Services, and customer-facing technical success teams.
  • Review partner quality samples and reconcile partner-reported results with SentinelOne telemetry and independent reporting.
  • Maintain a prioritized improvement backlog with owners, actions, deadlines, and objective closure evidence.
  • Identify onboarding and service-readiness risks that could affect ongoing operations or customer retention.
  • Drive measurable outcomes, including improved MDR detection and response performance with evidence-based reporting; better escalation accuracy and lower avoidable false-positive burden; closure of recurring MDR quality findings and improvement actions; higher MDR customer satisfaction and stronger renewal health; and earlier identification and containment of systemic service issues.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 5 or more years of experience in MDR, SOC management, security operations, managed security service delivery, or technical service assurance.
  • Strong understanding of SIEM, EDR/XDR, alert triage, incident handling, detection tuning, and operational security workflows.
  • Experience evaluating detection quality, response timelines, false-positive trends, and customer escalation patterns.
  • Ability to work productively with external delivery partners without confusing governance with hands-on service operations.
  • Strong root-cause analysis, quality-review, documentation, and data interpretation capabilities.
  • Confident stakeholder management during urgent security events and sensitive customer issues.
  • Ability to drive remediation across technical, customer success, engineering, and partner teams.
  • Experience with SentinelOne Singularity and Purple AI or similar detection and response platforms is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with threat hunting, incident readiness and response, and security analytics is highly desirable.
  • Experience building scorecards or operational quality programs for an MSSP is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Title: Manager, Community Outreach & Engagement


Full-Time ∙ Exempt-Salaried ∙ Remote (Baltimore, Maryland)


Are you ready to transform your career into a powerful catalyst for change? For almost 30 years, ZERO Prostate Cancer (ZERO) has been at the forefront of the battle against prostate cancer, providing essential support to patients and families touched by this disease. ZERO is the nation’s leading prostate cancer organization and the number one provider of prostate cancer resources, programs, and services. We are on a mission to improve and save lives from prostate cancer through advocacy, awareness, education, and support.

Consistently recognized as one of the Best Nonprofits to Work for by the Nonprofit Times, we take pride in our unwavering commitment to our team and community. Our culture is founded on the principles of growth, inclusivity, and camaraderie, which we uphold with passion and purpose. Our vision is a world where prostate cancer detection is early, support is unwavering, and care is accessible to all. When you join ZERO, you become part of an extraordinary community with strong core values, where each individual motivates and inspires one another, advancing your career while making a meaningful impact in the fight against prostate cancer. Seize this opportunity to be more than just an employee—become an essential part of a movement that truly matters!


Job Summary:

The Manager, Community Outreach & Engagement will serve as a community engagement strategist for ZERO’s health equity mission, working directly with communities to deliver lifesaving prostate cancer education, screening opportunities, and support services. This role is ideal for a mission-driven individual with strong community connections, a passion for advancing health equity, and the ability to inspire grassroots involvement that drives impact. The Manager will lead outreach activities, mobilize volunteers, build and sustain partnerships with local organizations, and represent ZERO at community events and gatherings. By collaborating with community-based organizations, healthcare providers, and trusted local voices, the Manager will ensure that outreach efforts are culturally responsive and accessible. This highly visible role will be the face of ZERO in the region, connecting underserved populations to critical prostate cancer resources while aligning local efforts with national initiatives such as Blitz the Barriers.


Key Duties & Responsibilities:

1. Regional Community Engagement

  • Implement grassroots outreach strategies to engage target populations in prostate cancer education, awareness, and screening
  • Represent ZERO at community health fairs, educational forums, and local events.
  • Coordinate with local Community Engagement Committees (CECs) to support outreach initiatives and amplify community voices.

2. Regional Volunteer Engagement

  • Recruit, onboard, train, and engage community-based volunteer navigators, leveraging local knowledge, cultural understanding, and established relationships to support prostate cancer patients and underserved populations.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive training programs to equip volunteer navigators with the knowledge, skills, and resources necessary to provide prostate cancer education, patient support, and connections to care.
  • Establish and strengthen partnerships with community organizations, faith-based institutions, and local stakeholders to increase prostate cancer awareness, promote screening, and expand access to supportive services.
  • Coordinate volunteer-led peer support and mentorship opportunities, engaging prostate cancer survivors and community advocates to build trust, reduce barriers to care, and connect patients and caregivers with ZERO's Patient Navigation services.

3. Program Execution

  • Facilitate the delivery of community-based programs and services aligned with the goals of Blitz the Barriers.
  • Work closely with internal teams (Patient Navigation, Measurement & Evaluation) to ensure successful implementation and impact tracking of local programs.
  • Maintain records and assist with data collection related to outreach activities and participant engagement.

4. Partnership Development

  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with regional healthcare providers, community-based organizations (CBOs), and non-traditional partners.
  • Identify opportunities to collaborate with Urology Practices, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), clinics, and local support organizations to expand prostate cancer education and resources.
  • Conduct asset mapping to identify local organizations, businesses, leaders, and spaces that can support program goals.

5. Event Coordination

  • Plan and coordinate roundtables, health screenings, and educational events in collaboration with local partners.
  • Serve as the point of contact for regional outreach events and activations, ensuring a culturally competent and community-centered approach.

6. Internal Collaboration & Reporting

  • Provide regular updates and reports to the Director of Community Outreach and Engagement.
  • Participate in team meetings and training to share best practices and align on ZERO’s national strategies.
  • Assist in the development of reports, presentations, and communication materials to highlight outreach outcomes.
  • Other duties as assigned

Core Competencies for Success:

  • Cultural Humility & Competence: Ability to work across lines of race, gender, income, and identity with empathy and respect.
  • Relationship-Building: Skilled at cultivating trust with partners, community members, and stakeholders.
  • Equity Lens: Understands systemic barriers and is committed to reducing disparities in health outcomes.
  • Community Leadership: Motivated to empower others and amplify community voice in program design and delivery.
  • Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving nonprofit environment.
  • Mission Alignment: Passionate about ZERO’s vision and dedicated to advancing health equity in prostate cancer outcomes.
  • Data-Driven Strategy: Skilled at analyzing community health data, demographic trends, and outreach metrics to guide program design and measure impact.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Sciences, Communications, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in community engagement, grassroots outreach, or health education.
  • Demonstrated success building relationships with diverse populations, healthcare systems, community, and professional organizations.
  • Experience working and engaging with healthcare systems, FQHCs, and Urology Practices
  • Experience coordinating and leading community events, workshops, or outreach campaigns, and managing volunteer teams and committees.
  • Strong verbal communication and public speaking skills; comfortable representing the organization in public settings.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders, partners, and local leaders to strengthen community presence.
  • Knowledge of health equity, cultural humility, and best practices in community outreach.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in fast-moving environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in health education or cancer prevention outreach.
  • Bilingual or multilingual communication skills are a plus.
  • Experience working in target regions or with similar regional populations.
  • Ability to adapt to changing situations.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work across teams/departments.

Physical Requirements:

  • Constant use of a computer and other office productivity equipment, such as a printer, calculator, and copier.
  • Prolonged periods of a stationary position at least 50% of the time.
  • The ability to recognize details at close range for extended periods of time.
  • The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

One of many reasons to join the ZERO team is because we offer great benefits!

  • Flexible (Unlimited) PTO, upon completion of probationary period
  • 403(b) retirement plan matching up to 4%
  • 100% Employer-paid benefits include: Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, & Long-Term Disability insurance
  • FSA/HSA

This role will report directly to the Director, Community Outreach & Engagement and will work closely with the Outreach & Engagement team to support ZERO’s mission to improve and save lives from prostate cancer through advocacy, education, awareness, and support.

This is a remote opportunity for candidates based in the region's metro area. This position will require local travel within the region's metro area to community partners approximately 20% to 40% of the time (travel will vary with program and community needs).Additionally, there will be some occasional national travel.

ZERO Prostate Cancer is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all employees. We encourage BIPOC, Veterans, individuals with Disabilities and those affected by prostate cancer to apply. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

Reporting directly to our Credentialing Manager, the Credentialing / Enrollment Senior Associate will support all credentialing or payer enrollments operations at Nourish, including assisting with day-to-day tasks, maintaining and optimizing workflows, developing net-new processes as we expand into new payers and functions, and helping to ensure the credentialing process runs smoothly. This is an entry point into our cred/enrollment org - We're hiring for a number of roles and will make sure we match you with the best fit opportunity.

This role is critical for many of Nourish’s core operations; you’ll get the chance to work cross-functionally with our RCM, Payer Ops, Clinical Ops, and Customer Experience teams. The work you do will positively impact all stakeholders at Nourish—our patients (ensuring they get the life-changing care they need), our dietitians (providing a seamless credentialing experience), our payers, and more.

This role is full-time and open fully remote or NYC-based candidates.

Key Responsibilities:

You have 3+ years of experience in a payer enrollment and/or credentialing role.

The Organization

What if K-12 education were designed to help all students develop lives of meaning and purpose? Wayfinder, a division of Lemnis, was founded at the Stanford d.school to answer this question. Our goal is to double our impact each year for the coming years. Our vision is to become the preeminent future-readiness curriculum company in the world — leading the global movement of purpose, meaning, and belonging-based education worldwide.

Wayfinder joined the Lemnis Collective as a nonprofit division in 2026. As a public charity, Lemnis is dedicated to the concept of the unlimited learner. Their mission is to create more accessible, flexible, learner-centered systems that help young people navigate the challenges and opportunities of the future. Wayfinder and Lemnis share that vision, especially when it comes to supporting learners in underserved communities and the institutions that serve them.

Wayfinder is the third organization to join the Lemnis Collective. The Collective brings mission-aligned organizations (both for-profit assets and nonprofits with earned revenue) under the Lemnis umbrella through mergers and acquisitions. Lemnis provides long-term, mission-driven investment, stability, freedom from the pressure of constant fundraising, and operational and strategic support, so organizations like Wayfinder can stay focused on our mission, impact, growth, and innovation.

What We Value

You’ll be joining a team of incredibly motivated and dedicated staff members committed to living our organization's values. We work collaboratively across teams, and we feel and act like a purpose-driven organization. To the best of our abilities, each person’s role aligns with their own sense of purpose, which feeds into Wayfinder’s larger sense of purpose.

Read this article about our workplace culture in SOCAP Global.

We value equal access, inclusive community, and belonging, and these values are represented in our product, our team, and our school partners.

Product: We develop our learning tools using human-centered design principles. We work with grade-level experts to ensure our curriculum is developmentally appropriate and engaging at all levels. Every Wayfinder lesson is supported by relevant research, prototyped in classrooms, and vetted by teachers over rounds of feedback and iteration. We use Universal Design for Learning principles to give every student an equal opportunity to succeed.

Team: Our team is composed of people from all different backgrounds and walks of life. We intentionally recruit, hire, and work with people of all identities + experiences. We focus on belonging: being connected, accepted, and valued by the people around us.

School Partners: We intentionally target a wide array of educational partners, from traditional to non-traditional, that work with a range of students from different socioeconomic groups. We’ve taught our curriculum in high-need schools in the Bronx, independent schools in Silicon Valley, and after-school programs in San Antonio.

The Role

Wayfinder is looking for a Director of Account Management to lead our team of eight Account Managers and own the retention and growth of our current partner base. The Director of Account Management will play an integral part in Customer Success’s work to help school and district partners see value year after year, renew, and expand across Enterprise, Traditional, and Scaled books.

Our ideal candidate has a background leading quota-carrying account management or customer success teams, ideally in K-12 EdTech, and work experience coaching Account Managers through complex renewals, running pipeline reviews and forecasting, and owning a team’s gross and net revenue retention results. Our ideal candidate is based in the Pacific or Mountain time zone.

The Director of Account Management will report to the Senior Director of Customer Success.

We strongly encourage people from traditionally underrepresented populations in tech - such as women, People of Color, People with Disabilities, and LGBTQ+ people, etc - to apply!

  • Own the team’s Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and expansion targets, partnering with Sales on the expansion accounts Account Executives lead, and deliver an accurate weekly forecast to Customer Success and Growth leadership.

  • Run a consistent renewal motion, from early value conversations through quoting, procurement, and close.

  • Partner with Customer Success leadership on Account Manager comp plan administration, quota setting, and book assignments.

  • Run the team in Salesforce and Gong: build reports and dashboards, keep account and opportunity data clean, and use Gong for call coaching and pipeline reviews.

  • Turn partner feedback and churn reasons into clear insight for Product, Marketing, and Implementation.

The Vice President, GSE Servicing will be responsible for serving as the company’s primary subject matter expert and point of contact for Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac servicing requirements, performance expectations, and strategic initiatives. Provides enterprise leadership and direction on government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) servicing procedures, scorecard performance, monthly business reviews, operational planning, and long-range strategy. Translates GSE guidance and performance feedback into clear business requirements, measurable action plans, and sustainable servicing practices across performing loans, default servicing, loss mitigation, investor reporting, claims, quality control, and related support functions. This position works closely with Servicing Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Finance, Technology, Data and Analytics, and executive leadership to identify emerging risks and opportunities, drive accountability for corrective actions, and represent the company in formal and informal engagements with the GSEs. Performs all duties in accordance with company policies and procedures and applicable federal and state laws and regulations. The target pay for this position is $180,000-$225,000 plus Annual Bonus.

GSE Servicing Leadership and Relationship Management
• Serve as the primary servicing subject matter expert and point of contact for Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, coordinating inquiries, escalations, reviews, and follow-up commitments.
• Establish and maintain productive relationships with GSE servicing, performance management, account management, and oversight teams.
• Represent the company in GSE meetings, examinations, onsite or virtual reviews, industry forums, and strategic discussions.
• Provide authoritative interpretation and practical application of GSE servicing requirements across the servicing organization.

Servicing Procedures, Governance, and Change Management
• Own enterprise governance for GSE servicing procedures and ensure operational practices align with current GSE guides, announcements, bulletins, directives, contracts, and approved variances.
• Lead cross-functional assessments of new or revised GSE requirements, define business impacts, assign accountable owners, and oversee implementation through documented completion and validation.
• Identify procedural gaps, control weaknesses, and inconsistent practices; sponsor corrective action plans and verify that changes are sustainable and embedded in daily operations.
• Partner with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Quality Control, Internal Audit, Technology, and business leaders to maintain defensible evidence of compliance and operational readiness.

Scorecard Performance and Remediation

• Lead oversight of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac servicing scorecards, performance metrics, benchmarks, rankings, and related management reporting.
• Analyze performance trends and root causes across investor reporting, custodial accounting, loss mitigation, foreclosure, bankruptcy, claims, property preservation, customer service, and other applicable servicing functions.
• Establish performance targets, early-warning indicators, and operating tolerances; escalate material deterioration and recommend timely corrective action.
• Coordinate remediation plans in response to GSE findings or performance concerns, including milestones, owners, validation criteria, executive reporting, and closure evidence.

Monthly Business Reviews and Executive Reporting
• Plan and lead monthly GSE business reviews with internal executives and operational leaders, presenting scorecard results, portfolio trends, emerging risks, open findings, and strategic priorities.
• Develop concise, decision-oriented materials that connect servicing performance to financial, operational, compliance, reputation, and counterparty risk.
• Maintain an integrated inventory of GSE commitments, action items, exceptions, approvals, and due dates; drive timely completion and transparent status reporting.
• Prepare executives for GSE meetings by developing briefing materials, anticipated questions, performance narratives, and recommended positions.

Planning, Strategy, and Cross-Functional Execution
• Develop and maintain the GSE servicing strategy and annual operating plan, aligning portfolio objectives, capacity, technology, controls, and talent with GSE expectations and company priorities.
• Advise executive leadership on servicing policy changes, portfolio performance, emerging industry practices, counterparty risk, and opportunities to improve outcomes or reduce cost and exposure.
• Partner with Finance and Operations to evaluate the resource, technology, vendor, and financial implications of GSE initiatives and performance commitments.
• Sponsor strategic initiatives that improve borrower outcomes, operational effectiveness, data quality, automation, scalability, and scorecard performance.
• Support new client onboarding, servicing transfers, portfolio acquisitions, and product or process changes by validating GSE servicing requirements and readiness.
• Provide leadership, coaching, and subject matter guidance to team members and business partners; promote disciplined execution, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What you'll need:
• Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, risk management, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
• Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressive mortgage servicing experience.
• Minimum ten (10) years of direct GSE servicing experience involving Fannie Mae and/or Freddie Mac requirements, performance management, or counterparty engagement.
• Executive-level experience leading GSE scorecard performance, business reviews, servicing procedure governance, remediation, and strategic planning.
• Prior experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior operational, risk, compliance, legal, finance, technology, and analytics partners.

jobs.title: Manager, Digital Marketing
jobs.excerpt: At SCORE, our mission is to foster vibrant small business communities through mentoring and education.
jobs.description:
At SCORE, our mission is to foster vibrant small business communities through mentoring and education. Through its network of volunteers, education, and resources, SCORE empowers small business owners to sustain successful businesses at any stage of their small business journey

We're seeking a Digital Marketing Manager to help expand SCORE’s national reach, strengthen audience engagement, and connect more entrepreneurs with the ongoing support needed to succeed.

About the Role

The Manager, Digital Marketing leads SCORE’s national digital marketing strategy to increase brand awareness, engage key audiences, and connect more entrepreneurs with SCORE’s mentoring and educational resources. This role oversees national social media, email marketing, paid advertising, marketing automation, and digital performance analytics to drive measurable audience growth, engagement, and conversion.

Through data-driven decision-making and cross-functional collaboration, the Manager, Digital Marketing strengthens SCORE’s digital presence and advances organizational marketing priorities. The role partners closely with the Field Marketing Manager to align national digital strategies with chapter needs, maintain consistent standards across digital channels, and equip chapters with the tools and guidance needed to support local marketing efforts.

The ideal candidate is an experienced digital marketer who knows how to capture ideas and turn them into bold, measurable results. This person is comfortable working within a nationwide network of volunteers and thrives on connecting with audiences and inspiring action.

This is a full-time, non-exempt, remote position with a required schedule of Monday-Friday from 9:00 am - 5:00 pm Eastern. Applicants should reside in one of the following states: AZ, CA, DC, FL, IL, LA, MD, MI, NC, NY, OH, OK, PA, TX, VA

Salary Range: $98,555 - $102,000

At SCORE, we recognize that our employees are essential to advancing our mission. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including:

  • Competitive salary
  • 100% employer-paid medical eligible for employees
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays and two floating holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Remote work environment
  • Professional development opportunities

No phone or email inquiries will be accepted regarding this position.

Responsibilities:

National Digital Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute national digital marketing strategies aligned with organizational goals, audience needs, and annual marketing priorities.
  • Establish channel strategies, objectives, key performance indicators, and measurement frameworks for national digital marketing initiatives.
  • Manage national digital marketing campaigns that increase awareness of SCORE, promote mentoring and educational resources, and support organizational priorities, including volunteer recruitment and fundraising.
  • Identify opportunities to improve audience acquisition, engagement, retention, and conversion across digital channels.
  • Monitor digital marketing trends, emerging platforms, and evolving audience behaviors to inform strategy and identify opportunities for innovation.
  • Collaborate with the Senior Director, Marketing & Communications and other marketing team members to ensure digital initiatives support integrated marketing campaigns and organizational objectives.
  • Contribute to annual marketing planning, budgeting, and performance reviews for national digital marketing initiatives.
  • Support the development and implementation of marketing policies, standards, and processes related to digital channels.
  • Provide digital marketing expertise and recommendations to support organizational priorities and cross-functional initiatives.

Email Marketing & Marketing Automation

  • Lead national email marketing strategy, including audience segmentation, campaign planning, lifecycle communications, and performance optimization.
  • Oversee the administration, configuration, and effective use of SCORE’s national email marketing and marketing automation platforms.
  • Develop and optimize automated email journeys that guide audiences toward relevant SCORE resources, including mentoring, workshops, educational content, volunteer opportunities, and fundraising initiatives.
  • Establish email marketing standards and best practices for audience targeting, personalization, deliverability, accessibility, and performance measurement.
  • Analyze email engagement and conversion data to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and audience experience.
  • Partner with the Field Marketing Manager to ensure email marketing tools, workflows, guidance, and resources support chapter needs and align with national standards.
  • Collaborate with other marketing team members to coordinate email communications within integrated campaigns and maintain a cohesive audience experience.

National Social Media & Digital Community Engagement

  • Develop and execute SCORE’s national social media strategy to increase brand awareness, audience engagement, and visibility of SCORE’s mentoring and educational resources.
  • Oversee national social media content planning, publishing, community engagement, and performance analysis across relevant platforms.
  • Establish national social media standards, best practices, and guidance that promote brand consistency, accessibility, and effective audience engagement.
  • Monitor platform performance, audience behavior, and emerging social media trends to inform content strategy and channel optimization.
  • Identify opportunities to amplify SCORE’s impact through success stories, mentor and volunteer spotlights, educational content, and integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Partner with the Field Marketing Manager to align national and chapter social media efforts, support consistent standards, and identify opportunities to amplify relevant local content.
  • Monitor social media practices and emerging platform considerations to help maintain effective, responsible, and consistent national digital engagement.

Digital Advertising & Audience Growth

  • Develop and manage national digital advertising strategies across relevant paid media channels to increase awareness, reach priority audiences, and drive engagement with SCORE resources.
  • Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital advertising campaigns based on established objectives, audience insights, and performance data.
  • Manage campaign targeting, budgets, creative testing, landing page alignment, and conversion tracking to improve effectiveness and cost efficiency.
  • Support integrated campaigns promoting SCORE mentoring, workshops, educational resources, volunteer opportunities, and fundraising initiatives.
  • Use audience insights and campaign results to identify opportunities to improve acquisition, engagement, and conversion.
  • Coordinate with the Field Marketing Manager on advertising guidance, resources, and approaches that may support chapter-level marketing efforts.

Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain reporting frameworks to measure the performance and impact of national digital marketing channels and campaigns.
  • Analyze data from email, social media, paid advertising, web analytics, and other relevant platforms to evaluate results and identify actionable insights.
  • Translate performance data into recommendations that improve audience engagement, campaign effectiveness, channel performance, and resource allocation.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and communicate results, trends, opportunities, and risks to the Senior Director, Marketing & Communications.
  • Ensure appropriate tracking, tagging, and measurement practices are implemented across digital campaigns in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders and vendors.
  • Use testing, experimentation, and ongoing optimization to improve digital marketing outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve reporting, and strengthen the use of data in marketing decisions.

Collaboration & Vendor Management

  • Collaborate with the Brand & Campaigns Manager, Communications Manager, Field Marketing Manager, and other stakeholders to execute integrated marketing initiatives and maintain a coordinated audience experience.
  • Partner with the Field Marketing Manager to clarify channel responsibilities, align national and chapter marketing practices, and provide guidance that helps chapters apply digital marketing best practices.
  • Manage digital marketing vendors, agencies, and contractors, including project requirements, deliverables, timelines, performance, and budgets.
  • Coordinate cross-functional digital marketing projects to ensure work is delivered efficiently, on schedule, and in alignment with organizational priorities.
  • Document processes, establish best practices, and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and collaboration.
  • Stay informed about digital marketing tools, technologies, and platform capabilities that may improve SCORE’s marketing effectiveness.

Revenue Growth, Lead Generation & Conversion

  • Develop and execute digital marketing strategies that support SCORE’s revenue-generation goals, including donor acquisition and retention, fundraising campaigns, workshop registrations, and other revenue-generating initiatives.
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Marketing & Communications and relevant organizational stakeholders to identify priority audiences, develop acquisition strategies, and move prospective supporters and customers through measurable conversion journeys.
  • Build and optimize digital campaigns, email journeys, landing pages, and calls to action that encourage audiences to take meaningful actions, including making donations, registering for workshops, and engaging with SCORE’s programs and initiatives.
  • Develop audience segmentation and nurturing strategies that strengthen relationships with prospective and existing donors, workshop participants, and other key audiences.
  • Use digital advertising, email marketing, marketing automation, and audience insights to identify opportunities to increase donor acquisition, repeat giving, workshop registrations, and other measurable revenue outcomes.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of revenue-focused campaigns by monitoring conversion rates, cost per acquisition, donation performance, registration volume, and return on advertising investment, as applicable.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the digital experience and reduce barriers to conversion across SCORE’s website, donation pages, registration experiences, and other digital touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to ensure digital marketing campaigns support broader fundraising, partnership, and organizational revenue priorities.
  • Approximately 10% travel.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of progressive experience in digital marketing, including responsibility for developing, executing, and optimizing digital marketing strategies and campaigns.
  • Proven ability to manage email marketing, social media, paid advertising, and digital analytics.
  • Proficiency with email marketing platforms and marketing automation, including audience segmentation, automated journeys, and campaign performance optimization.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to use web analytics and digital reporting tools to evaluate performance and inform strategic decisions.
  • Experience managing digital marketing vendors, agencies, or contractors.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating cross-functional marketing initiatives and balancing multiple projects and priorities.
  • Experience supporting a distributed organization, partner network, franchise system, or chapter-based structure, preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Excel) and Google Workspace

About SCORE: Since 1964, SCORE has helped more than 11 million entrepreneurs start or grow a business. SCORE's over 7,500 volunteers provide free, expert mentoring, workshops and educational services to 1,500+ communities in all 50 U.S. states and territories. Visit SCORE at www.score.org. Our national headquarters is located in Washington, D.C.

Salary: $98,555 - $102,000
