jobs.description:
Deputy Lead - Ongoing Care Team

Internal applications only — applicants must have been in their current role for a minimum of six months.

United Kingdom (Remote)

Reporting to: Team Lead – Ongoing Care Team

Remuneration: £61,000 per annum

plus £1,000 per annum - working from home allowance

Contract Type:Employed | Permanent | Full Time - 40 hours per week

Location:Home-based/various UK meeting locations as required

About Us:

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time or part-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference.

The Deputy Ongoing Care Lead plays an advanced clinical role in Psychiatry UK’s ADHD service, managing patient presentations and contributing to safe, high-quality prescribing practice. Reporting to the Team Lead and working closely with Consultant Psychiatrists, the role focuses on the independent or supplementary prescribing of ADHD medication and ongoing treatment of adult patients, in line with NICE guidelines and Psychiatry UK clinical policies.

Deputy Leads bring significant experience in ADHD management and apply a high level of clinical judgment in titration, risk management, and long-term prescribing. They support the wider team by contributing to multidisciplinary discussions, sharing expertise, and mentoring peers or new joiners to maintain consistency in clinical standards.

This is a home-based role (applicants must reside in the UK), though occasional travel may be required for face-to-face meetings at various locations within the UK.

As our Deputy Ongoing Care Lead, you will:

  • Provide safe, effective, and evidence-based prescribing for ADHD patients in accordance with national guidance and internal protocols.

  • Communicate with patients through Psychiatry UK’s secure portal, offering clear and clinically sound responses to medication queries.

  • Exercise independent or supplementary prescribing rights confidently, with appropriate use of professional boundaries and escalation when needed.

  • Participate in multidisciplinary discussions with Consultants, prescribers, and operational colleagues to support joined-up patient care.

  • Offer informal support or mentoring to less experienced prescribers, including case discussion, guidance, and shared learning.

  • Conduct regular risk assessments, monitor safeguarding concerns, and escalate according to Psychiatry UK’s procedures.

  • Keep accurate, timely clinical records in line with legal and professional standards.

  • Engage in audit, quality improvement, and clinical governance processes, particularly related to prescribing practice.

  • Stay current with ADHD-related legislation, clinical developments, and Psychiatry UK policies, and proactively engage in CPD.

  • Contribute to the refinement of prescribing and titration processes, drawing on practical experience and patient feedback.

To succeed as our Deputy Ongoing Care Lead, you will have:

Advanced prescribing skills and sound clinical judgment in ADHD medication management, strong knowledge of medication pathways including side effect management and treatment adjustments, excellent communication skills for delivering high-quality remote care, confidence in discussing complex clinical scenarios in MDT forums, a commitment to accurate documentation and patient confidentiality, awareness of safeguarding principles, and high digital literacy with proficiency in electronic patient records and secure messaging systems.

Essential Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Registered Nurses

First-level registered Mental Health nurse (RMN) or

First-level registered nurse (Adult Nurse/Children’s Nurse/Learning Disabilities Nurse) (with one year post qualification Secondary Mental Health service experience or further Mental Health qualification).

Must have Independent & Supplementary Non-Medical Prescribing (V300) qualification with minimum 4 years of clinical experience in ADHD prescribing roles (private or NHS), including titration, medication reviews, and long-term management of ADHD treatment.

Clinical experience in ADHD prescribing roles (private or NHS), including titration, medication reviews, and long-term management of ADHD treatment.

- or -

  • Pharmacists

Registered Pharmacist with Non-Medical Prescribing Qualification

Minimum 4 years post qualification secondary mental health service experience or further training or post prescribing qualification experience in Specialist ADHD service (Specialist ADHD experience can include working within private and/or NHS practice) or equivalent.

ADHD experience must include managing ADHD patients with prescribing responsibilities, including medication initiation, titration, review, and long-term management.

(Secondary mental health services are defined by there is a need for a GP referral to the service.  Secondary mental health experience includes inpatient care, community mental health teams, psychological wellbeing services, crisis resolution and home treatment teams, assertive outreach teams and early intervention teams)

Desirable Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Additional training or postgraduate qualifications in mental health, prescribing, or neurodevelopmental disorders.

  • Experience working with complex or treatment-resistant ADHD cases.

  • Experience in remote clinical service provision or digital healthcare environments.

Desirable Knowledge and Skills

  • Familiarity with clinical audit and quality improvement processes.

  • Experience using ADHD rating scales and validated clinical tools.

  • Comfort with working in a dynamic, technology-enabled clinical environment.

  • Ability to support the development of peers through knowledge-sharing and informal mentoring.

Psychiatry UK: Supporting You

We want you to enjoy your work while feeling healthy, happy, and appreciated. That’s why we’ve created a benefits package designed with you in mind. Company Overview:

Argano is the world’s largest global digital consultancy, exclusively connecting design and delivery for the transformation of high-performance business operations, extending our clients’ commercial agility, profitability, customer experience, and growth. Our strategic consulting, bolstered by proprietary IP, provides a comprehensive view of business operations, pinpointing areas of strength and unveiling opportunities for improvement. Argano is at the intersection of operations and technology for digital transformation.

JOB TITLE:

SAP IBP Director - Delivery

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director – Delivery, SAP IBP Practice Leader at Argano is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the growth, development, and successful delivery of SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) solutions across client engagements. We’re looking for a supply chain planning leader who can help clients turn complex, fragmented planning into a connected process that drives better decisions. You’ll design integrated planning that holds up under real-world volatility, and you’ll help move AI-enabled planning from pilot to practice.

What You’ll do:

  • Define and drive the vision, strategy, and growth of Argano’s SAP IBP practice, including delivery excellence, solution capabilities, and client success.
  • Design IBP/S&OP: Build and facilitate the full IBP cycle, including demand, supply, portfolio, and executive reviews. Integrate commercial, finance, product, and operations inputs, and design the governance and operating model that keeps those functions making decisions together.
  • Strengthen demand and supply planning: Build processes that account for key planning drivers such as new product launches, product phase-outs, promotions and seasonality, production yield variability, supplier and contract manufacturer lead times, and capacity constraints.
  • Connect plans to execution (S&OE): Turn IBP decisions into near-term plans covering production schedules, sequencing, supplier and contract manufacturer orders, and distribution.
  • Optimize inventory: Develop multi-echelon inventory strategies that balance service levels against working capital, obsolescence, and write-off risk.
  • Manage supply risk: Identify and mitigate risks such as supplier capacity constraints, material shortages, logistics disruptions, and single-source dependencies to protect supply continuity.
  • Measure what matters: Define and track KPIs such as OTIF, forecast accuracy, supplier on-time delivery, days on hand, and write-off rate. Turn that reporting into insight leaders can use for capacity, network, and supply strategy decisions.
  • Modernize planning with AI: Implement advanced analytics, digital twins, and generative and agentic AI planning use cases. Translate technical outputs into executive-ready recommendations that can scale.
  • Establish and promote adherence to Argano’s delivery methodologies, processes, and best practices specific to SAP IBP.
  • Drive successful delivery across a highly matrixed global delivery model, coordinating resources and collaborating across practices, geographies, and functional teams.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and helping clients maximize the value of their SAP IBP investments.
  • Ability to travel to client sites as needed to meet business and client requirements.

How you’ll work

  • Lead small-to-medium client teams with diverse skills and backgrounds, and coach and develop team members
  • Run workshops and analyses, including peer benchmarking, to diagnose problems and shape solutions
  • Choose the right approach for each engagement and constructively challenge legacy ways of working
  • Build trusted relationships with client executives and functional leaders across commercial, finance, supply chain, and operations
  • Own delivery outcomes so engagements achieve the client’s key goals
  • Contribute to business development and thought leadership
  • Support community impact initiatives in the places we work

MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field such as computer science, engineering, business, or a related discipline.
  • MBA, relevant master's degree, or PhD expected.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of experience in supply chain management, SAP implementation and delivery, or a related field, with a strong focus on SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).
  • 10+ years of experience leading delivery teams, managing client engagements, and overseeing complex technology implementations.
  • Deep understanding of supply chain planning processes and SAP IBP capabilities, including demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimization, and related planning solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience in leadership roles, including leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing consulting and delivery teams.
  • Proven experience overseeing complex SAP implementations and large-scale client engagements, from solution design through implementation and ongoing delivery.
  • Experience applying Agile development principles and methodologies, along with established project management and delivery best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex client accounts, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and identify opportunities for account growth.
  • Experience working within a global, matrixed delivery model, coordinating cross-functional teams and resources across geographies.
  • Strong communication, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executive stakeholders, clients, and internal teams.

SKILL REQUIREMENTS

  • Background in Supply Chain Management and SAP Implementation
  • Strategic Leadership: Expertise in strategic leadership, shaping the strategic direction of the delivery practice and aligning it with organizational objectives.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: At Fresh Prints, we work with thousands of customers, but not every customer should have the same experience with us.
jobs.description:
At Fresh Prints, we work with thousands of customers, but not every customer should have the same experience with us.

Some might be ordering for the first time. Others have been buying from us for years. Some need an occasional reminder or a well-timed offer, while others represent significant opportunities that deserve a much more personalized approach.

Today, we reach these customers through emails, SMS, automated journeys, promotional campaigns, gifting programs, and direct outreach. We've built much of the infrastructure to make these things possible, but there's a much bigger opportunity ahead of us: bringing all of these touchpoints together into a thoughtful, cohesive strategy for how we grow our customer relationships.

That's what we're hiring a Growth Strategist to do.

Your job is to understand our customers, figure out what they need at different stages of their relationship with Fresh Prints, and build experiences that make them want to engage, purchase, return, and grow with us.

For some customers, that might mean a great email at exactly the right moment. For others, it might mean an entirely different experience, with personalized outreach, exclusive offers, samples, or programs designed around their long-term potential.

We don't want someone who thinks about growth as a collection of campaigns or channels. We want someone who can see the bigger picture, identify where the opportunities are, and turn those opportunities into programs that drive meaningful business results.

This isn't a role where you inherit a finished playbook. You'll have the freedom, and responsibility, to question how we do things today, build better systems, and shape what customer growth looks like at Fresh Prints.

This role is about:

  • Understanding our customers deeply: Who they are, what they care about, why they buy, what brings them back, and what makes them disengage.
  • Designing the right experience for different customers: Knowing when automation and great content are enough, and when a relationship deserves a more personalized, high-touch approach.
  • Finding opportunities to grow customer value: Identifying where we're losing customers, leaving revenue on the table, or missing opportunities to build stronger relationships.
  • Being a great marketer: Understanding what makes someone open an email, click a link, respond to an offer, or take the next step, and being able to create that experience yourself.
  • Turning ideas into execution: Building programs, writing compelling content, coordinating teams, testing approaches, and taking ownership of the results.
  • Building systems that scale: Using data, technology, AI, and automation to create experiences that become smarter and more effective over time.

What You'll Own

Understanding Customers & Finding Growth Opportunities

  • Develop a deep understanding of Fresh Prints' customers, their buying behavior, motivations, needs, and decision-making journeys.
  • Use customer insights, data, and commercial judgment to identify the biggest opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, and customer value.
  • Build meaningful customer segments based on behavior, lifecycle stage, value, and growth potential, rather than treating everyone on our list the same way.
  • Identify where different customers need different experiences, and determine where we should invest more time, effort, and resources.
  • Continuously question our existing approach and develop new ideas that could materially change how customers engage and grow with Fresh Prints.

Building Experiences That Drive Growth

  • Own how Fresh Prints engages with customers throughout their relationship with us, from their first interaction to becoming loyal, repeat customers.
  • Develop thoughtful customer journeys that bring together content, communication, offers, personalization, and outreach to move customers toward the next meaningful action.
  • Own the strategy, messaging, and execution of customer communications across email, SMS, automated journeys, and promotional programs.
  • Build experiences around key customer moments, including onboarding, first purchases, post-purchase engagement, repeat purchases, reactivation, and win-back.
  • Develop more personalized approaches for our highest-value customers, including targeted campaigns, gifting, exclusive programs, and coordinated outreach with account-facing teams.
  • Create compelling content that customers actually want to engage with, from subject lines and SMS messages to promotional concepts and personalized pitches.
  • Work closely with Brand and Creative to make sure everything we put in front of customers feels relevant, engaging, and distinctly Fresh Prints.

Turning Strategy Into Results

  • Take ideas from insight to execution. You'll be expected to develop the strategy, build the plan, and make sure it actually happens.
  • Own performance across the experiences and programs you build, using engagement, conversion, retention, repeat purchase behavior, revenue, and customer value to measure success.
  • Develop a disciplined approach to experimentation, constantly testing messaging, offers, timing, audience selection, and customer experiences.
  • Look beyond surface-level metrics to understand what's actually driving performance and what needs to change.
  • Use our marketing technology, customer data, automation platforms, and AI tools to build and improve programs efficiently.
  • Maintain strong execution standards across customer communications, including segmentation accuracy, deliverability, list health, testing, and quality control.
  • Build processes, playbooks, and systems that allow successful programs to scale without requiring constant manual intervention.

Making Growth a Company-Wide Effort

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Creative, Data, Tech, and Operations to turn customer insights and growth opportunities into coordinated action.
  • Influence how different teams engage with customers when changes are needed to improve retention, expansion, or the overall customer experience.
  • Bring a clear point of view on where we should focus, what we should test, and what we should stop doing.
  • Make the business case for new initiatives, align stakeholders, and drive execution even when the people involved don't report to you.
  • Help build a more connected approach to customer growth, where every interaction contributes to a stronger long-term relationship.

Who You Are

  • You're a marketer first. You understand people, what motivates them, and how to turn that understanding into messaging and experiences that drive action. You can write a great subject line as comfortably as you can design a customer growth strategy.
  • You think in customer journeys, not marketing channels. You don't see email, SMS, or account-based programs as separate worlds. You see different ways to engage different customers based on what they need and what they're worth to the business.
  • You're commercially minded. You understand that engagement is a means to an end. You're constantly thinking about how your work influences purchases, retention, revenue, and long-term customer value.
  • You're both strategic and hands-on. You enjoy figuring out the big picture, but you're equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to write the copy, build a journey, launch a test, or troubleshoot a problem.
  • You're curious about customers. You don't assume you know what people want. You ask questions, study behavior, challenge assumptions, and use what you learn to build better experiences.
  • You think in systems. Rather than solving the same problem every month with another campaign, you look for ways to build something that will keep working and improving.
  • You have strong ownership. You don't need someone else to constantly set priorities or check the quality of your work. You hold yourself accountable for both the thinking and the execution.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You don't need a detailed playbook to get started. You can take an unclear opportunity, develop a strong point of view, and create a path forward.
  • You know how to bring people along. You can challenge ideas, communicate clearly, and work across teams to get things done without relying on formal authority.

Requirements

  • At least 4+ years proven experience in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, customer growth, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated experience owning marketing initiatives end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and developing strategy to execution and performance analysis.
  • Strong marketing instincts and writing ability, with experience creating messaging, campaigns, or customer experiences that drive measurable action.
  • Experience working with customer segmentation, behavioral data, and lifecycle journeys.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to understand customer behavior, evaluate performance, and make decisions.
  • Experience improving conversion, customer engagement, repeat purchases, retention, or revenue through marketing initiatives.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and independently drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Experience with SMS, account-based marketing, loyalty programs, or high-value customer engagement is a plus.
  • Experience in B2C, DTC, e-commerce, or businesses with repeat-purchase behavior is strongly preferred.

Above all, we're looking for someone who combines great marketing instincts with strong strategic thinking and the ability to execute. Someone who can look at how we engage with customers today, see what we could be doing better, and take ownership of making it happen.

Job Location: Work From Home

Working Hours: 3:00 AM - 12:00 PM EST, Monday to Friday

Monthly Salary: Competitive monthly salary based on experience

jobs.description:
Are you excited to identify new vulnerabilities or design secure systems?

Do you enjoy collaborating with developers, engineers, and architects, impacting products touching life online for billions of users?

Join Our ZeroTrust Security Team

Collaborating with Development, Product, Support, and Sales Engineering teams, the focus is on delivering secure, high-quality products. Efforts aim to strengthen product security features and provide comprehensive protection for customers.

Shape Internet Security

Responsibilities include coordinating with diverse teams to integrate security measures into enterprise application design and development. The position encompasses design, development, leadership, and collaboration within a global team environment.

As a Principal Software Engineer Lead, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing and implementing secure network solutions for products, collaborating with stakeholders to transform requirements into functional designs.
  • Establishing and upholding security standards, procedures, and guidelines consistently applied across the entire product portfolio.
  • Assessing and recommending network and security technologies aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborating with audit, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing teams to prioritize and address identified findings effectively.
  • Identifying network and security risks in existing architecture and implementation, while ensuring appropriate solutions are effectively implemented.
  • Reviewing code in C, C++, Python, and Go while establishing standards and processes to enhance secure-coding quality effectively.
  • Guiding and mentoring a team of engineers delivering innovative user access solutions while staying updated on networking, security, and cloud advancements.
  • Keeping up with the latest trends and advancements in networking, security, and cloud technologies while ensuring continuous professional development.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have 12+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
  • Demonstrate expertise in networking protocolsTCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLANswith proven experience designing and deploying secure network infrastructures.
  • Demonstrate expertise in VPN software, virtual appliances, hypervisors, cloud platforms, and identity and access management protocols and tools.
  • Demonstrate expertise in security standards, frameworks, and best practices, with familiarity in NIST standards and FedRAMP compliance knowledge.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in programming languages like C, C++, Python, or Go, focusing on implementing and adhering to secure coding practices.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of developing on-premises and cloud-based appliances while addressing associated security challenges effectively.
  • Solve intricate network and security challenges with expertise while utilizing analytical skills to effectively address and resolve technical issues.
  • Demonstrate excellent communication and interpersonal skills while adapting to changing priorities and collaborating effectively across diverse teams.

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Position Summary:

Cherokee Strategic Solutions is seeking a Records Technician / FOIA Analyst to provide support for the processing of Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and Privacy Act (PA) requests. You will help reduce the request backlog and improve response times by reviewing records, verifying requester entitlement, preparing responses, and submitting completed work to government staff for approval.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Records Technician / FOIA Analyst: $25/hour Expected hours 20-29 hours a week.

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • 401(k) plan with up to a 6% company match

  • Paid holidays (eligibility based on scheduled hours)

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Professional development, training, and certification support

  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

•Access pre-scanned records responsive to FOIA and PA requests.

•Verify requester entitlement and the accuracy of names, addresses, and other identifying information.

•Determine whether a request falls under FOIA or the PA.

•Confirm that responsive records match the request and the correct subject.

•Review case discussions, supporting documents, requester documents, and consent, when applicable.

•Identify information requiring redaction and apply appropriate exemptions.

•Prepare responses and submit them electronically to government staff for approval.

•Update case notes and follow applicable handling instructions, including restrictions on producing CDs for correctional facilities.

•Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications:

•High school diploma and at least one year of college coursework or one year of experience working with legal documents in a government or private law office.

•At least six months of on-the-job experience using a computer terminal.

•One to three years of experience in records management or document control, including manual and automated information systems.

•Ability to identify different types of legal documents and understand their purpose.

•Ability to create and maintain systems for tracking work assignments.

•Strong English reading, writing, speaking, and comprehension skills, plus proficient typing ability.

•Sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

•Strong interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to troubleshoot minor computer issues.

•This position requires an active Public Trust clearance or the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance to be considered.

•Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about for extended periods.

•Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

•Experience processing FOIA requests, particularly for USCIS.

Job Summary (Basic Function)

The Associate Director, Technology Product Management for Medi-Span has two connected areas of accountability: owning product strategy for the North America Commercial market and leading strategy and roadmap direction for assigned product areas. These areas currently include solutions that support drug pricing and market access, supply chain and regulatory information, dispensing and pharmacy workflows, and patient-facing medication information.

This leader is the primary Medi-Span Product partner for Commercial Sales opportunities and turns customer, market, competitive, regulatory, and product-performance evidence into clear priorities and investment decisions. The role balances growth with customer commitments, security, modernization, regulatory needs, and ongoing product health, while ensuring priority work moves from discovery through launch, adoption, and measurable results.

The role leads Product professionals and works closely with Engineering, Design, Content, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Customer Support, Systems Implementation, and other Product leaders. Success requires sound judgment, strong commercial healthcare knowledge, and the ability to align teams around customer problems and sustainable business value. This leader also leads adoption of AI-enabled ways of working and the Agentic Product Development Life Cycle across their product areas.

Wolters Kluwer Health is an established, fast-growing, and innovation-driven healthcare information technology company that delivers trusted clinical technology and evidence-based solutions to support decision-making and improve outcomes across the healthcare ecosystem. Our flagship products include UpToDate, UpToDate Lexidrug, UpToDate Patient Engagement, and Medi-Span.

what you’ll be accountable for

Understand the Customer:


  • Own and continually refine the Medi-Span strategy for the North America Commercial market. Use customer needs, market trends, competitive intelligence, product performance, and business goals to identify growth, retention, and portfolio opportunities.
  • Ensure product decisions are supported by meaningful customer and market evidence. Define the problem, target customer, desired outcome, scope boundaries, and measures of success, and validate value before expanding scope.

Make Better Decisions:


  • Use customer evidence, experimentation, product telemetry, and business performance to make clear product and investment decisions that improve adoption, retention, customer value, and business outcomes. Help teams identify assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, and adjust direction as new evidence emerges.
  • Own strategy and roadmap direction for assigned product areas. Translate product-line strategy into priorities and make trade-offs across growth, customer commitments, regulatory and standards-driven work, security, modernization, technical debt, and ongoing product health.

Build Valuable Products:


  • Oversee progress and outcomes from discovery through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement. Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, and Content to establish accountability, evaluate feasibility, manage dependencies and risks, and remove barriers.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Customer Success, and Systems Implementation to define target buyers, use cases, value, positioning, packaging, launch readiness, adoption plans, and sales enablement for existing and new solutions.
  • Define and monitor measurable outcomes for assigned market and product responsibilities, including revenue contribution, retention, adoption, customer value, roadmap progress, product health, and launch results.
  • Ensure teams validate customer value, competitive differentiation, and willingness to pay before scaling investment, then use adoption, usage, retention, expansion, and financial performance to improve results after launch. Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Finance on commercialization, forecasts, and corrective action when outcomes fall short.
  • Scale AI-enabled ways of working and Agentic PDLC practices across Medi-Span North America Commercial product areas, using AI to accelerate discovery, synthesis, prototyping, and execution while remaining accountable for product decisions and outcomes.
  • Work with Customer Success, Customer Support, and Systems Implementation to create a coherent customer experience across product, onboarding, training, support, adoption, and ongoing value realization rather than a series of handoffs.

Lead Across Boundaries:


  • Serve as the primary Medi-Span Product partner for Commercial Sales opportunities. Provide product guidance, participate in customer conversations, connect opportunities to the right experts, and set clear expectations about fit, priorities, and timing.

Grow People & Capability:


  • Lead, coach, and develop Product team members through clear expectations, regular feedback, career support, and meaningful growth assignments. Build a culture of accountability, trust, shared ownership, and continuous learning.
  • Raise the bar for customer understanding, product judgment, experimentation, product craft, and AI-enabled practice across the team.

Other Duties

Other Duties:


  • Represent assigned market and product responsibilities in product-line strategy, governance, investment, and industry discussions.
  • Build shared understanding of customers, markets, competitors, and products through internal education and clear strategic communication.
  • Other duties as assigned by manager.

Job Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, healthcare, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, required.

Required Experience:


  • 10+ years of progressive experience with healthcare technology, data, or software products, including product leadership responsibilities.
  • 5+ years of hands-on product management experience leading B2B solutions from market discovery and validation through launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Demonstrated success owning product or portfolio strategy and making roadmap trade-offs across growth, customer needs, regulatory requirements, security, modernization, and product health.
  • Experience partnering directly with Sales and go-to-market teams to support customer opportunities, product positioning, enablement, and launch readiness in commercial healthcare markets.
  • 3+ years of direct people management experience, including hiring, goal setting, coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across Product, Engineering, Design, Content, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Customer Support, Systems Implementation, and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate customer understanding, insight synthesis, experimentation, and product execution while maintaining strong human judgment.
  • Experience using customer evidence, experimentation, and product telemetry to guide product decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Experience building, launching, or scaling AI-enabled products, capabilities, or agents and integrating AI into product-development practices.

Preferred Experience:


  • Experience with healthcare embedded data and embedded data workflows.
  • Proficiency with product-development and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, and visual collaboration tools.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:


  • Ability to guide teams in selecting appropriate customer-research methods, evaluating evidence quality, and synthesizing insight across a product domain.
  • Strong strategic, commercial, and financial acumen, including product strategy, monetization, forecasting, prioritization, and investment decisions across a product domain.
  • Working fluency in AI-enabled product development and the use of AI to accelerate learning, decision-making, and execution.
  • Ability to lead product outcomes in a complex, matrixed organization by aligning cross-functional teams, resolving dependencies, and influencing decisions without direct authority.

If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about healthcare technology and product leadership, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences and perspectives.


What We Value in This Role:

  • Strategic Thinking: You see patterns, anticipate change, and turn complex information into a clear direction that connects customer value and business goals.
  • Sound Judgment: You make timely, well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information, distinguish what matters most, and adjust when new evidence emerges.
  • Accountability for Results: You create clarity about outcomes, ownership, and follow-through and stay engaged until the intended value is achieved.
  • Collaborative Influence: You build trust, listen to different perspectives, communicate clearly, and align people across functions without relying on authority.
  • People Development: You set clear expectations, provide direct and constructive feedback, develop talent, and create an environment where people can take ownership and grow.

Trave

This role includes up to 20% travel, typically amounting to one trip per month (2–3 days each) for customer engagement or team collaboration. Occasional international travel may be required 1–2 times per year, generally for about a week. We strive to keep travel purposeful and balanced with flexibility.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

$133,400.00 - $238,400.00 USDThis role is eligible for Bonus.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. jobs.description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at .

As a Senior Database Engineer at Bitwarden you will work with our Engineering teams to lead the design, development, and continual tuning and maintenance of our database systems. You will serve as a technical leader for database query design and the optimization of our existing queries, scripts, and programs. You will support the software development process and contribute directly to the culture of quality within Bitwarden through process improvements, team outreach, and mentoring. To ensure success as a Senior Database Engineer, you should exhibit knowledge of best practices in database management and experience in a similar role. A top-notch Senior Database Engineer will be someone whose database management skills translate into the efficient flow of information throughout an organization.

This is an all-remote team and we are looking for someone located in the U.S. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain and enhance the performance of existing database scripts, queries, and other database objects
  • Assist engineering teams in designing new database implementations that meet the organization's data security, storage, and performance needs
  • Tune existing database scripts and queries for optimal performance and data security
  • Establish database observability practices and monitor databases and related systems to ensure optimized performance alongside operations staff
  • Partner with other engineers to develop new scripts and queries that support company growth
  • Review database and user reports as well as system information
  • Perform debugging procedures on database scripts and systems, including as a part of incident response
  • Mentor engineers and provide them with technical support
  • Adhere to best practices in securely accessing, storing, backing up, and archiving data
  • Document processes related to database design, configuration, and performance
  • Keep abreast of developments and best practices in database engineering
  • Participate in code reviews and learn and spread technical knowledge amongst the engineering organization

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

Must haves:

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL: execution plans, indexing, locking and blocking, and query tuning on very large tables
  • Experience reviewing other engineers’ database code (schema changes, stored procedures, queries, migrations) and giving clear, constructive feedback that developers act on
  • Experience making schema changes safely on live systems: backward-compatible migrations, zero-downtime deployments, and knowing which changes block
  • Experience operating a large, busy cloud-hosted database in production (Azure SQL preferred; equivalent experience on another managed platform is welcome)
  • Ability to diagnose performance problems with evidence, using tools such as Query Store, execution plans, and wait and blocking analysis
  • Excellent problem-solving skills: you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining database findings to developers, SRE and support
  • Proficiency using source control and working through pull requests
  • Around 5 years of experience in database engineering, or equivalent depth on a large production system

Good to have:

  • Ability to read and review C# data-access code (.NET, Dapper, Entity Framework migrations)
  • Working knowledge of at least one other RDBMS, such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
  • Experience with observability tooling, such as Datadog and a telemetry query language like KQL
  • Scripting for automation in PowerShell or Python
  • Experience with production incident response and carrying out data fixes under a controlled process
  • Familiarity with Docker for local and test environments
  • Sound practice in data security: least-privilege access and safe handling of production data and secrets

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Meeting with Talent Acquisition
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager
  • Interview with fellow database engineers

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.

Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

The Manager, Implementation Enablement serves as the Operations implementation lead within the Product-Technology-Operations (TPO) operating model. The role leads the Operations portion of implementation delivery across aggregator activation, client onboarding, system enhancements, operational initiatives, and cross-functional business change. The manager converts approved business needs into executable plans and ensures Operations requirements, business validation, operational readiness, rollout coordination, governance, and transition activities are completed.

The role directly leads and develops the Applications Analyst function. It coordinates delivery across teams but does not replace Product, Engineering, Client Success, Channel Relationship, or functional business ownership.

What You Will Do

  • Implementation work moves from accepted scope through launch with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, decisions, and risks.
  • Operations requirements and acceptance criteria are complete, testable, and understood by Product and Technology partners.
  • Business validation and production validation provide reliable evidence of operational readiness.
  • Applications Analysts receive role-relevant coaching, standards, workload direction, and career development.
  • Launches transition into supported steady-state operations with defined ownership, documentation, monitoring, reporting, and escalation paths.
  • Establish and continually improve implementation standards, processes, and governance to support consistent and scalable delivery across partners, onboarding initiatives, and operational changes.
  • Lead planning and execution for aggregator activations, onboarding changes, system enhancements, releases, and major operational initiatives.
  • Create and maintain scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, decisions, risks, target dates, success measures, and implementation status.
  • Maintain risk, dependency, decision, action, and blocker registers; drive follow-up and escalate when leadership action is required.
  • Prepare executive-ready implementation updates and conduct post-implementation outcome reviews and lessons learned.
  • Establish, standardize, and continuously improve implementation processes, governance models, readiness criteria, and operational handoff frameworks to support scalable growth.
  • Directly manage Senior Applications Analyst and Applications Analyst.
  • Set priorities and capacity plans across onboarding, configuration, requirements, testing, production validation, release support, and improvement work.
  • Establish analyst standards for requirements, test evidence, process documentation, configuration validation, meeting notes, and implementation tracking.
  • Create development plans and coach analysts in business analysis, testing, facilitation, process design, implementation delivery, and technical-to-business translation.
  • Lead discovery and translate business needs into process flows, user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and operational impact assessments.
  • Assign and review analyst-produced requirements before Product or Technology evaluation.
  • Assess client, provider, workflow, support, reporting, configuration, and cross-client impacts.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering while preserving their ownership of product decisions and technical design.
  • Coordinate Operations business validation and client-lens scenarios.
  • Ensure detailed functional testing is completed by appropriate business owners and subject-matter experts.
  • Coordinate defect evidence, retesting, production validation, and readiness impact tracking.

  • Ensure relationship owners receive a complete handoff for ongoing partner or client management.

What You Need to Succeed

Do you crave a career that truly makes an impact in people’s lives? Do you thrive on leading complex, mission-critical programs and building high-performing teams? Join Leidos QTC Health Services and help lead a program that directly supports the wellbeing of military families every day.

Leidos QTC Health Services is seeking a Clinical Operations Data Analyst to support contract operations, dashboards, recurring reporting, ad hoc analysis, data integrity, and stakeholder support across programs and business functions. In this role, you will provide analytical, reporting, and operational support across multiple contracts and initiatives, with emphasis on Military OneSource, NAVAHCS, and other rural health care programs. This role gathers, validates, analyzes, and translates data into actionable insights that support program execution, performance management, and decision-making.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Cross-Contract Data Analysis and Reporting
    • Collect, validate, analyze, and report operational, clinical operations, provider network, utilization, and performance data across multiple contracts and initiatives
    • Compile and extract data from multiple systems and sources to support recurring, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reporting
    • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, and other reporting tools used by program teams and leadership

    • Support Northern Arizona VA Health Care System and other rural health care initiatives through recurring reporting, operational analysis, and ad hoc analytics

Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our FP&A team. Reporting to the Finance Manager, FP&A, you’ll primarily own financial tracking and analysis for our hardware programs and R&D functions, working closely with Program Managers and R&D leadership. You’ll build and maintain program-level P&Ls and investment frameworks that inform strategic priorities, track budget vs. actuals, and surface cost variances in real time. You’ll also manage headcount forecasts and spend, support month-end close in partnership with Accounting, and contribute to key deliverables, such as Monthly Financial Results presentations and Board materials.

What You Will Do:

  • Help evolve tracking of program-level financials, partnering with Program Managers to track budget vs. actuals on active programs and surfacing cost variances in real time
  • Build and maintain program-level P&Ls and investment frameworks to evaluate whether hardware/R&D programs clear investment hurdles and inform go/no-go decisions
  • Own monthly financial file updates for each assigned R&D function, identifying and explaining cost variances
  • Review and approve purchase orders for assigned functions, ensuring spend is coded correctly and aligns with approved budgets
  • Partner with business leaders to manage the headcount forecast for owned R&D functions, tracking departmental headcount changes and ensuring managers are hiring according to the approved plan
  • Support the month-end close process, partnering closely with Accounting on accuracy of program and functional financials, and provide variance commentary vs. plan/forecast
  • Support the preparation of key monthly and quarterly deliverables, including Monthly Financial Results presentations, Board meeting materials, and function and program-specific reviews
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate program and R&D financial reporting processes (e.g., templates, dashboards), enhancing efficiency and accuracy across monthly and quarterly deliverables
  • Drive best practices in reporting and data utilization across the Program Management and R&D finance workflows.
  • Prepare other ad hoc analysis and modeling as needed

This is a remote role open to candidates across the US, with a slight preference for those based in the Pacific time zone.

What you'll bring

  • 4-6 years of relevant finance experience, experience partnering with Product facing teams is a plus
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, working with planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Pigment) preferred
  • Established experience in FP&A or a similar analytical finance role, strong Accounting foundation, and a familiarity with annual planning, forecasting, and reporting
  • Exceptional attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and precision of financial data and resolving discrepancies effectively
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and experience communicating with or presenting to people at all levels of the organization with varying levels of financial literacy, including Program Managers and R&D leadership
  • A self-starter attitude, with a demonstrated ability to operate well with ambiguity and build things from scratch
  • Ability to learn and adapt quickly to new systems and tools
  • High integrity, intellectual curiosity, self awareness, and a self starter attitude

Nice to have:

  • Experience in an opex-focused FP&A role
  • Big 4 experience (e.g., Deloitte, EY, PwC, KPMG)
  • Familiarity with hardware build process, especially through a consumer health/wearables or tech lens

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis Operations is looking for a Principal OSINT & Investigations Analyst to deliver Digital Intelligence managed services for Orbis clients, including social media narrative and sentiment analysis, open-source research, and investigative due diligence. You will track narratives, measure sentiment, map networks, and research the people and organizations behind them, then turn what you find into finished intelligence with clear sourcing, stated confidence, and actionable conclusions. You will also lead, train, and mentor analysts, raising the standard of tradecraft across the team.

Travel: Up to 20% international travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver Digital Intelligence managed services — Run recurring and on-demand social media, OSINT, and investigative production for Orbis clients, owning the cycle from requirements through dissemination, with up to 20% international travel.
  • Analyze social media narratives — Track narratives, influence activity, and network behavior across platforms and languages in real time. Identify who is driving a narrative, how it spreads, and where it is headed.
  • Assess sentiment — Measure how audiences on social media and other publicly available sources react to clients, issues, and events. Explain what is driving shifts, not just that they happened.
  • Lead investigative research — Conduct financial, fraud, and due diligence research on individuals, companies, and counterparties using government, commercial, and open-source resources. Identify assets, ownership, and undisclosed relationships.
  • Produce finished intelligence — Write narrative and sentiment assessments, analytical reports, target packages, and link analyses with transparent sourcing, stated confidence levels, and actionable conclusions that hold up under review.
  • Map networks and influence — Build link and network analyses that connect online communities, key influencers, people, organizations, and assets across sources, surfacing relationships that aren't obvious from single-platform or single-source views.
  • Develop and deliver training — Design and teach curricula on OSINT, social media analysis, investigative research, and analytic tradecraft for analysts at varying skill levels.
  • Lead and mentor analysts — Serve as a team lead. Coach analysts on tradecraft, source evaluation, and production standards, and review their work to raise the floor across the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of professional experience in open-source intelligence, supply chain, due diligence analysis, social media analysis, investigative analysis, or a closely related intelligence discipline
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Demonstrated expertise in social media narrative and sentiment analysis and in investigative research using government, commercial, and open-source data, including financial, fraud, and due diligence research
  • Proficiency with social media monitoring and analytics platforms and with link and network analysis tools
  • Experience producing finished intelligence products, target packages, and link analyses with proper sourcing, confidence statements, and analytic rigor
  • Strong understanding of operational security (OPSEC) principles as applied to online research, including managed attribution and browser isolation
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance
  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, and training analysts
  • Ability to travel internationally up to 20%

Desired Qualifications

  • TS/SCI preferred
  • Formal intelligence analysis or OSINT.
  • Ability to leverage large language models in support of OSINT and investigative research and collaborate with product development teams
  • Experience with commercially available data sources used for geospatial, maritime, ADTECH analysis in support of open-source investigations
  • Knowledge of influence operations, information warfare tactics, and computational propaganda methods
  • Familiarity with intelligence community standards, analytic frameworks, and structured analytic techniques (SATs)
  • Understanding of legal and ethical frameworks governing open-source collection, including privacy regulations and platform terms of service
  • Experience delivering recurring intelligence products or managed services to government or commercial clients
  • Experience supporting federal law enforcement, Inspector General, Intelligence Community, or DoD missions
  • Experience with proposal development or capture management
  • Professional proficiency in one or more foreign languages relevant to areas of operational interest

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
  • Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
  • Ability to travel internationally for extended periods, including long-haul flights

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer (all genders) – Cisco & Fortinet
jobs.excerpt: Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT.
jobs.description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group steht die Braintower Technologies für innovative IT-Security- und Netzwerklösungen, sichere Business-Kommunikation sowie ganzheitliche Managed Services – von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Zur Verstärkung unseres 15-köpfigen, deutschlandweit verteilten Netzwerk-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Planung, Implementierung und Optimierung komplexer Netzwerkinfrastrukturen bei unseren Kund:innen

  • Eigenständige Umsetzung von Netzwerkprojekten, beispielsweise bei der Modernisierung von Netzwerkkomponenten, Optimierung von VPN-Verbindungen oder Erweiterung von Managed Services

  • Analyse und Behebung komplexer Netzwerk- und IT-Störungen durch strukturiertes Troubleshooting und nachhaltige Lösungsansätze

  • Sicherstellung eines stabilen Netzwerkbetriebs sowie schnelle Unterstützung bei kritischen Störungen und technischen Herausforderungen

  • Technische Beratung unserer Kund:innen zur Weiterentwicklung ihrer IT-Infrastruktur, inklusive Analyse bestehender Umgebungen und Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen IT-Teams und Administrator:innen als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Kund:innen und verschiedenen Fachbereichen

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung technischer Dokumentationen sowie Einbringen eigener Ideen zur Optimierung von Netzwerklösungen und internen Prozessen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst langjährige Erfahrung im Network Engineering mit und kennst dich mit der Implementierung, Administration und dem Betrieb komplexer Datacenter-Netzwerke aus

  • Du hast bereits Netzwerkprojekte eigenständig umgesetzt und überzeugst durch fundierte Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerk- und IT-Störungen

  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Cisco ACI und hast idealerweise eine gültige Cisco CCNP-Zertifizierung

  • Du besitzt eine gültige Fortinet NSE 4-Zertifizierung und hast praktische Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Administration von Firewalls, beispielsweise von Fortinet oder Palo Alto

  • Du arbeitest proaktiv, eigenständig und lösungsorientiert, überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung und entwickelst dein Fachwissen gerne kontinuierlich weiter

  • Du bringst idealerweise weitere Zertifizierungen in Cisco ACI, Fortinet (NSE 5 oder höher), Palo Alto oder LANCOM sowie Erfahrung mit Kund:innen aus regulierten Branchen mit

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

jobs.excerpt: About Revaly Revaly is the payment performance platform that helps businesses understand, improve, and capture more of the revenue they've already earned, from first attempt through recovery.
jobs.description:
About Revaly

Revaly is the payment performance platform that helps businesses understand, improve, and capture more of the revenue they've already earned, from first attempt through recovery. What you earn, you keep.

Our platform helps performance-driven businesses turn failed or at-risk payments into approved revenue, using intelligence drawn from across the payment ecosystem to make approvals work smarter.

Now, we're scaling and we're looking for a Demand Generation Manager.

About the Role

As Demand Generation Manager, you'll be the engine behind Revaly's ambitious inbound target, owning our demand engine end to end: the paid channels, the website and landing pages that convert, and the HubSpot automation and reporting that turn traffic into pipeline. Reporting to our Director of Marketing, who owns overall go-to-market strategy, brand, and positioning, you'll own execution and results. You build the pages, run the tests, own the number, and tell us with data what to scale and what to cut. Your focus: turning traffic into qualified pipeline and proving it with clean numbers every week.

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates eligible to work in Canada only. This is an active vacancy.

Salary Range: $95,000–$125,000 CAD annually. The final offer will be determined based on the successful candidate's experience, skills, location, and overall fit for the role.

What You'll Be Doing

Paid Acquisition, Programs and Content

  • Own the inbound lead and sourced pipeline targets. Forecast, pace, and report on them weekly.
  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Meta Ads, from audiences and creative testing to bidding and budget pacing.
  • Keep testing new channels and formats, then move spend to whatever actually produces pipeline.
  • Run the webinar program end to end in Livestorm: setup, promotion, registration, follow-up, and pipeline reporting.
  • Plan and run the content program that fuels demand (ebooks, blogs, and newsletters) and build it into email nurture and campaigns.

Website and Conversion

  • Lead a full revamp of our website and landing pages in Webflow and Base44. Build, ship, and iterate them yourself, without waiting on developers.
  • Run a structured conversion and A/B testing program, from hypothesis to rollout.
  • Own SEO and answer engine optimization (AEO). Improve how Revaly ranks in search and shows up in Google AI Overviews and LLM-generated answers, through site structure, metadata, schema, and content built to be cited.

HubSpot and Lead Management

  • Be our marketing operations function. Build and maintain HubSpot workflows, automation, forms, lists, nurture, and lifecycle flows.
  • Own lead scoring, routing, and the handoff to Sales in Salesforce, including follow-up SLAs and data hygiene.
  • Keep email compliant: consent, opt-outs, and suppression.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Own tracking and attribution from first touch to closed revenue using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Fibbler, and HubSpot and Salesforce reporting, including LinkedIn's account-level pipeline impact.
  • Deliver a weekly performance review and a monthly pipeline readout with clear recommendations.

Across All of It

  • Use Claude every day to research, write and test copy, analyze performance, and build pages and workflows faster.
  • Document your work in Confluence and collaborate across the team in Microsoft 365.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years in B2B demand generation or performance marketing, with 4+ in SaaS or fintech.
  • A track record of owning an inbound lead or pipeline target and hitting it. You can tell us the number, how you got there, and what you cut along the way.
  • Hands-on experience managing paid budgets in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
  • You've revamped a website or landing pages yourself in Webflow or an AI builder like Base44. You're not a developer, but you're at home with layouts, CMS, forms, and tracking.
  • Deep HubSpot experience building workflows, scoring, and lifecycle automation without a marketing ops team behind you.
  • Proven CRO and A/B testing results, plus strong analytics skills.
  • Experience running SEO and AEO and content programs (ebooks, blogs, and newsletters) that drive qualified traffic and pipeline.
  • Hands-on experience using AI and LLMs in your daily work, ideally Claude, to move faster and test more.
  • Bonus points: experience marketing payments, fintech, or subscription businesses; account-based campaigns on LinkedIn; and design skills in Figma for page mockups and ad creative.
  • Clear, direct communication, high ownership, and a bias to action.

What Success Looks Like

  • Day 30: You've audited every channel, the website, HubSpot, tracking, and routing, set a funnel baseline, and shared a priorities memo.
  • Day 60: The biggest conversion and tracking leaks are fixed, and your first rebuilt landing pages and tests are live.
  • Day 90: You're running the weekly pipeline forecast and can show a measurable lift in conversion rate or cost per qualified lead.
  • 6 months: The website revamp is shipped, a steady A/B testing rhythm is producing documented wins, and lead scoring, routing, and Sales handoff SLAs are running cleanly between HubSpot and Salesforce.
  • 12 months: Marketing-sourced pipeline and inbound qualified leads are hitting target, with measurable improvement against your baseline in website conversion rate, cost per qualified opportunity, and lead-to-opportunity conversion. Attribution is trusted from first touch to closed revenue.

Why Revaly

We're a growing global company committed to building a team filled with diverse cultures, viewpoints, and experiences. As they say, variety is the spice of life. No matter how large we become, we will always be connected through our shared sense of community and slightly quirky personalities.

Our vibrant culture is filled with talented, creative, deeply curious, high achievers. We believe in and invest in our people because we know they are the secret to our success. We are happy to extend the following benefits to our employees:

  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 100% remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • Comprehensive health benefits package effective from day one

What to Expect from the Hiring Process

We believe hiring should feel like a conversation, not a test. Here's what you can expect if you apply:

Step 1: Conversation with People & Culture (30 minutes)

If your experience looks like a fit, you'll meet with our Head of People & Culture for a video chat. It's a two-way conversation, we'll learn about your background, skills, and what energizes you, and you'll have space to ask about Revaly, our mission, and what it's like to work here. It's also a chance to make sure the vibes are right on both sides.

Step 2: Conversation with the Hiring Manager (60 minutes)

Next, you'll meet with the hiring manager for a deeper dive into your role-specific experience. We'll talk through real scenarios, how you approach challenges, and what success looks like in this role. You'll also get a clearer picture of the team's goals and priorities.

Step 3: Meet a Future Teammate (60 minutes)

In this stage, you'll meet with someone from the team you'll work closely with. This is your chance to get an on-the-ground perspective, how the team collaborates, what day-to-day looks like, and the kind of people you'll be building alongside.

Step 4: 90 Day Ramp Up Presentation (30 minutes)

In this final stage, we ask candidates to prepare and present a 90 day ramp up plan to the hiring manager. This is an opportunity for candidates to outline how they would approach their first 3 months in the role, what they'd aim to learn, prioritize, and accomplish. This is a chance to show your understanding of the role, the company, and the environment we're operating in, while giving the hiring manager a glimpse into how you think, structure your approach to learning and communicate your ideas.

We hire for both skill and fit, looking for people who are not just aligned with our values, but who will add to our culture with their ideas, energy, and perspective.

Revaly is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Accommodation is available upon request for applicants with disabilities.
