jobs.title: Director, HR Solutions
jobs.excerpt: About Leena AI Leena AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform for HR, IT and Finance.
jobs.description:
About Leena AI

Leena AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Colleagues don't just answer employee questions — they run the work behind them: case handling, approvals, transactions across systems like Workday, SAP SuccessFactors and ServiceNow.

We've built the platform. Now we're going deeper into the HR operations problems that cost enterprises the most — payroll issues, time card exceptions, benefits enrollment and life events, and job and compensation changes. These are the transactions where errors cost real money, employees feel the impact directly, and HR operations teams lose hours fixing them. Building agents for them takes someone who has lived those problems.

The role

We're hiring a techno-functional HR leader who has run HR operations at scale — payroll, time, benefits and employee changes — and wants to turn that experience into AI Colleagues that solve real HR operations problems, not just answer questions. You'll report directly to a co-founder of Leena AI.

You'll wear three hats, in this order of priority:

  1. Build — own the domain for our high-value HR operations agents. Make sure they get transactions right, follow each customer's policies and hand off to humans at the right moments.
  2. Deliver — join customer implementations when an agent needs to be tailored to a customer's policies, pay and time rules, or system setup.
  3. Represent — join pre-sales conversations with CHROs, payroll and HR operations leaders, so buyers see that Leena AI brings industry expertise, not only technology. There is no sales quota.

What you'll do

Build high-value HR agents (about 50% of your time)

  • Own the domain for agents that handle high-stakes HR operations work: payroll issues, time card exceptions, benefits enrollment and life events, and job and compensation changes.
  • Follow the chain across systems. A promotion, transfer or status change has to land correctly in pay, time rules and benefits eligibility. The agents you build won't replace the system of record — they'll make sure each change lands right everywhere, and catch it when it doesn't.
  • Design how agents catch problems early — missing punches, unapproved timecards, late pay-rate changes, benefit deduction mismatches, eligibility gaps — and who they chase to fix each one before it reaches an employee.
  • Design how agents resolve issues end to end — "my pay is wrong", "my benefits didn't start", "my promotion isn't showing": investigate across systems, find the root cause, route the fix for approval, and explain the outcome to the employee.
  • Define the edge cases engineers won't know exist: retro pay, overtime and shift rules, multi-state taxes, mid-year life events, retroactive job changes, mid-period terminations.
  • Find where issues and cost concentrate at each customer — volume, rework hours, cost per error — and build the business case for each agent.
  • Build realistic test scenarios and review agent behavior for domain correctness before it reaches customers.
  • Co-own the roadmap with Product. Measure what buyers care about: errors caught before they reach employees, rework hours saved, time to resolve an employee issue.

Tailor agents for customers (about 25%)

  • Join implementation calls when a customer's HR policies or processes need the agent designed around them.
  • Translate a customer's HR policies, pay rules, union agreements and system setup into agent behavior the delivery team can configure.
  • Advise customer HR leaders on process redesign, rollout and change management.
  • Step in on escalations where the question is "is the agent doing the HR process right?"
  • Bring field learnings back into the product so the next customer gets them by default.

Represent Leena AI in the market (about 25%)

  • Join discovery and demo calls with CHROs, payroll, HR operations and HRIS leaders, and speak their language.
  • Run process deep-dive workshops with prospects and build the ROI case for each agent.
  • Own the functional HR answers in RFPs.
  • Be an external voice: webinars, customer advisory boards, analyst briefings and content on where AI changes HR operations.

Requirements

What you bring

  • 12+ years in HR, including 5+ years leading HR operations, HR shared services or payroll in a large enterprise (5,000+ employees), or leading HR operations and payroll transformations for such enterprises at a consulting firm, payroll provider or HCM implementation partner.
  • Hands-on ownership of high-volume HR transactions — payroll accuracy, time and attendance, benefits enrollment and life events, job and compensation changes. You know where they break and what that costs.
  • Systems know-how across the HR stack: how HR, time, benefits and payroll systems feed each other, and where data breaks between them. Functional depth in platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, UKG or ADP — you understand their processes, data and integrations, even if you don't configure them yourself.
  • You've led at least one HR technology implementation or HR transformation from design through go-live.
  • Techno-functional comfort: you can read a process flow or an API spec at a conceptual level, write structured requirements, and test whether a system does what it should. No coding required.
  • Business sense: you can size a process by volume, rework hours and error cost, and make the case for automating it.
  • Working knowledge of US HR compliance — FLSA and overtime, multi-state wage, hour and tax rules, FMLA, ACA and ERISA.
  • Executive presence with CHRO-level audiences: you can run a workshop, present a vision and handle skeptical questions.
  • Curiosity about AI — you've used generative AI tools and have a view on where they help and where they don't.

Nice to have

  • Experience with organizations running several HR, time, benefits and payroll vendors side by side.
  • Global HR operations or payroll experience across multiple countries.
  • Time at a payroll provider, benefits administrator, HCM implementation partner or an HR transformation practice at a consulting firm.
  • Hands-on with HR automation: ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, Workday Extend or Studio, RPA or workflow tools.
  • Certifications such as CPP (Certified Payroll Professional), CEBS, SHRM-SCP or Workday Pro.
  • Exposure to where HR meets IT and Finance — access changes on job moves, payroll-to-general-ledger posting.

Benefits

Why this role

  • Build a new practice. You'll define how Leena AI's HR agents handle payroll, time, benefits and job changes, and grow a team as the practice scales.
  • Your experience becomes the product. The edge cases you've fixed by hand become the rules our agents follow at enterprise customers.
  • Work across the whole company. Product, Engineering, customers and Sales all rely on your judgment, and you report directly to a co-founder.

Job Description:

As the Director of Data Software Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for building and operating Darktrace’s internal Data & Insight Marketplace and the applications, APIs and services that power it. Reporting to the VP, Enterprise Data, you will sit at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering and Analytics, creating the technology that enables trusted enterprise data and insights to be discovered and consumed across the business.


You will lead a blended team of permanent employees, contractors and strategic partners, setting the technical vision, engineering standards and delivery model for secure, scalable and user-friendly applications and services. Working across a modern Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystem, you will oversee engineering across a React front end, Python services, REST APIs, containerised workloads, Azure DevOps CI/CD and Entra-based identity.

A core focus of the role will be the Data & Insight Marketplace, Darktrace’s single front door to trusted dashboards, curated datasets, semantic models and AI Data Agents. You will ensure the Marketplace provides intuitive, governed self-service access to data products for both people and AI agents, while establishing the APIs, integration patterns and services needed to support a growing AI-first data ecosystem.


This is an opportunity to build a strategic internal product and engineering capability from the ground up rather than inherit a legacy estate. You will influence architecture and technology choices, build a high-performing engineering team, introduce AI-assisted engineering practices and partner directly with the VP, Enterprise Data to shape the technology strategy and roadmap.


Key Duties & Responsibilities

• Build, lead and develop the Data Software Engineering team, establishing the technical vision, engineering standards and operating model needed to deliver and run secure, reliable production applications and services.

• Own the technical delivery and lifecycle of the Data & Insight Marketplace, creating an intuitive single front door through which users can discover, understand, access and consume trusted enterprise data and insights.

• Lead the design, development and operation of secure, well-documented APIs and services that expose governed data products to employees, applications and AI agents.

• Own the architecture and deployment of containerised applications and services on Azure across development, test and production environments, balancing scalability, resilience, security, performance and cost.

• Establish strong software engineering and DevOps practices, including automated CI/CD, testing, code review, infrastructure-as-code, deployment controls, release management and rollback capabilities.

• Embed security-by-design across Marketplace applications and services, including Entra-based identity, role-based and least-privilege access, auditable approval workflows, and alignment with enterprise security, privacy and AI governance requirements.

• Own the production health of Marketplace applications and services, establishing observability, service levels, incident management, root cause analysis and operational handoffs in partnership with DataOps and Infrastructure teams.

• Lead Agile delivery across engineering squads, maintaining clear roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, risks and delivery reporting while removing barriers to execution.

• Experience leading blended engineering teams that include permanent employees, contractors, consultants and/or strategic delivery partners.

Preferred:

• Hands-on knowledge of React, Python and REST API engineering sufficient to guide architecture, engineering standards and technical decision-making.

• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, role-based access control and enterprise identity and access-management patterns.

• Experience building internal data marketplaces, data catalogues, developer portals or other self-service enterprise platforms.

Technical Skills:

jobs.title: Product Manager OEM
jobs.excerpt: About Virtuozzo Virtuozzo develops infrastructure software for AI and the cloud.
jobs.description:
About Virtuozzo

Virtuozzo develops infrastructure software for AI and the cloud. Our technology combines an optimised operating system with virtualisation, storage, orchestration, management, automation, and protection, helping service providers, SaaS companies, and enterprises build and run efficient, scalable infrastructure.

We enable customers and partners to launch, operate, and grow cloud services on their own infrastructure and under their own brand. Our software delivers mainframe-like performance, reliability, and security while reducing infrastructure costs and operational complexity.

With deep engineering roots, we pioneered container-based virtualisation and continue contributing to foundational open-source projects, including OpenVZ, the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, CRIU, KVM, and OpenStack.

About the role

Virtuozzo builds infrastructure software for service providers, SaaS, and corporate partners: virtualisation, software-defined storage, and cloud services.

One of our largest partners embeds our product into its own branded cloud offering under an OEM agreement, and we are looking for a mid-to-senior-level professional to build and run a cross-functional team that delivers for this partner, working closely with our Product and TAM teams and release management.

What you will do

  1. Take in the partner’s business and technical requests. Find the business problem behind each one. The partner often brings a ready technical solution; with your engineering lead, decide whether to accept it as stated or go back to the problem.
  2. Learn how the partner sells our product through MSPs and service providers and which requests matter for its sales and renewals. Use this to set priorities with the Product team.
  3. With engineering and product teams, turn the requests into product requirements the team can estimate.
  4. With the Product team, find where the partner’s requests overlap with our own roadmap so we build things once for everyone.
  5. Build and run the requirements and change process with the partner: scope, freeze dates, change requests, impact assessment, and exceptions. Decide on late changes yourself, within that process.
  6. Plan the work with the team and with release management, aligned with the partner’s own release schedule, get commitments, and deliver on them. When a date slips, tell the partner early and agree on a new plan.
  7. Be the single point of contact for the partner on delivery: regular syncs, status, and escalations. Bring product management in when a product decision is needed, with the problem already clear.
  8. Say “not in this release” to the partner when scope and dates are under pressure, defend the process and the team’s resources, and keep the relationship in good shape.
  9. Deliver bad news early, with a plan attached, and adjust the message for the partner, our leadership, and the engineers.
  10. Own reporting on the programme: what was delivered, what is planned, and where the team’s time went.
  11. Together with R&D, set up the team that delivers for the partner: a dedicated core (frontend, backend, storage, and hypervisor engineers, with an engineering lead) plus shared engineers from other teams, around 40 people in total. Decide who is on it, how it plans, and how it works with the rest of R&D. Our R&D is organised by technical area, so this setup is new.

What you bring

  1. Excellent English and confident communication skills, spoken and written.
  2. Experience as a delivery, programme, or project manager on the vendor or contractor side of B2B software work, for example, custom development for an external client.
  3. Enough technical understanding to discuss VMs, Kubernetes, S3, software-defined storage, and networks with engineers and to question a technical proposal. You consult your technical peers for depth.
  4. Availability to work remotely during European working hours.

Nice to have

  1. Experience running OEM or technology partnership programmes, ideally with revenue-share or co-selling models.
  2. Experience in sales through MSP and service-provider channels.
  3. Hands-on experience with virtualisation and HCI: Proxmox, oVirt, OpenStack, Ceph; VMware/ESXi, Nutanix, or Sangfor HCI also help.
  4. Experience with storage products: Pure Storage, Dell, HPE, or similar.
  5. Familiarity with backup, disaster recovery, or cyber-protection products and with backup storage: S3-compatible object storage, NFS, data retention, and immutability.
  6. Comfortable in the Linux terminal; AlmaLinux/RHEL-based distributions are most useful.

This role is for you if

  1. You are excited to build a new process.
    The team and the process do not exist yet. You will set them up and have a real say in how they work.
  2. You like seeing the business result of your work.
    The partnership runs on revenue share: when the partner sells more, so do we, and what your team ships shows up in that number.
  3. You like to work with or learn infrastructure technologies.
    Virtualization, storage, Kubernetes, S3: you will learn the stack from the people who build it.
  4. You like working between business and engineering.
    One day you are with the partner’s managers, the next with our engineers, and you connect the two.

This role is not for you if

  1. You need the process to be in place before you go in.
    In this position, you will have to build the process yourself. The company is not used to working with OEM, so you will have to build consensus about the process on both the Virtuozzo and partner sides, guard your resources, get resources from others, and lead the team to deliver.
  2. You are looking for a strictly project-management role.
    In this role, you won’t be able to stay away from technical details, and usually there will be no person who will collect the data or prepare the slides for you. The faster you understand the technology and the systems you can get raw data from, the more you will get done here.
  3. You want to decide what to build and own the product.
    Your input will inform product direction within what the OEM partner is requesting; final decisions are made by the Virtuozzo Product team.

Your first six months

  • Month 1: Get to know the team, the product, and the partner’s business

You meet the Product, engineering, TAM, and release management teams and the partner’s main contacts. You go through product training and get hands-on with the platform, so you can follow technical discussions and know where to get data. You learn how the partner sells our product and which of its business goals depend on us.

  • Months 2–3: Set up the team

With R&D leadership, you agree who is on the team, dedicated and shared, and how it plans and works with the rest of R&D. You take over the partner’s requests from the Product team and become the partner’s main contact on delivery.

  • Months 4–6: Run it

By the end of the first half-year:

  1. The partner and Virtuozzo work through an agreed intake and change process. It keeps the partner’s requests at a size the team can deliver, makes dates predictable, and turns late changes into explicit trade-offs agreed with the partner.
  2. Committed scope ships on the agreed dates, and when a date moves, the partner hears it from you early.
  3. You can show at any time what the team delivered, what is planned, and where its time went.

Systems that you will use day to day

This is a First Shift position (8:45 AM EST to 5 PM EST) with a schedule of Thursday through Monday.

NBCUniversal’s Cyber Defense Operations team provides cyber threat intelligence, security event analysis, incident response, threat hunting, and detection and response capabilities across the enterprise. As a member of the Cyber Response team, the Senior Cyber Event Analyst will serve as a senior technical investigator responsible for identifying, analyzing, scoping, and responding to cybersecurity events.

This role requires an analyst who can go beyond the alert. The successful candidate will dive into underlying security telemetry, correlate activity across multiple data sources, develop and test investigative hypotheses, and determine the actual risk and potential impact of security events. The analyst will also help engineer and improve SOAR playbooks, investigation workflows, and response processes.

This is a shift-based role supporting NBCUniversal’s 24x7 Cyber Defense operation and includes participation in an on-call rotation; including the need to cover Company holidays.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and prioritize the queue including the Cyber hotline
  • Perform advanced triage, investigation, scoping, and disposition of security events across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, application, and email environments.
  • Go beyond surfaced alerts by querying and analyzing underlying logs and telemetry to validate detections, reconstruct activity, determine scope, and identify potential impact.
  • Correlate evidence across SIEM, EDR/XDR, identity, DNS, proxy, firewall, WAF, cloud, email, application, and threat intelligence data sources.
  • Conduct hypothesis-driven investigations, identifying the additional evidence required to confirm or disprove malicious activity.
  • Assess security risk based on technical evidence, including affected identities and assets, privileges, persistence, lateral movement, data access, exposure, and business context.
  • Develop clear, evidence-backed dispositions documenting investigative findings, scope, confidence, risk, and recommended response actions.
  • Maps observed attacker behaviors and techniques to MITRE ATT&CK and other applicable security frameworks.
  • Collect and preserve endpoints, identity, network, cloud, and application artifacts to support investigations.
  • Design, build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain SOAR playbooks and investigation workflows for enrichment, evidence collection, containment, and response.
  • Translate manual investigation procedures into scalable automation using APIs, Python, PowerShell, JSON, or similar technologies.
  • Identify gaps/tuning opportunities in detection logic, telemetry, logging, and response processes and partner with Detection Engineering to implement improvements.
  • Perform technical peer reviews and mentor analysts on investigative methodology, query development and telemetry analysis.
  • Maintain detailed investigation records, technical runbooks, and shift handoffs to ensure continuity and analytical rigor.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, relevant certifications, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, or Cyber Defense.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex security events beyond the information provided in the initial alert.
  • Hands-on experience querying and analyzing security telemetry using SIEM, security data lake, and/or log analytics platforms.
  • Experience correlating data across endpoints, identity, network, cloud, email, and application security technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Windows/Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, identity and authentication, enterprise networking, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience investigating threats such as credential compromise, malware, phishing/BEC, endpoint or network intrusion, suspicious cloud activity, and unauthorized data access.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and incident response methodologies.
  • Experience developing, modifying, or troubleshooting SOAR playbooks and security automation workflows.
  • Experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
  • Ability to clearly distinguish and communicate confirmed evidence, analytical conclusions, risk, assumptions, and investigative gaps.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to support shift-based operations and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Ability to cover Company holidays to ensure 24x7 all year-round coverage.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with query languages such as KQL, SPL, SQL, or equivalent.
  • Experience analyzing Windows Event Logs, Sysmon, EDR telemetry, authentication logs, DNS, network telemetry, cloud audit logs, and application logs.
  • Experience with endpoint/network forensics, packet analysis, or attack-path reconstruction.
  • Advanced experience developing SOAR automation, API integrations, or analyst enrichment tools.
  • Experience supporting Cyber Defense or Incident Response within a large, globally distributed enterprise or Media and Entertainment organization.
  • Relevant technical certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GIAC, or equivalent.

Additional Requirements

Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.
Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a Structured Data Engineer (AI Search), you will make ecommerce product data accurate, complete and machine-readable for AI search and AI shopping. Your work will ensure that AI systems can access reliable product, pricing, availability and delivery information, supporting product discoverability and ecommerce performance.

You will be fully embedded in an AEO/GEO programme and engineering team, working closely with the AEO/GEO Lead, engineering and platform teams, paid search, trading and product content teams.

This mid-to-senior-level role focuses on improving structured data quality, maintaining reliable product information at catalogue scale and enabling AI-powered product discovery and shopping.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain template-level JSON-LD across product, category, content and brand pages, including Product, ProductGroup, Offer, AggregateRating, Review, OfferShippingDetails, MerchantReturnPolicy and Organization.
  • Generate structured markup directly from source systems to maintain accuracy as prices, stock levels and reviews change.
  • Build automated validation and monitoring to identify broken, missing or contradictory structured markup.
  • Own and maintain product feed pipelines into Google Merchant Center and Microsoft Merchant Center, collaborating with the paid search team.
  • Prepare product feeds and integrations for emerging AI shopping platforms and agentic commerce protocols.
  • Maintain near real-time consistency of pricing, availability and delivery information across the website, structured markup and product feeds where required.
  • Identify and resolve gaps in product attributes, including specifications, energy ratings, dimensions and compatibility information.
  • Ensure price matching, delivery options and customer review information are consistently structured across relevant platforms.
  • Collaborate with PIM, catalogue and trading teams to resolve product data quality issues at source.
  • Ensure important content and structured markup are available in server-rendered HTML and accessible to AI crawlers.
  • Support log file analysis and crawler access rules alongside the AEO/GEO Lead.
  • Translate AEO/GEO findings into clearly scoped, tested engineering work.
  • Deliver changes through established Git workflows, code review, CI/CD and release processes.
  • Prepare product data and structured markup ahead of major retail events, including Black Friday and significant product launches.
  • Participate in engineering stand-ups and sprint rituals during UK business hours.
  • During the first 30 days, understand the existing technology stack, PIM systems and feed pipelines, audit structured markup and feed quality across priority categories, and establish a prioritised backlog.
  • During days 31–60, implement corrected, source-driven markup across high-traffic templates and resolve significant pricing, availability and product attribute inconsistencies.
  • During days 61–90, establish automated validation and monitoring, extend coverage across the product catalogue and document the system for ongoing maintenance.
  • Work towards automatically generated, validated and monitored structured markup and product feeds across priority categories within the first 90 days.
  • Measure improvements against the initial audit, including structured data coverage and validity, pricing and availability consistency, product attribute completeness, and Merchant Center feed health.
  • Monitor data quality issues and improve the proportion of errors detected before they affect customers or AI systems.
  • Contribute to improvements in AI search visibility, measured through the AEO/GEO Lead's citation and accuracy metrics.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in backend, data or integration engineering, including at least 2 years working with ecommerce or retail platforms.
  • Strong Python programming skills, with SQL knowledge and hands-on experience using ETL or data pipeline tooling.
  • At least 2 years of experience working with ecommerce product data, including Product Information Management (PIM) systems, catalogue models, product attributes and variants.
  • Strong knowledge of JSON-LD and schema.org, or the engineering depth to learn these technologies quickly and implement them correctly.
  • Experience building and maintaining product feeds for Google Merchant Center or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of server-side rendering, caching, Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) and how search engine and AI crawlers access web content.
  • Experience implementing automated testing and monitoring for data quality.
  • Experience working with Git, code reviews and CI/CD pipelines within an established engineering team.
  • Ability to maintain data accuracy and consistency across large ecommerce product catalogues.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and commercial stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Magento/Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud or a headless commerce technology stack.
  • Experience with Microsoft Merchant Center, Bing Webmaster Tools or marketplace product feeds.
  • Exposure to agentic commerce, AI shopping integrations or Large Language Model (LLM) APIs.
  • Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse.
  • Background working with consumer electrical products or other specification-heavy product categories.

jobs.description:
Want to make a difference? Join an organization committed to sharing the hope of true transformation with those impacted by incarceration for nearly 50 years. Prison Fellowship® is the nation's largest Christian nonprofit equipping the Church to serve currently and formerly incarcerated people and their families, and to advocate for justice and human dignity.

Prison Fellowship and its church partners encounter Jesus with those behind bars, breaking cycles of crime and prayerfully anticipating a revival of justice, mercy, and hope in our culture.

Prison Fellowship® is an organization committed to the highest standards of conduct, ethics, and Christian values. Our conduct is guided by and grounded in the Bible, as reflected in our Statement of Faith below.

What We Are Looking For

A relationship-focused ministry professional who understands church culture, enjoys supporting volunteers, and can build trusted partnerships with church leaders and Angel Tree coordinators. This individual will serve as a primary point of contact for Angel Tree Christmas church coordinators, providing exceptional support, guidance, and encouragement throughout the program year and seasonal campaign. The ideal candidate thrives on building strong partnerships, solving problems, and delivering outstanding customer service while advancing Prison Fellowship's mission.

Working closely with church partners, volunteers, and internal ministry teams, this person will strengthen coordinator engagement, support annual program renewals, provide operational and technical assistance, and recruit churches to participate in Angel Tree events and ministry opportunities. The strongest applicants are highly organized, relational, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced ministry environment.

Location Requirement: This position must reside within the assigned service region and have strong familiarity with local churches and communities. Applicants outside the designated region will not be considered.

West Region: AK, AZ, CA, CO, HI, ID, KS, MT, ND, NE, NM, NV, OR, SD, UT, WA, WY

Role Responsibilities

Church Coordinator Engagement & Program Renewals

  • Manage relationships with approximately 1,000+ Angel Tree church partners throughout the region while helping coordinators successfully deliver Angel Tree Christmas programs.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Angel Tree Christmas church coordinators through proactive outreach, ongoing support, and exceptional customer service.
  • Encourage and secure annual program renewals, helping returning churches re-engage each season.
  • Guide coordinators through registration, enrollment, and compliance requirements.
  • Identify opportunities for churches to deepen their involvement with Angel Tree and other Prison Fellowship ministry programs.

Church Coordinator Support & Program Operations

  • Oversee development and execution of coordinator-facing communications and marketing materials for Angel Tree Christmas.
  • Partner with Marketing and Instructional Design teams to create and update program resources, training materials, and promotional assets.
  • Ensure messaging remains accurate, mission-aligned, and consistent across all coordinator communications.
  • Manage project timelines and priorities to ensure quality deliverables are completed on schedule.

Church Recruitment & Event Engagement

  • Recruit churches and volunteers to participate in Angel Tree events and ministry opportunities.
  • Attend Angel Tree sports camps, STEM camps, and regional events to strengthen church engagement.
  • Support event registration activities and represent Angel Tree and Prison Fellowship at ministry events.
  • Cultivate relationships with church leaders, volunteers, and ministry partners through in-person engagement.

Communications & Training

  • Deliver clear, accurate, and timely communications and resources to church coordinators.
  • Support webinars, virtual trainings, kickoff events, and coordinator development opportunities.
  • Equip coordinators with the tools and information needed to serve children and families successfully.
  • Gather coordinator feedback and share insights to support ongoing program improvements.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2–4 years of experience in customer relations, account management, church engagement, volunteer management, ministry operations, nonprofit programs, or a related field.
  • Strong relationship-building, customer service, and communication skills, with the ability to engage church leaders, volunteers, and ministry partners effectively.
  • Experience coordinating events, supporting volunteers, or managing church, ministry, or nonprofit programs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, CRM platforms such as Salesforce, and other web-based systems, including the ability to troubleshoot basic technology issues.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt during seasonal peaks.
  • Successful candidates have experience working with churches, faith-based organizations, or volunteer-driven programs

Work Arrangement

  • Remote/work-from-home position; the individual serving in this position must reside in the assigned service region for consideration.
  • Up to 25% travel required, including attendance at ministry events, trainings, and team gatherings.
  • Employees who travel on behalf of Prison Fellowship must maintain required automobile insurance coverage and successfully complete annual motor vehicle record checks.

Salary at Prison Fellowship is determined by a variety of factors. For this full-time position, the budgeted rate of pay is projected to be $21.50-$26.00 per hour (or $44,720-$54,080 per year).

Why Join Prison Fellowship

At Prison Fellowship, we're committed to supporting the overall well-being of our employees through comprehensive benefits, generous paid time off, and opportunities for professional growth.

Full-time employees enjoy:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Retirement account funding
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
  • Paid maternity and parental leave
  • Generous paid time off, including:
    • 14 paid holidays
    • 15 vacation days
    • 10 sick days
    • 39 total paid days off annually after one year of employment
  • Additional benefits and wellness resources

Part-time employees who regularly work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for select benefits on a prorated basis (excluding health insurance).

Beyond our benefits, you'll find a collaborative, mission-driven culture, supportive teammates, innovative technology tools, and meaningful opportunities for personal and professional development. Join us in making a lasting impact while building a rewarding career.

Our Statement of Faith

The Foundation of What We Believe

As a Christian organization, Prison Fellowship believes in the full authority of the Bible as God's inspired Word and the complete tenets of the Apostles' Creed and the Nicene Creed.

We believe in one God, Creator and Lord of the Universe, the co-eternal Trinity: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. We believe that Jesus Christ, God's Son, was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, lived a sinless life, died a substitutionary atoning death on the cross, rose bodily from the dead, and ascended to heaven where, as truly God and truly man, He is the only mediator between God and man. We believe that the Bible is God's authoritative and inspired Word, without error in all its teachings.

How We Are Compelled to Live and to Act

We believe that Christians, both individually and corporately, must submit to the Bible as God's authoritative, divine, and inspired Word in all matters of belief and conduct.

This role will work closely with our CEO and leadership team and manage a Lead of Development.   • Proven track record of successfully meeting fundraising goals and developing diverse revenue streams.

jobs.title: Head of Credit, Kenya
jobs.excerpt: About us Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa's fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of naira in transactions monthly.
jobs.description:
About us

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa's fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About this role

The Head of Credit, Kenya owns Moniepoint's credit business in Kenya: who we lend to, on what terms and at what price, and running the credit unit economics profitably within the risk appetite. They own the value proposition and unit economics of every credit product in Kenya, starting with SME lending to our merchant base and also consumer base. They work with the Head of Business in Kenya and functionally with the Group Head of Product, Credit. They write the briefs (RFC) for product architects and engineering to build the product and lending experience.

Responsibilities

  • Set the credit strategy for Kenya: which segments to serve, which credit products to offer, and how to price for risk, starting with SME lending to Moniepoint merchants and then consumers.
  • Own the credit unit economics in Kenya, covering interest and fee, cost of funds, credit losses, and operating costs, with the budget, forecast, and reporting that give the Head of Business and Group Head of Credit clear visibility.
  • Design credit value propositions with sound unit economics, grounded in evidence of what Kenyan businesses (and eventually for consumers) need and in what is already proven in Nigeria.
  • Apply the Group credit policy framework in Kenya, and agree local risk limits and pricing changes with the Group Head of Credit and Risk & Compliance.
  • Make sure every Kenya credit proposition is validated with in depth customer contacts before the RFC goes to product architects, and that every credit RFC meets the RFC standard.
  • Work with Data Science to define what a good underwriting decision looks like in a thin-file market, and keep tightening it using portfolio performance.
  • Work with Growth on distribution, deciding how credit reaches customers through direct sales, the merchant base, and partner channels.
  • Make sure the credit business complies with Kenyan regulation from the start, including Central Bank of Kenya lending rules, credit reference bureau reporting, and data protection.

Experience & Background

  • Over 7 years of experience in fintech and ideally in lending specifically in Kenya.
  • Direct ownership of a lending unit economics, with the ability to explain the full economics of a portfolio you ran and how you balanced growth against portfolio quality.
  • Track record of building or scaling an SME (or comparable) lending book, ideally in a market with thin credit history data.
  • Experience launching credit products in a new market or business, from first disbursement to scale.
  • Experience leading lending teams across portfolio management, credit operations, and collections.
  • Experience working with product, data science, and risk teams to turn credit needs into clear requirements and better underwriting.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of how a lending business makes or loses money, and of SME credit needs.
  • Strong grasp of credit risk and lending economics: pricing for risk, cost of funds, loss rates, vintage and roll-rate analysis, and collections.
  • Able to interrogate a credit model's output rather than simply consume it.
  • Disciplined at framing credit bets as hypotheses and validating them before scaling.
  • Ability to shape the work of functions you do not own through influence and a clear commercial point of view.
  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable using data and AI-assisted tools.

What success looks like in this role

  • A clear credit strategy for Kenya agreed with the Head of Business and Group Head of Credit.
  • The credit book growing to plan in disbursement and revenue, with credit losses within the agreed risk appetite.
  • Credit products meeting contribution margin targets.
  • Every Kenya credit RFC meeting the RFC standard and moving to build with little rework.
  • Clean regulatory standing with the Central Bank of Kenya, and accurate credit reference bureau reporting.

Why join us

  • Build a credit business from the ground up in one of Africa's most dynamic markets.
  • Serve SMEs that remain underserved by credit despite Kenya's advanced financial infrastructure.
  • Apply a model already proven at scale in Nigeria, with the backing of the Group credit team.
  • Work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant responsibility.

jobs.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role:

The VP, Director of Media Strategy and Planning is responsible for developing the strategic approach and leading all things media, including accurate budget control and the flow of media activity. Working across functional teams, the VP, Director role will lead all planning and delivery of integrated cross-channel media plans including both digital (programmatic, endemic, social, search) and traditional (TV, print, OOH) media. This role is responsible for the full planning cycle from determining goals and objectives for media programs, developing budget recommendations, and modeling outcomes in order to reach those goals. The Director will lead of team of supervisors and planners in developing the subsequent plans, work with the analytics team to align on a measurement plan, and ensure team is delivering, optimizing, and achieving client goals accordingly. A successful candidate will lead via education and example, pitching in and working with junior team members as both a mentor and a colleague.

What you'll do:

  • Provide strategic thinking for the development, planning and implementation of client media plans, as well as the ongoing management of the campaigns. Work with key stakeholders to determine appropriate measurement techniques for properly evaluating success and criteria for optimization.
  • Work with the client and senior leadership to establish annual budget and staffing plans.
  • Manage accounts to ensure that client staffing plans are established to be fiscally profitable.
  • Identify ways to grow accounts via new partnerships and additional opportunities for growth in media spend and/or fee generating activities.
  • Lead team in developing RFPs, lists of media partners for consideration, and criteria against which partners will be evaluated.
  • Oversee and assist junior team members in the planning process, execution, and day-to-day management of campaigns.
  • Develop the staff through performance management and consistent feedback.
  • As the team lead, build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, account, creative, ad ops, strategy, and analytics teams across the internal organization, in order to facilitate the implementation and measurement of campaign.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key vendors, platforms, and technology partners, including identifying opportunities for new ideas and emerging technologies. Ensure junior team members are aware of and learning to take advantage of these opportunities.
  • Monitor the latest trends in advertising and healthcare and work with appropriate internal stakeholders to develop client-facing POVs, test and learn scenarios, and resulting case studies, as appropriate.
  • Participate in new business pitches and proposals as needed.
  • Supervise team of three to six team members, helping to develop their skill sets and assigning relevant tasks for career growth and appropriate account management.

About you:

  • 8+ years of relevant agency experience in planning and buying media across both online and offline channels.
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage to deadlines.
  • Demonstrated account leadership, initiative, and willingness to assume greater responsibility.
  • Understand the elements of a strategic marketing communications plan and be able to actively participate in its generation.
  • Understand all the steps necessary to complete each stage of a job.
  • Understand how to produce a comprehensive estimate.
  • Know how to present agency concepts to the client and guide client to well-considered responses and requests.
  • Ability to provide clear and logical direction on all work orders.
  • Direct experience with pharmaceutical (preferred) and/or healthcare advertising for both patients and physicians.
  • Knowledge of media planning and buying, third party tracking and ad serving technology, and audience and competitive research tools.
  • Experience with paid social and search strategy, a plus.
  • Understanding of and ability to explain full-funnel media campaigns.
  • Experience working within a full-service agency and/or client side preferred.
  • 3+ years of supervisory experience or related account management experience.
  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in a related field.

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

jobs.excerpt: SHIFT: Day (United States of America)Seeking Breakthrough Makers Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives.
jobs.description:
SHIFT:

Day (United States of America)

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.


CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview
Director of Data Trust will lead data governance providing both strategic and operational leadership across the enterprise data warehouse, business intelligence (BI) ecosystem, and analytical products, ensuring that data is reliable, secure, well‑understood, and responsibly used. As a leader within the Data & Analytics organization and reporting to the AVP of Data Science, this role oversees the Data Trust Office and drives the evolution of data governance capabilities that support clinical, research, operational, and enterprise reporting needs, as well as emerging AI‑enabled solutions.

The Director is responsible for establishing, executing, and advancing CHOP's data governance strategy which includes developing and refining the frameworks, policies, and standards that strengthen data quality, transparency, security, compliance, and ethical use.
While the role is anchored within the Data & Analytics organization, the Director will partner closely with clinical, operational, and technical leaders to improve data quality and stewardship at upstream source systems that feed the enterprise data warehouse. These partnerships are essential to ensuring downstream reliability for reporting, analytics, predictive modeling, and AI.

As CHOP expands its use of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI, the Director of Data Trust will build and scale the governance foundation required for trustworthy insights, positioning the organization for future growth and maturity in enterprise data governance.


What you will do

  • Operational oversight of the Data Trust Office activities in support of clinical and operational analytic leaders:
  • Data Strategy & Trust Leadership
  • Define and execute a multi-year Data Trust and Data Governance roadmap aligned to organizational strategy, clinical and operational priorities, research needs, and AI initiatives.
  • Integrate data governance into broader Data & Analytics, digital, and AI strategies, ensuring governance efforts are sequenced, scalable, and outcome driven.
  • Ensure governance standards are consistently applied throughout the data asset lifecycle, including acquisition, integration, validation, use, maintenance, and archival.
  • Provide thought leadership on modern governance practices that balance innovation with risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Promote enterprise-wide adoption of repeatable governance standards rather than one-off solutions
  • Data Quality, Metadata & Transparency
  • Scale and mature the Data Quality Center of Excellence (COE), including profiling, monitoring, root-cause analysis, prioritization, and remediation of data quality issues, imperative for trusted analytics and AI solutions.
  • Establish enterprise standards for data quality, metadata, lineage, and documentation that enable data consumers to understand, trust, and appropriately use data.
  • Define data quality metrics and KPIs and report progress to executive stakeholders.
  • Oversee adoption and optimization of the enterprise data catalog and metadata management processes, ensuring discoverability and usability across domains.
  • Access, Privacy, Security & Responsible Data Use
  • Align data governance practices with enterprise and/or regulatory privacy and security standards.
  • Refine and mature data access controls, balancing usability with protection of sensitive data.
  • Enforce data classification schemas and corresponding access controls to ensure data is securely managed and aligned with privacy, security, and compliance standards.
  • Ensure responsible data use and ethical considerations are embedded into analytics and AI initiatives.
  • Partner with enterprise AI governance efforts to ensure data readiness, documentation, and guardrails support responsible AI adoption.
  • Governance Operations & Policy Management
  • Develop, publish, and maintain enterprise data governance policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Establish and support data stewardship roles and accountability frameworks across clinical, research, and operational domains.
  • Translate governance decisions into actionable standards, priorities, and execution plans across the data ecosystem.
  • Leverage automation and scalable workflows to improve governance efficiency and consistency.
  • Collaboration, Councils & Change Management
  • Lead Data Trust council, stewardship forums, and working groups, ensuring alignment, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Integrate into and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leaders and enterprise committees/councils by framing options, clarifying trade-offs, and assessing impacts.
  • Partner closely with Clinical, Informatics, Research, Digital Technology Services, Analytics, Finance, HR, and Operations leaders to embed governance into day-to-day practices as relevant.
  • Drive change management and communication strategies to support adoption of new standards, definitions, and governance processes
  • Team & Operational Leadership
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Data Trust Office team.
  • Provide coaching, clear expectations, and professional development opportunities.
  • Manage operational responsibilities including resource planning, prioritization, budgeting input, succession planning and performance measurement.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, transparency, and customer focus.
  • Strategic Alignment & Continuous Improvement
  • Monitor healthcare, analytics, and AI trends to continuously evolve governance practices.
  • Proactively adapt Data Trust capabilities to support emerging data sources, technologies, and use cases.
  • Partner with Data Literacy and Enablement programs to embed Data Trust concepts into enterprise training and education.
  • Champion strategic programs like Master Data Management (MDM) to support enterprise data alignment, streamline cross system integration, and strengthen the overall data governance ecosystem.

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree Data science, informatics, computer science, biostatistics, healthcare, business administration, or a related field - Required
  • Master's Degree in related discipline - Preferred

Experience Qualifications

  • At least ten (10) years In healthcare, life sciences, or biomedical environments - Required and
  • At least five (5) years Leading or managing enterprise data governance or data management initiatives - Required and
  • At least two (2) years Demonstrated experience maturing data governance capabilities in complex, regulated organizations - Required and
  • At least two (2) years Experience supporting advanced analytics and AI use cases in healthcare - Required

Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and master data management practices (Required proficiency)
  • Understanding of healthcare data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements (Required proficiency)
  • Experience with business intelligence and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Business Objects) (Required proficiency)
  • Familiarity with data requirements for AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics (Required proficiency)
  • Experience with data catalogs, lineage, and governance tooling (Required proficiency)
  • Knowledge of modern data platforms, cloud environments, and DataOps practices (Required proficiency)
  • Proven ability to lead complex initiatives through influence and collaboration (Required proficiency)
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and data storytelling skills (Required proficiency)
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and adapt to evolving priorities (Required proficiency)
  • Experience with Epic analytics tools (Caboodle, Radar, SlicerDicer, Reporting Workbench) a plus (Preferred proficiency)
  • Familiarity with Python, R, Snowflake, GitHub, CI/CD, and automation a plus (Preferred proficiency)

To carry out its mission, CHOP is committed to supporting the health of our patients, families, workforce, and global community. As a condition of employment, CHOP employees who work in patient care buildings or who have patient facing responsibilities must receive an annual influenza vaccine. Learn more.EEO / VEVRAA Federal Contractor | Tobacco Statement

$100,000.00 - $375,000.00 Annually

This job is eligible for an incentive program.

jobs.title: VP Global Total Rewards and Analytics
jobs.excerpt: KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day.
jobs.description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

Remote positions open to the US only.

The Vice President of Global Total Rewards and Analytics is responsible for leading KnowBe4’s global total rewards strategy, including compensation, benefits, and equity programs across all operating regions. This role moves KnowBe4 beyond US-centric processes to build internationally competitive, scalable compensation frameworks that are fully integrated within Workday.

The VP will harness AI and advanced analytics to modernize how the organization benchmarks, analyzes, and acts on compensation data. A defining responsibility is establishing a rigorous global benchmarking program that identifies where KnowBe4 falls below market, develops a transparent multi-year strategy to close those gaps, and tracks progress against it.

This leader will also manage the People Operations team and partner closely with the Workday systems team to automate and optimize HR processes, and will oversee the HR Analytics function, helping business leaders make better workforce decisions through data-driven insights, and will serve as a key advisor to the CFO, executive leadership, and the Board on all matters related to compensation and total rewards.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of a global total rewards strategy that is competitive, equitable, and aligned with KnowBe4's compensation philosophy across all operating regions
  • Build and mature international compensation frameworks, replacing US-centric processes with globally consistent, scalable structures that reflect local market conditions and regulatory requirements
  • Drive the adoption of AI and advanced analytics tools to automate compensation analysis, surface pay equity insights, model scenario impacts, and reduce manual, error-prone processes
  • Establish and lead an ongoing global compensation benchmarking program: define benchmark methodology, identify positions below market, and develop a structured multi-year roadmap to close identified gaps in alignment with budget and business priorities
  • Partner with FP&A, CFO, and Executive Leadership to design and administer compensation programs including base pay, short- and long-term incentives, bonuses, commissions, and equity that drive company performance
  • Conduct regular pay equity analyses across geographies and demographic groups; develop and present action plans to address identified gaps
  • Simplify and reduce complexity in total rewards operations — rationalizing policies, eliminating redundant processes, and establishing clear governance and decision-making frameworks
  • Manage job descriptions reviews and provide recommended pay ranges in accordance with market data, KnowBe4's compensation philosophy, and budget guidelines
  • Work with budget owners on annual headcount and compensation budget planning, including total compensation package modeling for new and existing roles
  • Ensure Total Compensation dashboards within Workday are accurate, current, and well-utilized, with effective employee training and communications
  • Manage participation in global compensation surveys; analyze and apply findings to maintain market competitiveness
  • Develop executive presentations and board materials on total rewards strategy, benchmarking results, and gap remediation progress
  • Lead the HR Analytics function, providing business leaders with data-driven workforce insights and measurement frameworks to support strategic decisions
  • Lead and manage the HR Operations team, providing direction, coaching, and development, and ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant HR transactions, employee data management, and service delivery across all regions
  • Partner with the Workday systems team to identify, prioritize, and implement process automation and optimization opportunities across HR and total rewards workflows, including business process configuration, integrations, and reporting enhancements. Own the full integration and optimization of total rewards data and workflows within Workday, ensuring real-time data integrity, and a seamless employee experience across all geographies
  • Establish HR Operations service levels, quality standards, documented procedures, and controls; drive continuous improvement in processes, technology, and the employee and manager experience
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and projects to support operational and strategic business decisions
  • Provide genuine recommendations as to the hiring, firing, promotion, and discipline of subordinate employees to which the Company gives significant weight

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Management, Economics, Human Resources Management, or related field
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in global compensation and/or total rewards, reflecting increasing levels of responsibility and subject matter expertise
  • Demonstrated experience managing compensation across multiple international markets
  • 5+ years experience with Workday Advanced Compensation, Benefits, Analytics, and process workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and managing compensation programs across multiple countries and regions — ability to navigate diverse legal, regulatory, and cultural compensation environments is essential
  • Deep expertise in Workday HCM, including compensation module configuration, integration design, reporting, and data governance; experience migrating from fragmented systems to a unified Workday environment strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to leverage AI and automation tools (e.g., ML-based benchmarking tools, compensation analytics platforms) to improve decision quality and operational efficiency
  • Strong command of compensation benchmarking methodology, including survey participation, job matching, market positioning analysis, and multi-year pay strategy development
  • Experience building and communicating structured multi-year plans to address compensation gaps, balancing strategic intent with budget realities
  • Strong working knowledge of variable compensation plans, equity incentive plans, and executive compensation in multinational private or public companies
  • Exceptional analytical skills with advanced Excel proficiency (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Power Query) and experience with data visualization tools
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build strong cross-functional relationships with Finance, Legal, Payroll, People Business Partners, and executive leadership
  • Ability to lead, manage, and deliver complex compensation projects while providing strategic, tactical, and technical support to senior leaders
  • High attention to detail; capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present complex concepts clearly to varied audiences
  • Manages highly confidential information with professionalism, discretion, and sound business judgment
  • CEP (Certified Equity Professional) designation preferred, or actively working toward it
  • Experience with HRIS reporting and People Analytics platforms
  • Experience leading HR Operations or shared services teams, including coaching, developing, and managing team performance
  • Experience partnering with HRIS or Workday systems teams to define requirements and deliver process automation and optimization
  • SaaS industry experience a plus

The base pay for this position ranges from $225,000 - $250,000, which will vary depending on how well an applicant's skills and experience align with the job description listed above.

Application deadline: 1/20/2027. This is our good-faith estimate of the date the application window is anticipated to close. KnowBe4 reviews applications on a rolling basis and reserves the right to close the application window early if a qualified candidate for the position is identified.

Our Fantastic Benefits

We offer company-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses - all in a modern, high-tech, and fun work environment. Content and Deployment Specialist

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

Established in June 2004, FCM has been named World’s Best Travel Management Company for eight years running at the World Travel Awards.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a detail-oriented Content and Deployment Specialist to lead project deployments, create and deliver engaging training content, and streamline operational processes. This role bridges the gap between technology teams and end-users by developing comprehensive documentation, multimedia learning materials, and coordinating deployment activities across multiple stakeholders. This is an internal-facing position with minimal client interaction, focusing on stakeholder collaboration and back-end operations support.

  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

jobs.companyName: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime
jobs.description:
Closing Date for Applications

Friday, 27 November at 13:00 SAST

Start Date

As soon as possible / To be agreed

Duration

Ongoing consultancy, with regular assignments based on operational needs

Location

Remote (preference for candidates based in Malta)

Background

The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) is an independent civil society organization headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a globally dispersed Secretariat working across 43 countries. Founded in 2013, GI-TOC brings together a global network of more than 810 independent experts and a team of over 160 staff dedicated to understanding and responding to organized crime. Through research, analysis, policy engagement and support to civil society actors, GI-TOC works to deepen understanding of organized crime and strengthen effective, rights-based responses.

The GI-TOC works to:

  • Identify, analyse and map criminal trends and patterns of regional instability, and their impact on illicit flows, governance, development, security, conflict and the rule of law.
  • Connect and support civil society actors working on organized crime and corruption, and on their links to instability and conflict.
  • Strengthen local monitoring and analysis of national, regional and international organized crime and insecurity trends.

Job Summary

GI-TOC is seeking an experienced Research Editor to provide substantive editorial support to its North Africa and Sahel Observatory (NAS-Obs), which conducts research and analysis on organised crime, illicit economies, migration and related political and security dynamics across the region.

The successful candidate will work closely with researchers and analysts to strengthen the analytical quality, structure and clarity of research reports, policy briefs and other publications.

This role goes beyond conventional copy-editing. The Research Editor will engage critically with research content, examining arguments, questioning underlying assumptions, identifying gaps in evidence and analysis, and providing constructive feedback to researchers.

The role requires strong analytical judgement and the ability to work collaboratively with subject-matter experts, helping transform complex research into rigorous, coherent and accessible publications.

The consultancy will involve regular assignments, with the volume and timing of work determined by the Observatory's research and publication needs.

Main Responsibilities and Specific Tasks

  • Provide substantive editorial review of research reports, policy briefs and other analytical publications produced by the North Africa and Sahel Observatory.
  • Critically assess research arguments, analytical assumptions, evidence and conclusions, identifying weaknesses, inconsistencies and gaps requiring further attention.
  • Formulate questions and provide detailed, constructive feedback to researchers to strengthen the depth, accuracy and analytical rigour of their work.
  • Support researchers in developing clear analytical narratives, logical structures and compelling arguments.
  • Identify areas requiring additional research, clarification, contextualisation or stronger supporting evidence.
  • Work collaboratively with analysts through successive drafts, helping bring research outputs to publication-ready standards.
  • Ensure that research findings and conclusions are presented clearly, consistently and in a manner appropriate for policy, academic and wider professional audiences.
  • Coordinate with the Observatory's management and research teams to support publication planning and editorial workflows.

Required Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following experience and skills:

  • A university degree in political science, international relations, sociology, criminology, journalism, social sciences or another relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated professional experience in substantive editing, analytical research, investigative journalism or a closely related field.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, including the ability to interrogate research assumptions, evidence and conclusions.
  • Demonstrated experience working with complex research or analytical material, including research reports, policy briefs, investigative publications or comparable outputs.
  • Excellent written English, with a strong command of analytical writing, structure and argumentation.
  • Ability to provide clear, constructive editorial feedback and engage effectively with researchers and subject-matter experts.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage assignments independently and meet agreed deadlines.
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to working with colleagues in a geographically dispersed team.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Familiarity with political, security and organised crime dynamics in North Africa and the Sahel.
  • Experience editing research on migration, illicit economies, conflict, governance or transnational organised crime.
  • Previous experience working with research institutes, think tanks, investigative journalism organisations, academic institutions or international NGOs.
  • Experience supporting researchers in developing analytical arguments and improving research methodologies.
  • Based in Malta, facilitating closer coordination with the Observatory team.

The ideal candidate combines strong editorial judgement with analytical curiosity and the confidence to challenge research arguments constructively. We welcome applicants from a broad range of professional backgrounds, particularly those who can demonstrate the ability to engage critically with complex research and help researchers strengthen their analysis.

Consultacy Arrangements

The position is offered on a consultancy basis, involving regular assignments according to the Observatory's operational requirements.

The work will be undertaken remotely. Candidates based in Malta are particularly encouraged to apply to facilitate coordination with the Observatory's team, although applications from suitably qualified candidates based elsewhere are equally welcome.

GI-TOC operates a flexible working environment and encourages staff to achieve a suitable work-life balance and supports professional development and learning.

Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

The Global Initiatives makes use of BambooHR's ATS system to receive and review your application. All correspondence related to your application will be sent via our domain globalinitiative.bamboohr.com.
