Security Automation Solutions Engineer

Location: Remote (United States)
Reporting to: Director of Cybersecurity

At STN, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.

As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.

Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.

Overview
STN One is hiring a Security Automation Solutions Engineer to build and maintain integrations, orchestration, and AI-assisted workflows for internal cybersecurity operations and managed-services customers. You will work across security APIs, Python services, SOAR platforms, and operational data, with particular emphasis on safe execution, tenant isolation, reliability, and measurable analyst time savings.

Key Responsibilities

Security Automation Development & Integration
  • Design, develop, test, and operate security automation for alert enrichment, triage, investigation support, evidence gathering, case management, and approved response actions.
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, authentication standards, queues, and structured data from SIEM, EDR, identity, cloud, ticketing, and network tools.
  • Develop and maintain reusable Python modules, services, and scripts with version control, code reviews, automated tests, structured logging, and error handling.
Security Orchestration & Workflow Optimization
  • Create and improve SOAR playbooks and orchestration flows, including conditional logic, retries, idempotency, approvals, rollback, and exception handling.
  • Build secure integrations for Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM/XSOAR, SentinelOne, identity platforms, ticketing and asset tools, and approved internal STN services.
  • Develop AI-assisted workflows only where action boundaries, human authorization, customer data segregation, and security testing are demonstrably effective.
  • Evaluate AI-assisted and agentic security workflows where useful, using scoped tool permissions, human approval gates, traceability, and protection against untrusted input.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Security Controls
  • Work with SOC analysts, incident responders, implementation engineers, and customers to map workflows and define success criteria before automation.
  • Implement role-based access, secrets management, tenant boundaries, audit logs, and safeguards that prevent unintended cross-customer actions.
Operational Support & Continuous Improvement
  • Troubleshoot production failures, data mismatches, API limits, authorization issues, and deployment regressions; maintain operational runbooks.
  • Measure automation quality through execution success, false actions avoided, latency, analyst time saved, and continuous feedback.

Experience & Qualifications

Required
  • 4+ years of relevant software engineering, security engineering, or production automation experience, including substantial hands-on Python development.
  • Strong practical skills with REST APIs, JSON, OAuth/API authentication, Git, Linux, debugging, automated testing, and secure development practices.
  • Experience integrating at least one major security domain (SIEM, EDR, SOAR, IAM, cloud security, or ticketing) and working directly with analyst workflows.
  • Ability to build safe automation with strong validation, least privilege, observability, graceful failure handling, and change control.
  • Comfort gathering requirements from operational teams and independently delivering maintainable solutions rather than one-off scripts.
  • At least one current security or automation-related certification, such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GSEC, Microsoft SC-200, or a comparable security-platform/cloud-security credential.
Preferred
  • Cortex XSOAR/XSIAM integrations, SentinelOne APIs, Python web services, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with LLM tool use or MCP integrations, including prompt-injection defenses, action approvals, and evaluation of agent reliability.
  • Knowledge of multi-tenant MSSP operations, incident-response playbooks, and secure workflow orchestration.

Compensation

  • Full-Time, Exempt
  • $70,000-$90,000/year, DOE

Benefits

  • Health Coverage – Medical, Dental & Vision
  • FSA Health and Dependent Care available
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Observed Holidays Paid
  • Cell Phone Allowance
  • Collaborative, growth-driven culture
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US. STN is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

The Vice President is accountable for the entire Rental Vehicle Claims line of business: its financial and service results, carrier and client relationships, people and operating model. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The Revenue Operations Analytics Manager is a strategic and highly visible role responsible for driving operational excellence, scalable processes, and data-driven decision-making across the revenue organization. This individual serves as a trusted partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating complex data into actionable insights that directly influence business strategy and performance.

In addition to delivering accurate and timely insights, the Senior Analyst proactively identifies opportunities to optimize processes, improve data integrity, and enhance forecasting accuracy.

Revenue Operations & Executive Reporting

  • Own and evolve executive and board-level reporting, including pipeline health, bookings, forecast accuracy, and key performance metrics.

You will independently manage assigned BlueForge Alliance (BFA)-funded projects and perform delivery work comparable to that of the project managers you supervise, with project assignments balanced against leadership responsibilities.

Working with the LOE Lead, you will translate requirements into team priorities, strengthen team performance and development, and improve the processes and tools used to deliver quality results aligned with BFA priorities.

Project Management and Delivery

Team Performance and Development

Required

jobs.title: Senior AI Infrastructure & Data Center Architect
jobs.excerpt: Position Overview MetroSys is seeking an experienced Senior AI Infrastructure & Data Center Architect to design, deploy, and optimize enterprise infrastructure environments supporting GPU-accelerated computing, artificial intelligence platforms, and high-performance workloads.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

MetroSys is seeking an experienced Senior AI Infrastructure & Data Center Architect to design, deploy, and optimize enterprise infrastructure environments supporting GPU-accelerated computing, artificial intelligence platforms, and high-performance workloads.

This is an IT infrastructure-focused position, requiring deep expertise in enterprise data center technologies, compute architecture, high-performance networking, storage systems, virtualization, and NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing complex enterprise infrastructure solutions and integrating NVIDIA GPU platforms into existing or newly developed data center environments.

This individual will be responsible for infrastructure architecture, technical assessments, solution design, hardware selection, deployment planning, and operational readiness.

The role requires a strong understanding of how GPU compute, networking, storage, and infrastructure management technologies work together to support enterprise AI workloads.

This is not an AI application development, data science, or machine learning engineering position. The focus is on building and supporting the underlying IT infrastructure required to operate enterprise AI environments.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Infrastructure & Data Center Architecture

  • Design and architect enterprise data center infrastructure supporting GPU-accelerated computing and high-performance workloads.

  • Develop end-to-end infrastructure solutions integrating compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and management platforms.

  • Assess existing customer environments and identify infrastructure requirements for deploying NVIDIA AI computing solutions.

  • Create high-level and low-level infrastructure designs, technical diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), and implementation plans.

  • Lead infrastructure discovery sessions, technical assessments, and architecture workshops with enterprise customers.

  • Evaluate hardware platforms, infrastructure dependencies, scalability requirements, and operational considerations.

  • Design highly available, resilient, and scalable infrastructure environments.

  • Provide technical guidance on data center modernization, infrastructure consolidation, and emerging accelerated computing technologies.

NVIDIA GPU & Accelerated Computing Infrastructure

  • Design infrastructure solutions utilizing NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and enterprise GPU computing platforms.

  • Architect GPU compute environments incorporating NVIDIA Hopper, Blackwell, and other accelerated computing technologies.

  • Evaluate GPU server platforms, compute density, hardware compatibility, and infrastructure sizing requirements.

  • Design and support GPU cluster infrastructure for enterprise AI and high-performance computing environments.

  • Provide architectural guidance on NVIDIA Base Command Manager, NVIDIA Mission Control, and related infrastructure management technologies.

  • Support infrastructure deployment, configuration, validation, and operational readiness for NVIDIA-based computing environments.

  • Evaluate GPU resource allocation, cluster performance, capacity requirements, and infrastructure utilization.

  • Work with hardware manufacturers and infrastructure vendors to develop integrated computing solutions.

High-Performance Networking

  • Design high-bandwidth, low-latency networking environments supporting GPU clusters and distributed computing.

  • Architect NVIDIA InfiniBand and high-speed Ethernet networking solutions.

  • Design network fabrics utilizing RoCE, RDMA, and other high-performance interconnect technologies.

  • Evaluate NVIDIA Spectrum Ethernet and Quantum InfiniBand switching technologies.

  • Develop network architectures supporting east-west traffic, high-throughput data movement, and distributed GPU workloads.

  • Integrate accelerated computing environments with existing enterprise networking infrastructure.

  • Evaluate network performance, redundancy, scalability, and resiliency requirements.

  • Troubleshoot complex network connectivity and performance issues affecting GPU infrastructure.

Enterprise Storage & Data Center Systems

  • Architect high-performance storage environments supporting GPU-intensive computing workloads.

  • Evaluate enterprise SAN, NAS, NVMe, NVMe-oF, and parallel file system technologies.

  • Design storage connectivity and data access architectures for large-scale compute clusters.

  • Integrate enterprise storage platforms with NVIDIA GPU computing environments.

  • Evaluate storage performance, throughput, latency, and scalability requirements.

  • Support infrastructure solutions involving Linux, virtualization platforms, and containerized infrastructure environments.

  • Assess data center requirements including rack architecture, power distribution, cooling, and hardware density.

  • Collaborate with facilities and infrastructure teams to ensure data center readiness for GPU-dense deployments.

Infrastructure Deployment, Operations & Management

  • Develop deployment strategies for enterprise AI infrastructure and GPU computing environments.

  • Provide technical leadership during infrastructure installation, configuration, integration, and validation.

  • Design infrastructure monitoring, performance management, and operational support processes.

  • Establish best practices for GPU cluster administration, infrastructure maintenance, and capacity management.

  • Support infrastructure automation and standardized deployment methodologies.

  • Evaluate infrastructure management tools supporting GPU systems, networking, and storage environments.

  • Identify infrastructure performance bottlenecks and recommend optimization strategies.

  • Develop operational documentation, configuration standards, and technical runbooks.

  • Support troubleshooting and escalation activities for complex infrastructure environments.

Infrastructure Security & Availability

  • Incorporate enterprise security standards into GPU computing and data center infrastructure designs.

  • Develop secure network segmentation and infrastructure access control strategies.

  • Evaluate infrastructure isolation requirements for shared computing environments.

  • Design resilient infrastructure architectures supporting availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery.

  • Collaborate with security teams to align infrastructure solutions with enterprise compliance requirements.

  • Support secure management and monitoring of GPU compute clusters and supporting infrastructure.

Technical Consulting & Architecture Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical advisor for enterprise infrastructure and accelerated computing engagements.

  • Work directly with customer infrastructure teams, IT directors, and technology leadership.

  • Translate technical requirements into infrastructure designs and implementation strategies.

  • Develop architecture documentation, technical proposals, and infrastructure equipment specifications.

  • Collaborate with technical sales teams and engineering resources during solution development.

  • Evaluate infrastructure technologies from NVIDIA, Cisco, Dell, HPE, Lenovo, AMD, and other enterprise technology providers.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and architects.

  • Present infrastructure recommendations and solution designs to technical and executive stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure engineering, data center architecture, or solutions architecture.

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing complex enterprise infrastructure environments.

  • Strong technical understanding of NVIDIA GPU computing infrastructure and accelerated computing platforms.

  • Experience with enterprise server architecture, compute platforms, and large-scale infrastructure deployments.

  • Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, including high-speed Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, or RDMA technologies.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, NVMe, and high-performance storage architectures.

  • Experience with Linux-based infrastructure environments and enterprise virtualization technologies.

  • Knowledge of GPU cluster architecture, infrastructure management, and compute resource allocation.

  • Experience developing infrastructure architecture documentation, high-level designs, low-level designs, and bills of materials.

  • Understanding of data center hardware requirements, including rack density, power, cooling, and physical infrastructure considerations.

  • Experience integrating compute, networking, and storage platforms into enterprise environments.

  • Strong troubleshooting, infrastructure assessment, and technical problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to lead customer-facing architecture discussions and provide technical recommendations.

NVIDIA Certifications

Candidates holding one or more of the following NVIDIA professional certifications are strongly preferred:

  • NVIDIA-Certified Professional: AI Infrastructure (NCP-AII) – Demonstrates expertise in NVIDIA AI infrastructure architecture, deployment, and enterprise computing environments.

  • NVIDIA-Certified Professional: AI Networking (NCP-AIN) – Demonstrates expertise in high-performance networking technologies supporting accelerated computing infrastructure.

  • NVIDIA-Certified Professional: AI Operations (NCP-AIO) – Demonstrates expertise in operating, administering, monitoring, and maintaining NVIDIA AI infrastructure environments.

Candidates with multiple NVIDIA certifications will receive additional consideration.

Equivalent hands-on experience designing and deploying NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure will also be considered.

Preferred Technical Experience

  • NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and accelerated computing platforms.

  • NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPU architectures.

  • NVIDIA Spectrum Ethernet and Quantum InfiniBand networking.

  • NVIDIA Base Command Manager and Mission Control.

  • GPU cluster design, deployment, and administration.

  • InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, and high-performance Ethernet networking.

  • Enterprise storage solutions and parallel file systems.

  • Linux infrastructure administration and cluster management.

  • Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift infrastructure.

  • VMware or other enterprise virtualization technologies.

  • Enterprise data center infrastructure and hardware integration.

  • Infrastructure automation and configuration management.

  • High-performance computing (HPC) architecture.

  • NVIDIA AI Factory infrastructure design and deployment.

jobs.title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
We are seeking freelance developers / engineers to build, configure and maintain factory data pipelines within Sight Machine / Manufacturing Data Platform (MDP) environments, supporting manufacturing analytics and operational performance improvement.

Direct Sight Machine experience is preferred, but candidates with strong transferable experience in industrial data integration and pipeline development are encouraged to apply.

Freelance Cooperation – What Does It Mean?

  • Open-ended freelance agreement. An active sole proprietorship (B2B) is required throughout the duration of the agreement.
  • Part-time engagement. Work up to 50% of full-time workload, depending on current project needs.
  • Flexibility that fits your schedule. We’ll reach out whenever a suitable project opportunity comes up. If you’re available and interested, you can choose to join the project. If the timing isn’t right, you’re always free to decline without terminating the agreement.
  • No need to worry about the equipment. Freelancers typically work using equipment provided by us. Depending on the project, you may receive access to a virtual machine instead.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

    • Integrate factory data: Connect data from PLCs, SCADA, industrial historians, MES, ERP and quality systems through connectors, APIs and database interfaces.

    • Develop pipelines: Configure ingestion and transformation flows, including filtering, cleansing, aggregation, enrichment and combining multiple data sources.

    • Contextualise manufacturing data: Map machine tags and events to assets, production lines, products, batches and production orders.

    • Ensure reliable operation: Test and deploy pipelines, validate data accuracy and completeness, monitor performance and troubleshoot ingestion or processing issues.

    • Support scalable delivery: Develop reusable mappings, templates and documentation, collaborating with plant OT/IT and manufacturing teams to translate requirements into working solutions.

CORE SKILLS:

    • Proven experience delivering industrial data integration or factory data engineering solutions.

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based performance marketing agency specializing in helping high-growth brands scale through data-driven digital advertising, creative strategy, and emerging commerce channels.

The company works with ambitious eCommerce and direct-to-consumer brands, combining performance media, creative experimentation, analytics, and technology to drive measurable growth. With a strong culture of innovation, testing, and continuous optimization, the team operates at the forefront of rapidly evolving platforms such as TikTok and social commerce.

About the Role

TikTok Shop Ads Specialist (GMV Max / Spark Ads) to lead performance and social commerce strategies for high-growth eCommerce brands.

This is a highly specialized role dedicated to the TikTok ecosystem, with a strong focus on maximizing Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) through Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, Live Shopping Ads, affiliate content, and TikTok Shop's native commerce tools.

The ideal candidate combines advanced paid media expertise with a deep understanding of how consumers discover and purchase products through TikTok. You should be comfortable managing significant advertising budgets, analyzing performance data, identifying winning creative quickly, and making real-time optimization decisions.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of performance marketing, social commerce, creative experimentation, and emerging technology.

You will have direct exposure to high-growth eCommerce brands and significant advertising budgets while helping shape TikTok Shop strategies in a fast-moving environment where creative thinking, analytical decision-making, and speed to market are critical.

What You’ll Do

TikTok Shop Media Buying

  • Build, launch, manage, and optimize Video Shopping Ads (VSA) and Product Shopping Ads (PSA) within TikTok Ads Manager.

  • Develop paid media strategies designed to increase TikTok Shop GMV while maintaining brand-specific profitability targets.

  • Continuously optimize campaign structures, bidding strategies, audiences, budgets, and creative performance.

Livestream & Social Commerce Strategy

  • Manage real-time bidding and traffic orchestration for Live Shopping Ads (LSA) during key brand events.

  • Monitor live campaign performance and make rapid adjustments based on traffic, conversion, inventory, and promotional activity.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the relationship between paid media and organic TikTok Shop activity.

Affiliate & Creator Scaling

  • Identify high-performing affiliate content through the TikTok Shop Affiliate Center.

  • Analyze affiliate performance to determine which creators and assets should receive additional paid amplification.

TikTok Shop Management

  • Monitor TikTok Shop Seller Center performance and overall account health.

  • Ensure advertising strategies remain aligned with inventory availability, promotions, product performance, and shop activity.

  • Identify potential operational or performance issues that could impact campaign results.

Creative Testing & Optimization

  • Collaborate closely with creative teams to rapidly test hooks, concepts, transitions, formats, and TikTok-native trends.

  • Use performance data and AI-driven insights to guide creative iteration.

  • Identify winning assets quickly and translate performance learnings into actionable creative recommendations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of TikTok-native content and what drives users from discovery to purchase.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Analyze and report on ROAS, CAC, settled GMV, affiliate performance, and creative effectiveness.

  • Translate TikTok's attribution and commerce data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Communicate campaign performance and strategic recommendations effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Use data to identify opportunities for additional growth and improved efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Paid Social Media Buying.

  • At least 1 year of specialized hands-on experience within the TikTok Shop ecosystem.

  • Experience working with TikTok Creative Center.

  • Strong understanding of performance creative and the ability to identify effective hooks, formats, and TikTok-native creative trends.

  • Excellent client-facing communication and presentation skills.

  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment.

Important Notes

jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

Roles & Responsibilities Overview:

The Quality Control (QC) Manager at RYZE, Inc is responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of raw materials and finished products manufactured by external partners. This role involves overseeing quality control activities at contract manufacturers, implementing quality programs, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The role will manage daily quality compliance, ensuring timely product release, reviewing non-conforming materials, and assisting in complaint investigations. This role works cross-functionally with various teams, including operations, R&D, and logistics, to maintain the highest standards for product quality, safety, and compliance.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

Responsibilities will include:


Product & Process Quality Control

  • Review Certificates of Analysis (COAs) from suppliers and third-party labs for accuracy and compliance with specifications.
  • Facilitate the testing and release/rejection of Raw Material and Finished Product samples based on established specifications.
  • Provide onsite quality support during new product launches.
  • Investigate product quality issues, including consumer complaints, deviations, and non-conformances as it pertains to contract manufacturers.
  • Lead the material review board and manage disposal of non-conforming, expiring, damaged and returned products at warehouse and 3PLs.
  • Train and lead a team of virtual QC individuals who support various QC functions.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate QC records in accordance with FDA 21 CFR Part 111/117 requirements for foods and dietary supplements.
  • Manage and approve finished product specifications and testing protocols.
  • Ensure proper retention and traceability of QC data for audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Collaborate with QA to ensure corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) are implemented for identified issues.

Testing & Laboratory Management

  • Coordinate with third-party laboratories for microbiological, chemical, analytical, and stability testing.
  • Evaluate and approve external labs, ensuring they meet ISO/IEC 17025 standards or equivalent.
  • Validate new testing methods or procedures when required.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Operations, QA, Regulatory, and R&D teams to ensure smooth product launches and ongoing quality monitoring.
  • Partner with Quality on supplier quality programs to ensure raw materials and finished product consistentlymeet quality and safety requirements.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve QC processes and product quality.
  • Implement lean or efficiency-focused initiatives to optimize QC operations.
  • Support training initiatives for cross-functional teams on QC-related topics.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends and regulatory changes affecting production quality.

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS


  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Microbiology, Biology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of QC/QA experience in food, dietary supplements, or a similar regulated industry.
  • Experience overseeing contract manufacturers and 3PLs.
  • 2+ years leading or training teams, including remote team members.
  • Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Parts 111 and 117.
  • Experience reviewing and approving COAs against specifications.
  • Experience with microbiological, chemical, analytical, and stability testing.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17025 and approving external labs.
  • Experience with method validation and maintaining specifications and testing protocols.
  • Experience investigating deviations, non-conformances, and consumer complaints, including root cause analysis.
  • Experience leading a Material Review Board and managing product disposition.
  • Working knowledge of CAPA, QC record retention, traceability, and audit readiness
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work across Operations, QA, Regulatory, and R&D.
  • Detail-oriented, with sound release and rejection judgment.
  • Able to work independently and remotely, with onsite availability for product launches.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, and in QMS, ERP, or LIMS system

Preference:

  • Master’s degree in a related scientific field.
  • Certifications such as ASQ CQA, CQE, or CMQ/OE, PCQI, HACCP, or SQF Practitioner.
  • Experience supporting new product launches with contract manufacturers.
  • Experience with supplier quality programs, including audits and approval.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement training, with a record of efficiency projects.
  • Direct experience with FDA inspections or third-party audits (NSF, GMP, SQF, BRCGS).

jobs.title: Postdoc in Real-Time Simulation of HVDC Grids and Offshore Energy Hubs - DTU Win
jobs.excerpt: We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Researcher position in real-time and electromagnetic transient simulation of converter-dominated power systems, with particular emphasis on HVDC grids, offshore wind power plants, and offshore energy hubs.
jobs.description:
We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Researcher position in real-time and electromagnetic transient simulation of converter-dominated power systems, with particular emphasis on HVDC grids, offshore wind power plants, and offshore energy hubs. The research will focus on modelling, experimental validation, stability, dynamics, and control of future converter-dominated power systems.

The Division for Power and Energy Systems at DTU Wind and Energy Systems conducts cutting-edge research on sustainable, reliable, and cost-efficient energy systems for the benefit of society. At DTU Wind and Energy Systems, you will be part of a creative and inspiring work environment with about 400 highly skilled and motivated colleagues.

We are particularly committed to increasing gender diversity in power and energy systems research and strongly encourage women and other underrepresented groups to apply.

Responsibilities and qualifications
You will be part of a dynamic and supportive research environment where you can further develop your expertise in electromagnetic transient and real-time simulation, experimental validation, and converter-dominated power systems, alongside your professional and personal skills.

You will join a vibrant research group working at the intersection of converter-based power system stability, converter control, and small- and large-signal stability analysis. Your work will focus on developing and validating electromagnetic transient (EMT) and real-time simulation models of wind power plants, power electronic converters, HVDC connections, and their control interactions. Building on our work in the Offshore Energy Hubs project, you will contribute to models and test environments for multi-terminal DC networks, offshore energy hubs, offshore wind power plants, and other converter-dominated power systems.

You will collaborate closely with PhD students, junior and senior academics, and industrial and transmission system operator partners to develop relevant models, define test scenarios, and investigate the operation, stability, and control of offshore energy systems. You will also have the opportunity to shape future research directions in electromagnetic transient and real-time simulation.

We value different perspectives, collaboration, and supportive mentoring, and we actively work to create an inclusive and respectful research culture.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Develop, implement, and validate EMT and real-time simulation models of offshore energy hubs and offshore wind power plants, including converters, HVDC connections, and associated controls
  • Design and conduct EMT and real-time simulation studies to investigate system stability, control interactions, and dynamic performance across operating conditions and disturbances, and publish the results in leading journals and conferences
  • Collaborate with international academic, industrial, and transmission system operator partners on model development, test scenarios, and assessment of control solutions
  • Contribute to supervision and mentoring of MSc and PhD students
  • Participate in research project development, execution, and dissemination, including documentation of models, test procedures, and results

The position offers flexibility to shape your research focus based on your interests and strengths.

We are looking for a candidate who has:

  • A PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Control, or a related field
  • A strong background in power system dynamics and converter-dominated power systems
  • Knowledge of power electronic converter control and its interaction with power system stability
  • Experience with modelling power electronic converters, HVDC systems, offshore wind power plants, or related converter-based power systems
  • Experience with EMT simulation and/or real-time simulation; experience with RTDS is an advantage
  • Experience with Python or equivalent tools for modelling, analysis, visualisation, or test automation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Good communication skills in English

We actively encourage applications even if you do not meet all the points.

As a formal qualification, you must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent).

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and terms of employment
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: .

The period of employment is 2 years.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Prof. Nicolaos A. Cutululis, or Senior Advisor Dr. Daniel Müller,

You can read more about DTU Wind and Energy Systems Department at

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark.

Application procedure
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 11 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

  • Application (cover letter)
  • CV
  • Academic Diplomas (MSc/PhD – in English)
  • List of publications

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Wind and Energy Systems
At DTU Wind and Energy Systems, we put knowledge to work. The department is one of the largest public research organizations for wind energy in the world with about 400 staﬀ members. We educate and train the next generation of wind power engineers. We collaborate with global leaders in the wind industries and public authorities around the world to research and develop new technologies and services to power the green transition.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 5 - Search & Voice Systems
jobs.excerpt: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world.
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Our team owns the search and voice systems that help members find what they want to watch, whether they type it or say it. We are looking for a search expert and distributed systems engineer who will set technical direction for these systems and act as a force multiplier for the engineers around them. There is significant room in this role to own and shape the strategy and roadmap for how search works at Netflix.

As an engineer in this function, you are passionate about solving challenging problems with direct business impact across a wide variety of complex distributed systems. You will be expected to work cross-functionally and drive large projects throughout their lifecycle from identifying the problem to launching in production.

Does this sound like something you'd like to do? Awesome, let's talk specifics.

What you'll do:

  • Set the technical direction and multi-quarter roadmap for search and voice, partnering closely with product, data science, and ML teams.
  • Architect and evolve large-scale retrieval, ranking, and query understanding systems, including how they handle spoken input.
  • Lead the strategy for search quality: how we measure it, what we optimize for, and how we know a change is a real improvement.
  • Raise the bar on offline evaluation and experimentation so the team can ship quality improvements quickly and with confidence.
  • Design systems that handle sensitive and moderated queries responsibly without degrading the experience for everyone else.
  • Own the reliability, latency, and scalability of low-latency distributed services operating at significant scale.
  • Mentor engineers, shape design and review culture, and grow the technical depth of the team.

What we need from you:

  • 6-8+ years of professional experience designing, building, and shipping software.
  • Deep, hands-on experience building and operating search systems at scale, with a strong command of information retrieval fundamentals: indexing, retrieval, ranking, and relevance.
  • You have experience working with large-scale, low-latency distributed systems, including sharding, replication, caching, consistency tradeoffs, and fault tolerance.
  • You are skilled in object-oriented programming and write excellent code.
  • You own what you build, beyond just your code. You have a passion for quality.
  • You are proficient in systems design. You can craft systems and solutions to realize a range of product and engineering goals.
  • You have a track record of setting technical direction beyond your own code: defining strategy, driving alignment across teams, and turning ambiguity into a roadmap.
  • You are a force multiplier. You mentor, unblock others, and improve how the team designs, evaluates, and ships.
  • You love driving real business impact by applying your software engineering, analytical, and collaborative skills across engineering, product, design, ML/data science, and consumer insights.
  • You can work through ambiguity, multi-task effectively, and are highly motivated to lead cross-functional projects and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • You strive to improve yourself and help your colleagues grow. Your co-workers think of you as someone who is kind and does excellent work.
  • You communicate effectively in both written and verbal form, especially in design docs and strategy proposals. You are a great listener and give all voices an opportunity to express themselves.
  • You are self-driven and impact-oriented. You are proactive and can move fast or pivot to meet the changing needs of the product.

Areas of depth we'd love to add:

  • You don't need all of these. Depth in one or two is a strong signal.
  • Offline evaluation: relevance metrics (NDCG, MRR, precision/recall), human judgment pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and connecting offline metrics to online A/B outcomes
  • Query understanding: intent detection, entity resolution, spelling correction, query rewriting, and LLM-based approaches
  • ML for search: learning to rank, embeddings, and semantic and hybrid retrieval
  • Trust and safety in search: moderation frameworks, sensitive query handling, and policy-aware ranking and filtering
  • Voice and conversational interfaces: ASR error handling, spoken query ambiguity, and multimodal input

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $388,000.00 - $619,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. jobs.excerpt: The Workforce Scheduling Analyst is responsible for both intraday workforce management and short- to medium-term scheduling.
jobs.description:
The Workforce Scheduling Analyst is responsible for both intraday workforce management and short- to medium-term scheduling. This role monitors operational performance, real-time adherence, schedule conformance, staffing levels, and shrinkage; creates and maintains employee schedules; and makes timely adjustments to align capacity with changing business demand. The analyst partners with Operations, Training, and Workforce Management leadership to support service levels, employee experience, compliance, and efficient labor utilization across phone, chat, and offline work.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor phone, chat, and offline performance against service level, volume, staffing, occupancy, utilization, and other operational targets.

  • Make intraday adjustments to assignments, activities, breaks, lunches, and offline work based on current demand, staffing, queue conditions, and real-time shrinkage, including unplanned absences and other outages.

  • Build schedules that appropriately account for planned shrinkage, including PTO, holidays, training, coaching, team meetings, offline work, breaks, lunches, and other approved activities.

  • Create, maintain, and refine employee shift schedules using historical performance, staffing forecasts, anticipated workload, employee availability, labor rules, and business requirements.

  • Support time off planning and administration based on forecasted demand, available staffing, operational thresholds, and approved business rules.

  • Identify potential overstaffing, understaffing, coverage gaps, or schedule conflicts before they affect service delivery, and recommend corrective action.
  • Provide timely intraday reporting, impact analysis, and recommendations to Operations and WFM leadership.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years workforce management experience in contact center environment; healthcare industry experience strongly preferred

  • Working knowledge of intraday management concepts, including adherence, conformance, service level, staffing, shrinkage, interval coverage, and queue or channel balancing.

  • Advanced Google Sheets or spreadsheet skills, including formulas, filtering, pivot tables, and trend analysis.

  • Experience creating operational reports or dashboards using workforce management, business intelligence, or reporting tools.

  • Excellent time management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and effectively organize competing priorities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Operations, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred.

  • Leading, implementing and driving efficiency optimization projects

  • 1+ year experience with CXOne and/or NICE IEX strongly preferred

  • Healthcare specific workforce management experience

  • Interest and/or experience utilizing AI to optimize work flows and increase team efficiencies

  • Team player mentality, willingness to take on a variety of tasks within WFM

The base salary range for this full-time position is $65,000 – $75,000 per year in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C).

For context, these markets include Zone A (e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), Zone B (e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and Zone C (e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured salary bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.

Benefits & Perks:

In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:

Remote-first culture

401(k) savings plan through Fidelity

Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage through multiple medical plan options (including disability insurance)

Paid Time Off ("PTO") and Discretionary Time Off ("DTO")

12 weeks of 100% Paid Parental leave

Family Building & Compassionate Leave: Fertility coverage, $25,000 for surrogacy/adoption, and paid leave for failed treatments, adoption or pregnancies.

Work-From-Home reimbursement to support team collaboration home office work

jobs.title: Outbound Account Development Representative - DACH
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in the DACH region: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

We have offices in Paris and Amsterdam, and offer remote working from Germany, France, the Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

You should apply if

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You’re excited by AI: you’ll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

Minimum requirements for the role

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in German
  • AI Literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

  • ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.
  • ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.
  • ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.excerpt: Join AIR as a Principal Researcher and use your experience and knowledge to help us deliver on our mission: to generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.
jobs.description:
Join AIR as a Principal Researcher and use your experience and knowledge to help us deliver on our mission: to generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all. The Principal Researcher will provide senior intellectual and strategic leadership for AIR’s work in career and technical education (CTE) and career pathways, bringing deep subject matter expertise to a growing portfolio of research and evaluation work.

The Principal Researcher will provide leadership across projects, cultivate relationships with clients and partners, and help shape and develop new opportunities in the CTE and career pathways field. Serving as a trusted advisor to clients, collaborators, and multidisciplinary teams, the Principal Researcher will contribute thought leadership, mentorship, and strategic direction while helping strengthen and grow AIR’s CTE and career pathways portfolio.

This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR’s U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

About AIR:

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert on CTE and career pathways, including programs of study, career exploration and navigation, work-based learning, dual enrollment, industry-recognized credentials, career advising, employer engagement, secondary-postsecondary alignment, and transitions into postsecondary education and the workforce.
  • Provide strategic direction for AIR’s CTE and career pathways portfolio, helping to identify and shape emerging policy, research, and funding opportunities.
  • Provide intellectual and methodological leadership as principal investigator, project director, or senior technical advisor for studies using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, student-level longitudinal administrative data, state longitudinal data systems, and linked education and workforce data.
  • Advise clients and project teams on the design, implementation, continuous improvement, and evaluation of CTE and career pathways initiatives.
  • Lead business development and capture efforts, including opportunity identification and shaping, development of technical approaches and research designs, partnership and staffing strategies, proposal writing, and client engagement.
  • Cultivate and maintain strategic relationships with federal and state agencies, foundations, policymakers, research partners, practitioners, intermediaries, and other leaders in the CTE and career pathways field.
  • Represent AIR through conferences, professional networks, publications, webinars, and other thought-leadership activities.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop researchers and project leaders and help build AIR’s organizational capacity in CTE, career pathways, and related research methods.

Qualifications:

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Master’s degree in education, economics, public policy, sociology, statistics, or another relevant social science field, and a minimum of 11 years of relevant applied research experience; PhD preferred.
  • Deep professional expertise in CTE and career pathways research, policy, or program implementation.
  • Strong expertise in research and evaluation methods and demonstrated ability to provide intellectual and technical leadership for rigorous studies of education policies and programs.
  • Proven track record of developing new research opportunities, securing funding, and leading successful proposals or grants.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining senior relationships with government, foundation, research, or practitioner clients and partners.

Skills

  • Ability to think strategically, connect CTE research to policy and practice needs, and contribute to the development of a sustainable portfolio of work.

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

.

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Engineer, Cloud Security

About the job

This position is needed to lead the strategic design, implementation, and governance of Twilio's global cloud security architecture and infrastructure.

As a Principal Cloud Security Engineer, you will shape Twilio's cloud security strategy, driving secure-by-default architecture across multi-cloud environments. You will tackle complex infrastructure challenges, championing robust protection mechanisms at scale. By partnering with engineering teams globally, you will foster a culture of proactive security, ensuring our platforms remain highly secure and resilient.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Architect and implement secure-by-default cloud infrastructure blueprints across AWS, GCP and Azure and multi-cloud environments.
  • Lead threat modeling and vulnerability assessments on complex cloud architectures to mitigate systemic risks.
  • Drive the automation of cloud security controls and compliance checks.
  • Partner with engineering leaders to Own the Outcome of security remediation and incident response initiatives.
  • Mentor senior engineers, fostering a collaborative security culture that prioritizes We > Me.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 12+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a dedicated focus on cloud security engineering.
  • Deep expertise in AWS security services, IAM policy design, and cloud infrastructure security.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Strong Experience with container security and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing secure-by-default cloud architectures at enterprise scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex threat modeling and risk assessment exercises for cloud systems.
  • Strong understanding of AI Security, including securing models, agents, and agentic harnesses within cloud environments.
  • Exceptional communication skills to articulate technical security risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Desired:

  • Advanced cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Security Specialty, CCSP, or CCSK).
  • Experience utilizing AI agents to automate cloud security operations, workflows, and use cases.
  • Background in automated compliance monitoring and cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools.
  • Active participant in the broader cloud security community or open-source security projects.

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA, Washington D.C. area.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland (outside of the DC area), Massachusetts, Minnesota, or Vermont: $192,560 - $240,700.
