jobs.excerpt: About QC Servion QC Servion is the centralized hub for human resources, change management, program management, sales & marketing, safety, administration, legal, and accounting services across the QC Ecosystem.
jobs.description:
About QC Servion

QC Servion is the centralized hub for human resources, change management, program management, sales & marketing, safety, administration, legal, and accounting services across the QC Ecosystem.

We provide comprehensive operational support that empowers our companies to focus on growth, innovation, and excellence, while ensuring employees thrive in safe, engaging, and well-managed environments.

The entities in our ecosystem include DLB Associates, Galtra Solutions, AI2IO, Fluid2Chip, CEQEL Critical Commissioning, and 2AI-DC Integrators. Collectively, we deliver services across the data center industry.

Position:Program Manager

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

QC Servion recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Program Manager to drive day-to-day execution of large-scale data center programs across the QC Ecosystem. This is the role that keeps everything moving — coordinating across ecosystem entities, partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure commitments are executed, milestones are achieved, and issues are resolved before they impact delivery.

This role sits at the intersection of program planning, execution, and coordination. In addition to overseeing active program delivery, the Program Manager helps coordinate new opportunities as they move from proposal and planning through mobilization and kickoff, ensuring key stakeholders are engaged, execution plans are aligned, and critical milestones remain on track.

Essential Functions

Program Execution & Delivery

  • Drive day-to-day execution against master program schedules and phase-gate milestones.
  • Coordinate activities across ecosystem entities, consultants, contractors, vendors, and client stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary coordination point between the PMO and teams executing work in the field.
  • Facilitate working sessions that keep projects aligned, risks visible, and decisions moving forward.
  • Monitor program performance and proactively identify potential impacts to schedule, scope, and delivery.
  • Maintain accountability for action items, commitments, and program deliverables.

Program Mobilization & Kickoff Coordination

  • Support the transition of new opportunities from proposal development through program kickoff.
  • Coordinate across QC Ecosystem entities to align scope, deliverables, staffing plans, schedules, and execution assumptions.
  • Track pre-award, mobilization, and startup milestones to ensure readiness for execution.
  • Identify gaps, risks, and dependencies during planning and mobilization activities.
  • Facilitate kickoff planning and ensure successful handoff from business development and proposal teams to delivery teams.
  • Help establish governance structures, communication plans, reporting cadence, and stakeholder alignment before execution begins.

Schedule, Risk & Issue Management

  • Maintain the working program schedule and identify slippage before it becomes a delivery issue.
  • Monitor risks, issues, dependencies, and constraints across multiple workstreams.
  • Drive issue resolution by assigning ownership, establishing timelines, and following through to completion.
  • Escalate risks and challenges to program leadership when appropriate.
  • Support phase-gate reviews and readiness assessments.

Cross-Entity Coordination

  • Coordinate activities across multiple QC Ecosystem entities and external partners.
  • Facilitate collaboration between technical, operational, commercial, and delivery teams.
  • Ensure stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, timelines, and responsibilities.
  • Support communication between leadership teams, project teams, and field personnel.

Program Reporting & Governance

  • Own execution-focused program reporting and status updates.
  • Partner with Project Controls and Business Analysts to ensure accurate reporting and visibility.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly program updates for stakeholders and leadership.
  • Maintain program documentation, action logs, risk registers, and decision tracking.
  • Support governance reviews and executive reporting requirements.

What Success Looks Like

  • Program milestones are achieved and phase-gate requirements are completed successfully.
  • New opportunities transition smoothly from proposal through mobilization and kickoff.
  • Scope, staffing plans, schedules, and execution expectations are aligned before delivery begins.
  • Risks, issues, and dependencies are identified and addressed before impacting program execution.
  • Cross-entity teams remain coordinated and accountable throughout the lifecycle of the program.
  • Stakeholders have clear visibility into program status, priorities, risks, and next steps.
  • Program reporting is accurate, timely, and actionable.
  • Leadership has confidence that commitments are being tracked, managed, and executed effectively.

Position Requirements

  • 8–10+ years of program or project management experience within:
    • Data center development
    • Construction
    • Infrastructure
    • Utilities
    • Energy
    • EPC or capital project delivery environments
  • Proven experience coordinating multiple projects, vendors, consultants, contractors, or delivery partners within a single program.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Program execution
    • Schedule management
    • Risk management
    • Cross-functional coordination
    • Phase-gate and readiness processes
  • Experience supporting programs from planning, proposal, pre-construction, or mobilization phases through execution and closeout.
  • Ability to operate effectively with incomplete information while continuing to drive decisions, accountability, and progress.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across executive, operational, and field-level stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • PMP, CCM, or similar certification preferred.
  • Hyperscale data center programs.
  • Owner's Representative environments.
  • Multi-vendor program management.
  • Large-scale capital project delivery.
  • Infrastructure, utility, or energy programs.
  • Program mobilization, pursuit support, or pre-construction planning activities.
  • Experience coordinating multiple organizations under a shared governance structure.

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
  • Frequently moving through home office.
  • May occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 25%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Benefits

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option).
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA).
  • Dental and vision plans.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26.
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option.
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year.
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage.
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and professional licensing assistance.
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment.

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is QC Servion's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

EEO

QC Servion provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Notice To Third Party Agencies
QC Servion does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to QC Servion in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where QC Servion has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of QC Servion and QC Servion will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. jobs.excerpt: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

⭐️ Our Third Party & Outsourcing Risk Management Team

We are a high-performing Global team focused on delivering pragmatic Third Party Risk Management (‘TPRM’) that protects Monzo and our customers globally. As Monzo expands across new markets and scales its product range, the operational footprint is growing fast, and the operating environment is becoming more complex.

We’re looking for a Senior Third Party Risk Manager to help shape and deliver our approach. As well as ensuring Monzo’s TPRM has well defined controls, processes and governance models in place to meet the continually growing and evolving demands of global Third Party Risk Management regulations - you’ll also set priorities and turn them into measurable improvements.

Reporting to the Director of Third Party Risk, this is a hands-on role, with strategic scope. You’ll work across the global team, and with a variety of stakeholders throughout Monzo, to strengthen our framework, manage complex risks and improve how we deliver TPRM both tactically and strategically.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Delivering Core TPRM Operations Globally: Operating end-to-end operational activities, including supplier tiering, materiality assessments, due diligence reviews, exit planning support, and regulatory reporting.
  • Driving Operational Excellence: Taking ownership of process quality, making sure TPRM activities are completed accurately, consistently and on time. You’ll look for ways to improve how we manage third party risk in practice.
  • Helping shape our priorities: Identifying emerging risks, gaps and opportunities across third party risk management, and making recommendations to inform the team’s strategy and roadmap. You’ll develop practical solutions and help deliver improvements through to completion.
  • Enabling Strategic Delivery: Supporting and feeding into higher-level strategic initiatives and complex risk landscapes. Leading agreed initiatives from problem definition through implementation autonomously, working across teams and global markets to deliver measurable improvements and ensuring clear visibility throughout.
  • Collaborating Across Teams: Working directly with internal stakeholders across the 3LOD, and external suppliers to clear blockers, follow up on actions, and resolve issues effectively.
  • Sharing your expertise: Support colleagues and stakeholders with practical guidance, helping them understand how to deliver their third party risk responsibilities.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You know Outsourcing, Third Party Risk & Regulation: You have substantial practical TPRM experience (ideally in banking or financial services) operating in both the UK and EU financial markets.
  • You’ve contributed to a risk strategy, framework or operating model: You can demonstrate how you translated an identified gap into a practical improvement.
  • You’re comfortable leading complex assessments: You make balanced, well-reasoned recommendations when information is incomplete or stakeholders have different priorities.
  • You have experience working with various technologies: TPR tooling and AI to build innovative solutions and streamline operational workflows.
  • You hold a high quality bar: You pay close attention to detail and care about accuracy. You use data and reporting to spot patterns, make evidence-based decisions and improve processes.
  • You take ownership: You work independently, take initiative and prioritise your workload in a fast-moving environment. You use sound risk judgement and know when to seek guidance or involve others.
  • You focus on outcomes, not just activity: You measure success by what has materially improved whether that's faster turnaround times, clearer risk ownership, or cleaner supplier data.
  • You are a clear, pragmatic communicator: You build strong relationships with internal teams, third parties and regulators. You’re comfortable holding colleagues accountable and offering constructive challenges when needed. You bring together input from specialists across Information Security, Data Protection, Legal and Operational Resilience to form a clear view of risk.
  • You are comfortable escalating: You use sound judgement to know when to involve your team or manager in emerging issues or concerns, and communicate your priorities and workload clearly and regularly, defaulting to transparency and taking accountability.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £85,000 - £115,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

  • Short call with a Monzo Recruiter
  • Video-call with the Hiring Manager
  • Full-Loop Interviews (1 x Role Specific + 1 x Behavioural)

Full Loop interviews will take place in January 2027 🥳Thanks for your patience!

The Data Modeler will support the design, development, and maintenance of logical and physical data models that enable analytics, reporting, and operational data use cases. This role works with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into structured data solutions while applying established enterprise data modeling standards and practices. The Data Modeler contributes to data quality, consistency, and usability across systems while developing expertise in enterprise data modeling, data warehousing, data integration, and database technologies.

What you will do:

  • Design and maintain logical and physical data models for operational, analytics, and reporting use cases, including dimensional, normalized, and relational models under guidance from senior team members.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into structured data definitions, entities, relationships, and model components.
  • Apply enterprise naming conventions, data standards, and modeling practices consistently across deliverables, and maintain model documentation, metadata, versioning, and change tracking.
  • Create and maintain modeling artifacts, including entity relationship diagrams (ERDs), data mappings, model definitions, and supporting documentation.
  • Perform data profiling, validation, and quality reviews to support model accuracy, consistency, and usability, and assist in troubleshooting data structure, lineage, mapping, and integration issues.
  • Support data warehouse development and data integration initiatives across multiple systems while collaborating with data engineers, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to clarify data requirements.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, with 2 to 4 years of experience in data modeling, database design, analytics engineering, or a related data discipline.
  • Working knowledge of logical and physical data modeling concepts, dimensional modeling, and relational database design principles.
  • Experience using SQL for querying, validation, and data analysis, along with experience using data modeling tools such as ER/Studio, ERwin, or similar platforms and familiarity with cloud database or warehouse technologies such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, Athena, Snowflake, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, Canada)
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

About the Infrastructure group

We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.

You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.

We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.

How we work

Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.

Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.
  • Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.
  • Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.
  • Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.
  • Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.
  • Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.
  • Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.
  • Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage
  • Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.
  • A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.
  • The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.
  • Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.
  • You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability
  • Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.
  • Building self-service infrastructure for application teams
  • Running observability for a production platform at scale
  • Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure
  • You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"

In Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $192,891 CAD - $231,469 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior QA Engineer, Runtime

By governing the use of AI across the development lifecycle, Unqork empowers enterprises with a new way to leverage AI to build, run, and evolve complex, mission-critical software without creating unvetted, unsecured code. Unqork helps enterprises, like Goldman Sachs, Marsh, and BlackRock accelerate digital transformation while reducing risk and total cost of ownership across their application portfolio.

At Unqork, we value inclusive and innovative thinkers who boldly challenge the status quo. We encourage you to apply!

The Team:

The Runtime team owns the programming model and engine that runs every application built on Unqork. We keep today's runtime stable, fast, and secure for enterprise customers, and we are actively building the next generation. We ship fast, and we hold the highest bar for quality and security while we do it.

What U’ll Do:

  • Own test automation for the Runtime team. Design, write, and maintain Playwright test suites that cover critical runtime flows and run on every pull request and release. Keep them fast, deterministic, and trusted. A flaky test is a bug to fix, not a test to rerun.
  • Review automation as code. Review the tests engineers write with their features, hold them to the same standard as production code, and coach the team on writing tests that catch real regressions.
  • Gate releases with automation. Wire suites into CI/CD (GitHub Actions) as quality gates, track pass rate, flakiness, and run time, and decide when a release is ready to ship.
  • Test proactively. Join feature refinement early, define testability requirements and acceptance criteria, and have tests ready as features land, not after.
  • Raise the security bar. Build checks for authentication, authorization, input handling, and data exposure into the suite, and partner with Security to turn findings into regression tests.
  • Build and run performance tests. Write k6 load and stress tests for runtime APIs and rendering paths, set baselines, and catch regressions in CI before customers do.
  • Use AI to scale coverage. Use Claude Code, Gemini, and similar tools to generate test scaffolding, triage failures, and grow regression coverage faster. Review their output with the rigor you'd apply to a teammate's code.
  • Modernize legacy coverage. Migrate historical CodeceptJS and Selenium tests to Playwright, and retire tests that no longer earn their run time.
  • Close the loop on escaped bugs. Reproduce and isolate customer-reported issues, file clear bugs with evidence and severity, and turn every escape into an automated test so it can't come back.
  • Explore where automation can't. Do focused exploratory testing in the browser with DevTools, and build complex, nested applications that act like real customer use cases and push the runtime to its limits.

The Impact U will make:

  • Deliver a regression suite the team trusts enough to ship on.
  • Find and close gaps in our test suites using client use cases, past bug patterns, and customer feedback.
  • Raise the quality and security bar while increasing how fast we ship.
  • Become the Runtime team's trusted voice on whether something is ready to ship.

What U bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Engineering or Software Engineering, with at least 3 focused on test automation.
  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript experience required. Your test code reads like production code.
  • Deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining E2E suites with Playwright.
  • A track record of building a stable regression suite from scratch, or turning a flaky one around, with the metrics to show it.
  • Experience reviewing other engineers' test code and setting automation standards for a team.
  • A solid grasp of web development: HTML, CSS, the DOM, HTTP and REST APIs, browser DevTools, and how modern front-end apps render and manage state.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.

The Infrastructure Software Engineering team develops production services, APIs, and automation that support the full infrastructure lifecycle, from provisioning and bring-up through monitoring, maintenance, and decommissioning. Success means faster partner activation and time-to-value, stronger adoption and engagement, more partners completing onboarding through self-service experiences, less dependency on manual enablement, and ultimately more partners building profitable offerings around Horizon.

Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.

Working Within Our Values:

At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers.
    • Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.
  • Client: Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes.
    • Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.
  • People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise.
    • Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.
  • Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation.
    • Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development.

Qualifications

  • You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
  • You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
  • You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
  • You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
  • You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
  • You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.

---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

jobs.description:
This role builds the data foundation of a Legal Entity Platform: an AI-ready, single source of truth for ownership and control data across 8,000+ legal entities. The first phase is a pilot for one investment fund, starting in December 2026.

The scope covers source ingestion into AWS and Snowflake, a unified entity model with a unique Entity ID, and a point-in-time ownership graph (14+ levels) that calculates economic ownership percentages. It also includes data lineage, quality checks, and access control. Work is done in the client’s AWS accounts through a VDI.

Requirements

What you will do

  • Build automated ingestion pipelines from source-system CSV/XML exports into S3 and Snowflake (Snowpipe), and work around incomplete or limited source APIs.

  • Design an all-tiers entity data model with a unique Entity ID and a crosswalk to source systems.

  • Support fuzzy name and alias resolution together with the AI/ML lead.

  • Build a point-in-time ownership graph (14+ levels, effective-dated relationships) and deterministic economic-ownership calculations.

  • Capture lineage on every attribute (source, as-of date, owner, AI confidence) and route low-confidence AI matches to a data steward review queue.

  • Implement ingestion checks, source-precedence rules, register reconciliation, and role-, region- and attribute-level access.

About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Role Overview

Role:

IonQ is seeking a Senior Director, Global Payroll to own payroll strategy, operations and compliance for a rapidly growing, multinational workforce. IonQ is a leader in quantum computing, networking and sensing, with teams across multiple countries and a business that has expanded through both organic growth and acquisitions.

As our footprint grows, we need a payroll leader who can build a scalable, compliant and globally consistent function that keeps pace with the business. The role sits within the Finance organisation, reports to the Global Controller, and partners closely with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, HR, People Operations, Legal and Global Mobility.

Responsibilities:

You will own accurate, timely and compliant pay for every IonQ employee worldwide, and build the team, processes and controls to do it at scale. You will lead payroll operations end to end across every country where IonQ employs people, across in-house and outsourced models, and manage payroll providers, local vendors and in-country advisers on service levels, performance and cost.

You will own shadow payroll for employees on international assignments, including home and host country withholding, reporting and filing, and administer tax equalisation and tax protection policies, from hypothetical tax calculations through settlements and year-end reconciliations. You will coordinate assignment dates, cost projections and employee communications with Global Mobility, HR, Tax and external providers.

You will lead payroll due diligence and integration for acquired companies, covering data conversion, system migration, entity and registration set-up and harmonisation of pay practices, and you will remediate the compliance gaps and mismatches that acquisitions bring. Alongside this, you will partner with HRIS, IT and Finance Systems on the payroll technology roadmap and drive automation that reduces manual work, errors and cycle time.

You will build, develop and lead a high-performing global payroll team of managers, specialists and external partners, with clear roles, documentation and backup coverage so that payroll never depends on a single person.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Set global payroll strategy, standards and an operating model that balances local compliance with global consistency.
  • Partner with Tax, Legal and local advisers to monitor statutory changes and keep IonQ compliant in every jurisdiction.
  • Design and maintain internal controls over payroll that meet SOX and audit requirements for a public company.
  • Ensure accurate payroll accounting, reconciliations, accruals and general ledger postings, and oversee payroll tax filings, statutory reporting and year-end processes in every country.
  • Build a repeatable acquisition integration playbook, and give leadership clear reporting on payroll cost, headcount, risk and operational metrics.

Requirements:

You will have at least ten years of progressive payroll experience, including at least ten years in a senior leadership role managing a team, and a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

You will have run payroll on a global scope across multiple countries, with a strong understanding of local statutory requirements, tax and social contribution rules and common compliance pitfalls. You will have designed and run shadow payroll for internationally mobile employees, including multi-jurisdiction withholding and reporting, and you will have working knowledge of tax equalisation and tax protection, including hypothetical tax, settlements and equalisation reconciliations.

You will know payroll controls, audit readiness and SOX or equivalent compliance well, and you will have managed a mix of in-house payroll teams and outsourced or in-country vendors. You will be a calm, detail-driven operator with a global perspective and real integrity with confidential compensation and personal data, able to explain complex payroll and tax topics to non-experts and to earn trust across Finance, HR and Tax.

You’d be a great fit with:

  • Experience leading payroll through one or more acquisition integrations, including due diligence, entity and system consolidation and post-close remediation.
  • Experience in a high-growth, publicly traded or technology-driven company where headcount and entity count change quickly.
  • Experience implementing or consolidating global payroll platforms, including a global payroll aggregator or provider, and systems such as Workday, ADP and NetSuite.
  • Familiarity with the payroll treatment of equity compensation across jurisdictions, such as withholding on RSU vesting and option exercises.
  • A professional certification such as CPP or FPC, a Master's degree or CPA, or experience in a deep-tech, scientific or government-contracting environment.

jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

SR. LEGAL COUNSEL (P5)

  • Job Title: Sr. Legal Counsel
  • Reports to: Sr. Managing Counsel
  • Department: Legal

Position Summary

The Sr. Legal Counsel is a senior-level individual contributor who independently leads Black Duck's most complex commercial negotiations and provides strategic, practical legal advice on revenue-generating customer transactions, vendor and supplier agreements, and other sophisticated commercial matters. The role serves as lead counsel and quarterback for negotiations from intake through signature, including agreements on customer or vendor paper and transactions involving material legal, financial, operational, security, privacy, intellectual property, product, revenue-recognition, or reputational risk. The position partners closely with Sales, Deal Desk/Sales Operations, Procurement, Finance, Product, Security, Privacy, and other stakeholders; translates risk into clear business options; coordinates subject-matter input and approvals; and drives matters to timely resolution. The role provides experienced coverage and continuity for the commercial legal function, handles escalations with limited guidance, develops scalable contracting standards and playbooks, drives process improvement and efficiency through CLM and AI-enabled tools, and coaches less-experienced team members. From time to time, the role may also support Product and Engineering on artificial intelligence and open-source licensing matters.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

Complex Customer and Vendor Agreements and Commercial Negotiations

  • Independently lead complex customer negotiations end to end, from contract intake and issue identification through internal alignment, negotiation, approval, signature, and transition to post-signature owners.
  • Draft, review, interpret, and negotiate sophisticated revenue-generating agreements, including Software License and Services Agreements, SaaS and hosted-services agreements, enterprise license agreements, master services agreements, order forms, amendments and addenda, professional services agreements, evaluation agreements, partner and reseller agreements, nondisclosure agreements, and related documents.
  • Negotiate customer paper and significant deviations from Black Duck's standard positions, developing strategy, prioritizing issues, proposing practical fallback positions, and engaging directly with customer counsel, procurement, and business stakeholders on material issues involving intellectual property, data rights, information security, privacy, artificial intelligence, warranties, indemnities, liability, audit rights, service levels, acceptance, termination, payment, and revenue recognition.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate vendor and supplier agreements, including SaaS and software subscriptions, technology and data licenses, professional and consulting services agreements, data processing agreements, and other procurement contracts, partnering with Procurement, Security, Privacy, and Finance to manage third-party risk and protect Black Duck's data, intellectual property, and operations.
  • Negotiate AI-related contract terms, including use of customer data, AI-generated output, model training restrictions, and related warranties and indemnities.
  • Serve as senior commercial escalation counsel and provide reliable coverage for the most complex negotiations as needed, working closely with the Sr. Managing Counsel.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Risk Management

  • Coordinate input from Sales, Procurement, Finance, Revenue Accounting, Product, Security, Privacy, Tax, Compliance, and other subject matter experts; clearly identify decision points, owners, and required approvals.
  • Advise senior leaders and internal clients on legal and commercial risk, available courses of action, and practical mitigation strategies that support business objectives and timely deal closure.
  • Determine when non-standard requests may be accepted under established guidance and when escalation or additionalauthorization is required.
  • Identify recurring legal and process issues and recommend changes to policies, training, and approval frameworks.
  • From time to time, partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and Privacy to align Black Duck's legal and contractual posture with AI developments in its products, and review new product releases to confirm that third-party and open-source components are used in compliance with applicable license terms.

Commercial Legal Standards and Team Capability

  • Develop and maintain customer- and vendor-contract templates, clause libraries, negotiation playbooks, guidance, and other scalable resources for the commercial legal function.
  • Coach and mentor contract professionals and other legal team members on negotiation strategy, issue spotting, drafting, escalation, and stakeholder management; review work on complex matters as needed.
  • Actively drive process improvement and efficiency in the commercial contracting function, partnering with Legal Operations and business teams to optimize CLM workflows, identify and implement AI-enabled tools and automation, and reduce cycle times and avoidable friction.
  • Manage outside counsel or other legal service providers where specialized assistance or additional capacity is appropriate.
  • Other tasks and activities as assigned.

Required Education/Experience & Skills

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) or equivalent law degree from an accredited institution.
  • Active license and good standing to practice law in at least one applicable jurisdiction.
  • Typically7 - 10 years of relevant legal experience, including substantial commercial-contracting experience in a law firm, in-house legal department, or a combination of both.
  • Expert drafting skills, with a demonstrated ability to draft and revise precise, clear, and commercially practical contract language, including on short timelines and in response to complex customer redlines.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex business-to-business technology transactions, negotiating customer paper with sophisticated enterprise customers, and negotiating vendor and supplier agreements.
  • Deep knowledge of software licensing, SaaS and hosted services, professional services, intellectual property, data rights, privacy and security contracting, legal and contractual issues relating to artificial intelligence, indemnities, limitations of liability, warranties, and other core commercial terms; familiarity with open-source licensing a plus.
  • Working knowledge of contract lifecycle management systems and demonstrated interest in using AI-enabled legal tools and automation to improve contracting speed, quality, and scalability.
  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional subject-matter input, distinguish material issues from lower-risk points, and drive decisions and closure with limited guidance.
  • Strong negotiation, project leadership, and executive communication skills, including the ability to explain difficult or sensitive legal and commercial concepts clearly.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, build consensus, manage competing priorities, and remain effective during high-value or time-sensitive negotiations.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring legal and contracts professionals and developing templates, playbooks, or scalable contracting guidance.
  • Experience in enterprise software, cybersecurity, SaaS, artificial intelligence, or another global business-to-business technology environment strongly preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • General office environment and responsibilities requiring extensive computer use and routine telephone or video communications.
  • Occasionally moving and lifting objects up to 20 pounds.
  • May require up to 10% travel as needed.

Your success is a train ride away!

As we move America’s workforce toward the future, Amtrak connects businesses and communities across the country. We employ more than 20,000 diverse, energetic professionals in a variety of career fields throughout the United States. The safety of our passengers, our employees, the public and our operating environment is our priority, and the success of our railroad is due to our employees.

Are you ready to join our team?

Our values of ‘Do the Right Thing, Excel Together and Put Customers First’ are at the heart of what matters most to us, and our Core Capabilities, ‘Building Trust, Accountability, Effective Communication, Customer Focus, and Proactive Safety & Security’ are what every employee needs to know and do to be most impactful at Amtrak. By living the Amtrak values, focusing on our capabilities, and actively embracing and fostering diverse ideas, backgrounds, and perspectives, together we will honor our past and make Amtrak a company of the future.

Job Summary

The Distinguished Architect - Asset and Infrastructure Transformation is responsible for providing visionary companywide architecture services to ensure portfolio technology investments are in alignment with corporate goals and its ability to move towards the future in an evolving business environment. As a Digital Technology expert, this role will utilize communication, influence, guidance, and governance processes to maximize return on technology investment, and reduce time to capability, while minimizing operational costs. The Distinguished Architect will use visionary strategic thinking to choose technology capabilities, strategize and build around them to bring value to business relevant capability change.

As part of the DT architecture team the Distinguished Architect will be responsible for communicating technology target state, roadmap and change progress to portfolio leaders and other stakeholders. They will use their communication and influence skills to promote awareness and understanding of architecture principles across the organization, evangelizing for strategic enterprise change, executing strategy, technical leadership.

Essential Functions

  • Set up the architectural vision for core capabilities and aligning patterns to allow for consistency and reuse
  • Define enterprise principles, patterns and guidance that help in technology data capabilities, platforms and infrastructure, how applications are built, deployed, and maintained to align with strategic needs and maximizing technology investments
  • Provide Oversight and Governance to the current, interim and potential future state of key architecture domains to ensure value alignment with the organization's overall goals and objectives.
  • Ensure the reference architectures, standards, and guidelines of the organization's technology is safe, secure, stable and compliant with industry standards.
  • Drive adoption and re-use of the preferred resources, processes and technology across multiple or cross functional portfolios.
  • Mentor other architects and DT teams, providing guidance and fostering a culture of excellence.
  • Effectively communicate at all levels from senior leadership and throughout the company
  • Create strategic roadmaps and comprehensive plans that outline how the Digital Technology architecture will evolve to drive organization change, support the business strategy over time, and ensure DT initiatives are prioritized based on their expected business value and strategic importance.
  • Guide Investment Decisions Aligning technology plans and investments to business vision and strategy that is necessary to ensure we are building the right things.
  • Envision architecture patterns and strategies that drive significant competitive differentiation and business transformation]
  • Solve the most intricate and ambiguous architectural challenges that span multiple domains, systems, and business units, providing definitive technical direction.
  • Design, govern, and oversee the implementation of robust, scalable, and efficient architectural solutions for cross domain business problems.
  • Translate complex technical ideas into digestible concepts for both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between engineering and business teams to ensure alignment and understanding.
  • Assist in the identification, evaluation, and adoption of groundbreaking technologies and architectural patterns that drive significant competitive differentiation and business transformation
  • Work closely with Solution Architects and engineering leads to translate requirements into robust technical design on for our most complex technical solutions
  • In our major enterprise initiatives and complex systems of systems, ensuring products are scalable, secure, performant, and maintainable.
  • Provide expert technical guidance, and contribute to the evolution of our architectural standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data and intelligence or related field with 13+ year’s relevant experience or equivalent work experience with at least 5 years in a Principal or Senior Principal Architect role within a large, complex enterprise.
  • Must have repeated experience successfully directing significantly complex architecture initiatives over $7 million, developing capabilities that typically involve different stakeholders, multiple lines of business, many solution varieties, highly regulated environments, business transformations at mass scale.
  • Advanced expertise in asset lifecycle management and engineering systems, including AI-driven predictive maintenance, condition-based monitoring, machine learning, digital twins, and real-time streaming analytics for asset health diagnostics and failure prediction.
  • Proven ability to architect scalable integrations across enterprise asset management platforms such as IBM Maximo, SAP EAM, and Infor EAM using event-driven microservices, data virtualization, and domain-driven design. Strong experience developing secure IoT and edge architectures for remote telemetry, sensor fusion, and autonomous asset management, as well as integrating GIS platforms such as Esri ArcGIS, Hexagon GeoMedia, and Bentley Map with enterprise asset repositories.
  • Demonstrated success delivering geospatially enabled asset intelligence, risk scoring, and field mobility solutions for regulated, distributed, and infrastructure-intensive environments, including transportation, utilities, plants, and facilities.
  • Proven contribution to the architecture profession or industry, such as publications, research, intellectual property, innovation, development of training, or contributions to standards bodies or professional organizations. They must also have contributed to the development of professional architects in sharing this knowledge.
  • Experience creating significant business value realization with $500 million+ or more enterprises as an architect providing vision and choosing platforms. moving organizations forward and scaled for future initiatives.
  • Requires demonstrated ability to manage multiple architecture engagements and effectively plan and utilize collaborative cross functional teams to ensure the architecture objectives obtain key results.
  • Must possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, work well with others in an integrated team environment, and must be self-motivated.
  • Relationship building and collaboration skills across diverse and matrixed stakeholders and customers. 
  • Ability to surface, prioritize, and balance priorities across multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, including experience leveraging data to inform decision-making.
  • Technical and critical thinking expertise to break complex processes and products into component modular modern architectures.
  • Proven ability to align resources, processes and technology initiatives with business strategies across multiple lines of business (LOBs) or business units

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in business or related field
  • 17+ years of progressive experience in technology and architecture, with at least 12 years in a Principal or Senior Principal Architect role within a large, complex enterprise.
  • Travel and Transportation experience or relevant technology domain experience
  • Experience with governance, risk, regulatory and compliance.
  • The Architect’s skills and knowledge should span multiple architecture domains (e.g., Business Architecture, Application/Solution Architecture, Technical/Infrastructure Architecture & Information/Data Architecture)

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent applied experience.
  • 13+ years’ experience in relevant industry experience
  • Strong understanding of Architecture best practice and value methodology
  • Knowledge of IT, OT, domain and business architecture
  • Experience with Agile process for business value realization

jobs.excerpt: At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love.
jobs.description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

Senior Consultant, Safety and Reliability

Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, we partner with health systems to build resilient, safety-first cultures where clinical care and patient trust thrive. As a Senior Consultant, Safety and Reliability, you will guide healthcare organizations through transformational change by applying High Reliability Organization (HRO) principles, strengthening safety culture, and deploying Communication and Resolution Programs (CRP). You will collaborate closely with clinical teams and management to turn complex analytics into actionable process improvements that keep healthcare workers and patients safe. If you are passionate about applying data-driven insights to lower clinical risks and embed safety into daily healthcare operations, this role is for you.

How You’ll Find Success

  • Data & Analytics Competency: Highly proficient using analytical tools (Excel, SQL, SAS, Access) to perform quantitative and qualitative analysis on payer analytics, authorization metrics, denial rates, and behavioral observation data.
  • Project Workstream Execution: Manages day-to-day engagement plans—tracking timelines, scope, budgets, and deliverables using structured project management tools.
  • High Reliability Subject Matter Focus: Deeply understands HRO frameworks, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Fair and Just Culture, Safety Culture and Preventable Harm metrics, and Communication and Resolution Programs (CRP) to solve complex operational challenges.
  • Training & Facilitation: Excels at coaching patient-facing teams and leading interactive training sessions to drive engagement and long-term capability transfer.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicates effectively with client management and project leads, proactively sharing risks, recommendations, and progress updates.

How You’ll Grow

  • Deepen your expertise in High Reliability Organization (HRO) principles and safety culture transformation across diverse healthcare environments.
  • Build your client leadership capabilities as a primary workstream point of contact with client stakeholders.
  • Expand your mastery of complex healthcare analytics, data interpretation, and process optimization.
  • Collaborate with senior consulting leadership to shape Press Ganey safety methodologies, training toolkits, and client offerings.

Things You’ll Do

  • Advance Safety & Reliability Culture: Support client engagements focused on expanding HRO principles, improving safety culture metrics, and reducing clinical errors across care delivery settings.
  • Analyze & Interpret Complex Data: Construct data analyses—including payer metrics, authorization trends, denial rates, and behavioral assessments—to identify root causes and formulate actionable client recommendations.
  • Deliver High-Quality Engagements: Execute engagement plans on time and within budget, preparing core client deliverables such as data reviews, quality assessments, and executive presentations.
  • Train & Coach Frontline Teams: Deliver high-engagement training and coaching programs for patient-facing teams to ensure seamless knowledge transfer and sustained performance improvement.
  • Manage Workstream Relationships: Serve as a direct point of contact for project workstreams, building credibility with client teams, coordinating resources, and managing project risks.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • 10+ years of healthcare industry experience focused on safety and high reliability.
  • Demonstrated experience participating in or driving performance improvement and safety initiatives within healthcare settings.
  • Prior consulting or safety and reliability implementation experience strongly preferred.
  • Practical experience coaching, training, or facilitating patient-facing teams.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, MS Office, and data querying/analytical tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Access).
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree or clinical background (Nursing, Medicine, Pharmacy, Safety/Quality/Risk Management) preferred.
  • Ability to travel 50–75% (~10 days/month on-site across the US and select international locations).

What You Should Know About This Team

  • Diverse, Cross-Industry Expertise: You will join a supportive team of ~20 professionals that merges deep healthcare safety and quality backgrounds with high-reliability expertise from aviation, military, and nuclear industries.
  • Direct Executive & Patient Impact: Our work directly transforms health system leadership culture, eliminates systemic human error, and protects patients and healthcare workers in care delivery environments.
  • Data-Backed Consulting Model: We leverage market-leading healthcare data assets alongside clinical domain expertise to deliver measurable, sustainable operational changes for our clients.
  • Culture of Coaching & Continuous Learning: We cultivate a collaborative environment where leaders delegate effectively, share best practices, and actively invest in the career growth and analytical skill development of every team member.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • We participate in personalized Career Action Planning. You will work with your manager to design a plan based on your life experiences, values, and career aspirations (inside and outside Qualtrics) that helps you achieve your career goals at Qualtrics.
  • Qualtrics pays 100% of the healthcare benefit premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Variable allowances for wellness, meals, transportation, and more.

​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:Family & Medical Leave Act, Equal Opportunity Employment, Employee Polygraph Protection Act

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.

A global PR and marketing partner for challenger brands. We help disruptors, innovators and market leaders go beyond the expectations and standards of their industry - to create narratives that capture the minds of target audiences and generate real impact.

Account Director

B2B Tech Public Relations | Method Communications

Work Arrangement

The role can be performed hybrid (2x/week) for those based in San Francisco, Salt Lake City, Boston, or New York City.

We welcome applications from qualified remote candidates who can accommodate periodic travel to a hub office for collaboration and team meetings. We have growing remote hubs in the following cities: LA, Seattle, Portland, and D.C.

Note: If you reside within 50 miles of one of our hub offices, you would be required to work a hybrid schedule (minimum of two days per week in-office).

We currently only operate in the following states: AL, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, MA, NJ, NM, NY, OR, TX, VA, and WA.

The Opportunity

Account Directors (AD) are mid-level managers and first-level people managers who manage and function as the day-to-day leads on multiple client accounts. You’ll be a hands-on team member actively engaged in day-to-day work activities as well as responsible for the leadership and overall direction of account teams including client service, staffing, training, organizational development, and quality control.   • Execute and demonstrate Method’s Concierge Service Delivery Approach to your clients and teams
  • Oversee the development of goals for internal team members and clients, leading teams to effectively execute against client strategy

  • Develop strong written content and newsworthy pitches that align with client's business objectives and coach teams to do the same

Business Development

  • Passion for work and commitment to developing skills and helping team members learn on a daily basis
